1. (Ka) ye [T 1.0001][V 1.0001][M 1.0001] keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlā?

1. (Ka) Whatever wholesome states there are, are all those states wholesome roots?

(Kha) ye vā pana kusalamūlā, sabbe te dhammā kusalā?

(Kha) Or again, whatever states are wholesome roots, are all those states wholesome?

2. (Ka) ye [V 1.0002] keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlena ekamūlā?

2. (Ka) Whatever wholesome states there are, do all those states have a common root with a wholesome root?

(Kha) Or again, whatever states are mutually rooted by means of a wholesome root, are all those states wholesome?

Mūlavārauddeso.

Summary of the Root Section.

2-10. Hetuvārādi

2-10. The Section on Cause, etc.

49. Ye [V 1.0009] keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalahetū…pe… kusalanidānā…pe… kusalasambhavā…pe… kusalappabhavā…pe… kusalasamuṭṭhānā…pe… kusalāhārā…pe… kusalārammaṇā…pe… kusalapaccayā…pe… kusalasamudayā…pe….

49. Whatever wholesome phenomena there are, are all of them wholesome-cause... (and so on)... wholesome-source... wholesome-origin... wholesome-production... wholesome-arising... wholesome-nutriment... wholesome-object... wholesome-condition... wholesome-origination?

Mūlaṃ hetu nidānañca, sambhavo pabhavena ca;

Samuṭṭhānāhārārammaṇā samuṭṭhānāhārārammaṇaṃ (ka.), paccayo samudayena cāti.

Root, cause, and source; origin together with production; arising, nutriment, object; condition together with origination.

Uddesavāro niṭṭhito.

The Summary Section is finished.

(Kha) niddeso

(B) The Exposition

1. Mūlavāro

1. The Root Section

1. Kusalā dhammā (1) mūlanayo

1. Wholesome Phenomena. (1) The Root Method

50. (Ka) ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlāti? Tīṇeva kusalamūlāni. Avasesā kusalā dhammā na kusalamūlā.

50. (A) Whatever wholesome phenomena there are, are they all wholesome roots? There are only three wholesome roots. The remaining wholesome phenomena are not wholesome roots.

(Kha) ye vā pana kusalamūlā, sabbe te dhammā kusalāti? Āmantā.

(B) Or whatever are wholesome roots, are all those phenomena wholesome? Yes.

51. (Ka) ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlena ekamūlāti? Āmantā.

51. (A) Whatever wholesome phenomena there are, are they all of one root with the wholesome root? Yes.

(Kha) ye vā pana kusalamūlena ekamūlā, sabbe te dhammā kusalāti[M 1.0007]?

(B) Or whatever phenomena are of one root with the wholesome root, are all those phenomena wholesome?

Kusalasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 1.0010] rūpaṃ kusalamūlena ekamūlaṃ, na kusalaṃ. Kusalaṃ kusalamūlena ekamūlañceva kusalañca.

Material form originated from the wholesome is of one root with the wholesome root, but is not wholesome. The wholesome is both of one root with the wholesome root and is wholesome.

52. (Ka) ye keci kusalamūlena ekamūlā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlena aññamaññamūlāti?

52. (A) Whatever phenomena are of one root with the wholesome root, are they all, by means of the wholesome root, mutually rooted?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti kusalamūlāni ekamūlāni ceva aññamaññamūlāni ca. Avasesā kusalamūlasahajātā dhammā kusalamūlena ekamūlā, na ca aññamaññamūlā.

Those roots that arise together, the wholesome roots, are both of one root and mutually rooted. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the wholesome root are of one root with the wholesome root, but are not mutually rooted.

(Kha) ye vā pana kusalamūlena [T 1.0007] aññamaññamūlā, sabbe te dhammā kusalāti? Āmantā.

(B) Or whatever phenomena are mutually rooted by means of the wholesome root, are all those phenomena wholesome? Yes.

(2) Mūlamūlanayo

(2) The Root-of-Root Method

53. (Ka) ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalamūlamūlāti? Tīṇeva kusalamūlamūlāni. Avasesā kusalā dhammā na kusalamūlamūlā.

53. (A) Whatever wholesome phenomena there are, are they all the root of the wholesome root? Only the three wholesome roots are the root of the wholesome root. The remaining wholesome phenomena are not the root of the wholesome root.

(Kha) ye vā pana kusalamūlamūlā, sabbe te dhammā kusalāti? Āmantā.

(B) Or whatever phenomena are the root of the wholesome root, are all those phenomena wholesome? Yes.

Those indeterminate roots that arise together both have a common root and are mutually rooted. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the indeterminate roots have a common root with the indeterminate root but are not mutually rooted.

(Kha) ye vā pana abyākatamūlena aññamaññamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā abyākatāti? Āmantā.

Or whatever phenomena are mutually rooted by means of the indeterminate root, are all those phenomena indeterminate? Yes.

(4) Mūlamūlakanayo

(4) The Section on Being Rooted in a Root

83. (Ka) ye [V 1.0018] keci abyākatā dhammā, sabbe te abyākatamūlamūlakāti?

83. (Ka) Whatever indeterminate phenomena there are, are they all rooted in the indeterminate root?

Ahetukaṃ abyākataṃ na abyākatamūlamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ abyākataṃ abyākatamūlamūlakaṃ.

The rootless indeterminate is not rooted in the indeterminate root. The indeterminate with roots is rooted in the indeterminate root.

(Kha) ye vā pana abyākatamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā abyākatāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in the indeterminate root, are all those phenomena indeterminate? Yes.

84. (Ka) ye keci abyākatā dhammā, sabbe te abyākatamūlena ekamūlamūlakāti?

84. (Ka) Whatever indeterminate phenomena there are, are they all rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root?

Ahetukaṃ abyākataṃ abyākatamūlena na ekamūlamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ abyākataṃ abyākatamūlena ekamūlamūlakaṃ.

The rootless indeterminate is not rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root. The indeterminate with roots is rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root.

(Kha) ye vā pana abyākatamūlena ekamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā abyākatāti[T 1.0014]? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root, are all those phenomena indeterminate? Yes.

85. (Ka) ye keci abyākatamūlena ekamūlamūlakā dhammā, sabbe te abyākatamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlakāti?

85. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root, are they all rooted in a mutual root by means of the indeterminate root?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti abyākatamūlāni ekamūlamūlakāni ceva aññamaññamūlamūlakāni ca. Avasesā [M 1.0013] abyākatamūlasahajātā dhammā abyākatamūlena ekamūlamūlakā, na ca aññamaññamūlamūlakā.

Whatever indeterminate roots arise together, they are both rooted in a common root and rooted in a mutual root. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the indeterminate roots are rooted in a common root with the indeterminate root, but are not rooted in a mutual root.

(Kha) ye vā pana abyākatamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā abyākatāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in a mutual root by means of the indeterminate root, are all those phenomena indeterminate? Yes.

4. Nāmā dhammā (1) mūlanayo

4. Mental Phenomena (1) The Section on Roots

86. (Ka) ye [V 1.0019] keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlāti?

86. (Ka) Whatever mental phenomena there are, are they all mental roots?

Naveva nāmamūlāni. Avasesā nāmā dhammā na nāmamūlā.

Only the nine are mental roots. The remaining mental phenomena are not mental roots.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are mental roots, are all those phenomena mental phenomena? Yes.

87. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena ekamūlāti?

87. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are nāma, do they all have the same root as the nāma-root?

Ahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena na ekamūlaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlaṃ.

Rootless nāma does not have the same root as the nāma-root. Nāma with roots has the same root as the nāma-root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena ekamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena have the same root as the nāma-root, are all those phenomena nāma?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlañceva nāmañca.

Matter originated from nāma has the same root as the nāma-root, but it is not nāma. Nāma both has the same root as the nāma-root and is nāma.

88. (Ka) ye keci nāmamūlena ekamūlā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlāti?

88. (Ka) Whatever phenomena have the same root as the nāma-root, are they all mutually rooted by means of the nāma-root?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti nāmamūlāni ekamūlāni ceva aññamaññamūlāni ca. Avasesā nāmamūlasahajātā dhammā nāmamūlena ekamūlā, na ca aññamaññamūlā.

Whatever roots that are mental roots arise together, they both have a common root and are mutually rooted. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the mental roots have a common root with the mental root, but are not mutually rooted.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are mutually rooted by means of the nāma-root, are all those phenomena nāma? Yes.

(2) Mūlamūlanayo

(2) The Section on the Root of a Root

89. (Ka) ye [T 1.0015] keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlamūlāti?

89. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are nāma, are they all rooted in the nāma-root?

Naveva nāmamūlamūlāni. Avasesā nāmā dhammā na nāmamūlamūlā.

Only the nine nāma-roots are rooted in the nāma-root. The remaining phenomena that are nāma are not rooted in the nāma-root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in the nāma-root, are all those phenomena nāma? Yes.

90. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlāti?

90. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are nāma, are they all rooted in the same root as the nāma-root?

Ahetukaṃ [V 1.0020] nāmaṃ nāmamūlena na ekamūlamūlaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlaṃ.

Rootless nāma is not rooted in the same root as the nāma-root. Nāma with roots is rooted in the same root as the nāma-root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in the same root as the nāma-root, are all those phenomena nāma?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlañceva nāmañca.

Matter originated from nāma is rooted in the same root as the nāma-root, but it is not nāma. Nāma both is rooted in the same root as the nāma-root and is nāma.

91. (Ka) ye keci nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlāti?

91. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are rooted in the same root as the nāma-root, are they all rooted in a mutual root by means of the nāma-root?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti nāmamūlāni ekamūlamūlāni [M 1.0014] ceva aññamaññamūlamūlāni ca. Avasesā nāmamūlasahajātā dhammā nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlā, na ca aññamaññamūlamūlā.

Whatever roots that are mental roots arise together, they are both rooted in a common root and mutually rooted. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the mental roots are rooted in a common root with the mental root, but are not mutually rooted.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena are rooted in a mutual root by means of the nāma-root, are all those phenomena nāma? Yes.

(3) Mūlakanayo

(3) The Section on the Rooted

92. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlakāti?

92. (Ka) Whatever phenomena are nāma, do they all have a nāma-root?

Ahetukaṃ nāmaṃ na nāmamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlakaṃ.

Rootless mentality does not have a mental root. Mentality with roots has a mental root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena have a mental root, are they all mentality?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ nāmamūlakaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlakañceva nāmañca.

Materiality originated from mind has a mental root, but is not mentality. Mentality both has a mental root and is mentality.

93. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena ekamūlakāti?

93. (Ka) Whatever mental phenomena there are, do they all have a common root with the mental root?

Ahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena na ekamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlakaṃ.

Rootless mentality does not have a common root with the mental root. Mentality with roots has a common root with the mental root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena ekamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or whatever phenomena have a common root with the mental root, are they all mentality?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ [T 1.0016] nāmamūlena ekamūlakaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlakañceva nāmañca.

Materiality originated from mind is of a single root with the name-root, but is not mentality. Mentality is both of a single root with the name-root and is mentality.

94. (Ka) ye [V 1.0021] keci nāmamūlena ekamūlakā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlakāti?

94. (Ka) Of whatever phenomena are of a single root with the name-root, are they all mutually rooted by means of the name-root?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti nāmamūlāni ekamūlakāni ceva aññamaññamūlakāni ca. Avasesā nāmamūlasahajātā dhammā nāmamūlena ekamūlakā, na ca aññamaññamūlakā.

The name-roots which arise together are both of a single root and mutually rooted. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the name-roots are of a single root with the name-root, but are not mutually rooted.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, of whatever phenomena that are mutually rooted by means of the name-root, are they all mentality? Yes.

(4) Mūlamūlakanayo

(4) The Section on the Root of the Root

95. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlamūlakāti?

95. (Ka) Of whatever phenomena are mentality, are they all rooted in the name-root?

Ahetukaṃ nāmaṃ na nāmamūlamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlamūlakaṃ.

Rootless mentality is not rooted in the name-root. Mentality with roots is rooted in the name-root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or, of whatever phenomena that are rooted in the name-root, are they all mentality?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ nāmamūlamūlakaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlamūlakañceva nāmañca.

Materiality originated from mind is rooted in the name-root, but is not mentality. Mentality is both rooted in the name-root and is mentality.

96. (Ka) ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakāti?

96. (Ka) Of whatever phenomena are mentality, are they all rooted in the same root as the name-root?

Ahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena na ekamūlamūlakaṃ. Sahetukaṃ nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakaṃ.

Rootless mentality is not rooted in the same root as the name-root. Mentality with roots is rooted in the same root as the name-root.

(Kha) ye vā pana nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or, of whatever phenomena that are rooted in the same root as the name-root, are they all mentality?

Nāmasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakaṃ, na nāmaṃ. Nāmaṃ nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakañceva nāmañca.

Materiality originated from mind is rooted in the same root as the name-root, but is not mentality. Mentality is both rooted in the same root as the name-root and is mentality.

97. (Ka) ye keci nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakā dhammā, sabbe te nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlakāti?

97. (Ka) Of whatever phenomena are rooted in the same root as the name-root, are they all, by means of the name-root, rooted in a mutual root?

Mūlāni yāni ekato uppajjanti nāmamūlāni [M 1.0015] ekamūlamūlakāni ceva aññamaññamūlamūlakāni ca. Avasesā nāmamūlasahajātā dhammā nāmamūlena ekamūlamūlakā, na ca aññamaññamūlamūlakā.

The name-roots which arise together are both rooted in the same root and rooted in a mutual root. The remaining phenomena co-arisen with the name-roots are, by means of the name-root, rooted in the same root, but are not rooted in a mutual root.

(Kha) ye [V 1.0022] vā pana nāmamūlena aññamaññamūlamūlakā, sabbe te dhammā nāmāti?

(Kha) Or, of whatever phenomena that are rooted in a mutual root by means of the name-root, are they all mentality?

Āmantā.

Yes.

Mūlavāraniddeso.

The Exposition of the Root Section.

2-10. Hetuvārādi

2-10. The Section on Causes, etc.

98. Ye [T 1.0017] keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalahetūti…?

98. Whatever wholesome phenomena there are, are all of them wholesome causes?

Tayo eva kusalahetū, avasesā kusalā dhammā na kusalahetū…pe… kusalanidānā… kusalasambhavā… kusalappabhavā… kusalasamuṭṭhānā… kusalāhārā… kusalārammaṇā… kusalapaccayā… kusalasamudayā….

There are only three wholesome causes; the remaining wholesome phenomena are not wholesome causes… (and so on for) having wholesome as their basis… born of wholesome… originating from wholesome… arising from wholesome… having wholesome as nutriment… having wholesome as object… conditioned by wholesome… having wholesome as their origin.

99. Ye keci akusalā dhammā… ye keci abyākatā dhammā… ye keci nāmā dhammā, sabbe te nāmahetū ti… nāmanidānā… nāmasambhavā… nāmappabhavā… nāmasamuṭṭhānā… nāmāhārā… nāmārammaṇā… nāmapaccayā… nāmasamudayā….

99. Whatever unwholesome phenomena there are… whatever indeterminate phenomena there are… whatever phenomena are mentality, are all of them mental causes… having mentality as their basis… born of mentality… originating from mentality… arising from mentality… having mentality as nutriment… having mentality as object… conditioned by mentality… having mentality as their origin.

Mūlaṃ hetu nidānañca, sambhavo pabhavena ca;

Samuṭṭhānāhārārammaṇā, paccayo samudayena cāti.

Root, cause, and basis; birth and source; arising, nutriment, and object; condition and origination.

Niddesavāro niṭṭhito.

The Exposition Section is concluded.

Mūlayamakapāḷi niṭṭhitā.

The Pāḷi of the Root Yamaka is concluded.

Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa

Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One.

26. (Ka) rūpaṃ [T 1.0022] rūpakkhandhoti?

26. (Ka) Is form the form aggregate?

Piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ rūpaṃ, na rūpakkhandho. Rūpakkhandho rūpañceva rūpakkhandho ca.

Pleasant form, agreeable form is form, but not the form aggregate. The form aggregate is both form and the form aggregate.

(Kha) rūpakkhandho rūpanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the form aggregate form? Yes.

(Ka) vedanā vedanākkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is feeling the feeling aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) vedanākkhandho vedanāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the feeling aggregate feeling? Yes.

(Ka) saññā [M 1.0022] saññākkhandhoti?

(Ka) Is perception the perception aggregate?

Diṭṭhisaññā saññā, na saññākkhandho. Saññākkhandho saññā ceva saññākkhandho ca.

Perception associated with views is perception, but not the perception aggregate. The perception aggregate is both perception and the perception aggregate.

(Kha) saññākkhandho saññāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the perception aggregate perception? Yes.

(Ka) saṅkhārā [V 1.0034] saṅkhārakkhandhoti?

(Ka) Are formations the formations aggregate?

Saṅkhārakkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saṅkhārā avasesā saṅkhārā saṅkhārā (syā.), na saṅkhārakkhandho. Saṅkhārakkhandho saṅkhārā ceva saṅkhārakkhandho ca.

Excluding the formations aggregate, the remaining formations are formations, but not the formations aggregate. The formations aggregate is both formations and the formations aggregate.

(Kha) saṅkhārakkhandho saṅkhārāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the formations aggregate formations? Yes.

(Ka) viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is consciousness the consciousness aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) viññāṇakkhandho viññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the consciousness aggregate consciousness? Yes.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(Kha) Negative Section

27. (Ka) na rūpaṃ na rūpakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

27. (Ka) Is that which is not form, not the form aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na rūpakkhandho na rūpanti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the form aggregate, not form?

Piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ na rūpakkhandho, rūpaṃ. Rūpañca rūpakkhandhañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva rūpaṃ na ca rūpakkhandho.

Pleasant form, agreeable form is not the form aggregate, but it is form. Excluding both form and the form aggregate, the remainder is neither form nor the form aggregate.

(Ka) na vedanā na vedanākkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not feeling, not the feeling aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na vedanākkhandho na vedanāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not the feeling aggregate, not feeling? Yes.

(Ka) na saññā na saññākkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not perception, not the perception aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na saññākkhandho na saññāti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the perception aggregate, not perception?

Diṭṭhisaññā na saññākkhandho, saññā. Saññañca saññākkhandhañca [T 1.0023] ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva saññā na ca saññākkhandho.

Perception associated with views is not the perception aggregate, but it is perception. Excluding both perception and the perception aggregate, the remainder is neither perception nor the perception aggregate.

(Ka) na saṅkhārā na saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Are those which are not formations, not the formations aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na saṅkhārakkhandho na saṅkhārāti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the formations aggregate, not formations?

Saṅkhārakkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā na saṅkhārakkhandho, saṅkhārā. Saṅkhāre ca saṅkhārakkhandhañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva saṅkhārā na ca saṅkhārakkhandho.

Excluding the formations aggregate, the remaining formations are not the formations aggregate, but they are formations. Excluding both formations and the formations aggregate, the remainder is neither formations nor the formations aggregate.

(Ka) na viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not consciousness, not the consciousness aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na viññāṇakkhandho na viññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not the consciousness aggregate, not consciousness? Yes.

3. Section on the Simple Aggregates

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(A) Positive

38. (Ka) rūpaṃ khandhoti? Āmantā.

38. (A) Is form an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) khandhā rūpakkhandhoti?

(B) Are the aggregates the form aggregate?

Rūpakkhandho khandho ceva rūpakkhandho ca. Avasesā khandhā na rūpakkhandho.

The form aggregate is an aggregate and it is the form aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the form aggregate.

(Ka) vedanā khandhoti? Āmantā.

(A) Is feeling an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) khandhā vedanākkhandhoti?

(B) Are the aggregates the feeling aggregate?

Vedanākkhandho [T 1.0029] khandho ceva vedanākkhandho ca. Avasesā khandhā na vedanākkhandho.

The feeling aggregate is an aggregate and it is the feeling aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the feeling aggregate.

(Ka) saññā [M 1.0027] khandhoti? Āmantā.

(A) Is perception an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) khandhā saññākkhandhoti?

(B) Are the aggregates the perception aggregate?

Saññākkhandho khandho ceva saññākkhandho ca. Avasesā khandhā na saññākkhandho.

The perception aggregate is both an aggregate and the perception aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the perception aggregate.

(Ka) saṅkhārā khandhoti? Āmantā.

(A) Are volitional formations an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) khandhā saṅkhārakkhandhoti?

(B) Are the aggregates the volitional formations aggregate?

Saṅkhārakkhandho khandho ceva saṅkhārakkhandho ca. Avasesā khandhā na saṅkhārakkhandho.

The volitional formations aggregate is both an aggregate and the volitional formations aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the volitional formations aggregate.

(Ka) viññāṇaṃ khandhoti? Āmantā.

(A) Is consciousness an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) khandhā viññāṇakkhandhoti?

(B) Are the aggregates the consciousness aggregate?

Viññāṇakkhandho khandho ceva viññāṇakkhandho ca. Avasesā khandhā na viññāṇakkhandho.

The consciousness aggregate is both an aggregate and the consciousness aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the consciousness aggregate.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) Negative

39. (Ka) na [V 1.0042] rūpaṃ na khandhoti?

39. (A) Is what is not form not an aggregate?

Rūpaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā khandhā na rūpaṃ, khandhā. Rūpañca khandhe ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva rūpaṃ na ca khandhā.

Setting aside form, the remaining aggregates are not form, but they are aggregates. Setting aside form and the aggregates, the remainder is neither form nor an aggregate.

(Kha) na khandhā na rūpakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not aggregates not the form aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) na vedanā na khandhoti?

(A) Is what is not feeling not an aggregate?

Vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā khandhā na vedanā, khandhā. Vedanañca khandhe ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vedanā na ca khandhā.

Setting aside feeling, the remaining aggregates are not feeling, but they are aggregates. Setting aside feeling and the aggregates, the remainder is neither feeling nor an aggregate.

(Kha) na khandhā na vedanākkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not aggregates not the feeling aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) na saññā na khandhoti?

(A) Is what is not perception not an aggregate?

Saññaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā khandhā na saññā, khandhā. Saññañca khandhe ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva saññā na ca khandhā.

Setting aside perception, the remaining aggregates are not perception, but they are aggregates. Setting aside perception and the aggregates, the remainder is neither perception nor an aggregate.

(Kha) na khandhā na saññākkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not aggregates not the perception aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) na [T 1.0030] saṅkhārā na khandhoti? Āmantā.

(A) Are what are not volitional formations not an aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) na khandhā na saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not aggregates not the volitional formations aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) na viññāṇaṃ na khandhoti?

(A) Is what is not consciousness not an aggregate?

Viññāṇaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā khandhā na viññāṇaṃ, khandhā. Viññāṇañca khandhe ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva viññāṇaṃ na ca khandhā.

Setting aside consciousness, the remaining aggregates are not consciousness, but they are aggregates. Setting aside consciousness and the aggregates, the remainder is neither consciousness nor an aggregate.

(Kha) na khandhā na viññāṇakkhandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not aggregates not the consciousness aggregate? Yes.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Concordant: Individual

50. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho uppajjati tassa vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti?

50. (A) For whomever the form aggregate is arising, for them is the feeling aggregate arising?

Asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjati. Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati.

For those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, for them the form aggregate is arising, but for them the feeling aggregate is not arising. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them both the form aggregate and the feeling aggregate are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho uppajjati tassa rūpakkhandho uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whomever the feeling aggregate is arising, for them is the form aggregate arising?

Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho uppajjati. Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati.

For those being reborn in the formless realm, for them the feeling aggregate is arising, but for them the form aggregate is not arising. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them both the feeling aggregate and the form aggregate are arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) Concordant: Location

51. (Ka) yattha [V 1.0050] rūpakkhandho uppajjati tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti[T 1.0037]?

51. (A) Wherever the form aggregate is arising, is the feeling aggregate arising there?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati. Pañcavokāre [M 1.0032] tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati.

In the non-percipient realm, the form aggregate is arising there, but the feeling aggregate is not arising there. In the five-constituent existence, both the form aggregate and the feeling aggregate are arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho uppajjati tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, wherever the feeling aggregate is arising, is the form aggregate arising there?

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati.

In the formless realm, the feeling aggregate is arising there, but the form aggregate is not arising there. In the five-constituent existence, both the feeling aggregate and the form aggregate are arising there.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

53. (Ka) For whomever the form aggregate is not arising, for them is the feeling aggregate not arising?

Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho [V 1.0051] nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the formless realm, for them the form aggregate is not arising, but for them the feeling aggregate is arising. For all who are passing away, for them both the form aggregate is not arising and the feeling aggregate is not arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti?

62. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0054] rūpakkhandho uppajjissati tassa vedanākkhandho uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

62. (Ka) For whichever person the form-aggregate will arise, for that person will the feeling-aggregate arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho uppajjissati tassa rūpakkhandho uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person the feeling-aggregate will arise, for that person will the form-aggregate arise?

Ye arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca uppajjissati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those persons who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the feeling-aggregate will arise, but the form-aggregate will not arise. For the other persons, both the feeling-aggregate will arise and the form-aggregate will arise.

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha [V 1.0055] vedanākkhandho uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjissati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For the non-percipient beings, for them in that plane the form-aggregate will arise, but for them in that plane the feeling-aggregate will not arise. For those in the five-constituent plane, for them in that plane both the form-aggregate will arise and the feeling-aggregate will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the feeling-aggregate will arise, for that person, in that plane will the form-aggregate arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjissati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those in the formless plane, for them in that plane the feeling-aggregate will arise, but for them in that plane the form-aggregate will not arise. For those in the five-constituent plane, for them in that plane both the feeling-aggregate will arise and the form-aggregate will arise.

65. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjissati tassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjissatīti?

66. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjissati tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them in that plane the feeling-aggregate will not arise, but the form-aggregate will arise. For those in their final existence, for them in that plane both the feeling-aggregate and the form-aggregate will not arise.

68. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho uppajjati tassa vedanākkhandho uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjati. Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho ca uppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati.

70. (Ka) yattha [V 1.0057] rūpakkhandho uppajjati tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjitthāti?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjittha.

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjittha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati.

71. (Ka) yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati tattha saññākkhandho uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho [T 1.0044] ca uppajjati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjittha.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for beings of the formless realms, for them there the feeling aggregate has arisen, but for them there the form aggregate is not arising. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them there both the feeling aggregate has arisen and the form aggregate is arising.

For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent existences, for them there the perception aggregate has arisen, but for them there the feeling aggregate is not arising. For those being reborn in the four-constituent or five-constituent existences, for them there both the perception aggregate has arisen and the feeling aggregate is arising.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn in the non-percipient existence, for them there the feeling aggregate has not arisen, but for them there the form aggregate is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, for them there both the feeling aggregate has not arisen and the form aggregate is not arising.

85. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati tassa tattha saññākkhandho uppajjissatīti?

85. (Ka) For one for whom the feeling-aggregate is arising in a certain plane, will the perception-aggregate arise for them in that plane?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati saññākkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, for them the feeling-aggregate is arising there, but for them the perception-aggregate will not arise there. For the others who are being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both the feeling-aggregate is arising there and the perception-aggregate will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho uppajjissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for one for whom the perception-aggregate will arise in a certain plane, is the feeling-aggregate arising for them in that plane?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati. Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca uppajjissati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjati.

For those who are passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them the perception-aggregate will arise there, but for them the feeling-aggregate is not arising there. For those who are being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both the perception-aggregate will arise there and the feeling-aggregate is arising there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative Section

86. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjissatīti[T 1.0049]?

86. (Ka) For one for whom the form-aggregate is not arising, for them will the feeling-aggregate not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ [V 1.0063] arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away and for those who are being reborn into the formless realm, for them the form-aggregate is not arising, but for them the feeling-aggregate will arise. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them both the form-aggregate is not arising and the feeling-aggregate will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati tassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for one for whom the feeling-aggregate will not arise, for them is the form-aggregate not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjissati rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for them the feeling-aggregate will not arise, but for them the form-aggregate is arising. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them both the feeling-aggregate will not arise and the form-aggregate is not arising.

87. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tassa saññākkhandho nuppajjissatīti?

87. (Ka) For one for whom the feeling-aggregate is not arising, for them will the perception-aggregate not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saññākkhandho nuppajjissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati saññākkhandho ca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away and for those who are being reborn into the non-percipient plane, for them the feeling-aggregate is not arising, but for them the perception-aggregate will arise. For those attaining Parinibbāna, for them both the feeling-aggregate is not arising and the perception-aggregate will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho nuppajjissati tassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for one for whom the perception-aggregate will not arise, for them is the feeling-aggregate not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0041] pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ (sī. syā.) tesaṃ saññākkhandho nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho ca nuppajjissati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those who are in their last existence and are arising, for them the perception-aggregate will not arise, but for them the feeling-aggregate is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them the perception-aggregate will not arise and the feeling-aggregate is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: Sphere

88. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

88. Where the form-aggregate is not arising, there will the feeling-aggregate not arise? It will arise.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati [T 1.0050] tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

Or, where the feeling-aggregate will not arise, there is the form-aggregate not arising? It is arising.

89. (Ka) yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tattha saññākkhandho nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

89. Where the feeling-aggregate is not arising, there will the perception-aggregate not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yattha [V 1.0064] vā pana saññākkhandho nuppajjissati tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or, where the perception-aggregate will not arise, there is the feeling-aggregate not arising? Yes.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Individual and Sphere

90. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissatīti?

90. For whom, where the form-aggregate is not arising, for them, there will the feeling-aggregate not arise?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for formless beings, for them there the form-aggregate is not arising, but for them there the feeling-aggregate will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their last existence in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings passing away, for them there both the form-aggregate is not arising and the feeling-aggregate will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever in whatsoever existence the feeling-aggregate will not arise, for them there is the form-aggregate not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjissati rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those in their last existence who are arising in the five-aggregate realm and for those who are arising as non-percipient beings, for them there the feeling-aggregate will not arise, but for them there the form-aggregate is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their last existence in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings passing away, for them there both the feeling-aggregate will not arise and the form-aggregate is not arising.

91. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tassa tattha saññākkhandho nuppajjissatīti?

91. For whomsoever in whatsoever existence the feeling-aggregate is not arising, for them there will the perception-aggregate not arise?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nuppajjissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati saññākkhandho ca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms, for them there the feeling-aggregate is not arising, but for them there the perception-aggregate will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the feeling-aggregate is not arising and the perception-aggregate will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana [T 1.0051] yattha saññākkhandho nuppajjissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever in whatsoever existence the perception-aggregate will not arise, for them there is the feeling-aggregate not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ [V 1.0065] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ [M 1.0042] tattha saññākkhandho nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca nuppajjissati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those in their last existence who are arising, for them there the perception-aggregate will not arise, but for them there the feeling-aggregate is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the perception-aggregate will not arise and the feeling-aggregate is not arising.

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca uppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, for them the form-aggregate has arisen, but for them the feeling-aggregate will not arise. For the others, for them both the form-aggregate has arisen and the feeling-aggregate will arise.

The Arising Section is concluded.

Asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings, for them the form-aggregate is ceasing there, but for them the feeling-aggregate is not ceasing there. For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane of existence, for them both the form-aggregate is ceasing there and the feeling-aggregate is ceasing there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever, wherever the feeling-aggregate is ceasing, for them, is the form-aggregate ceasing there?

Arūpā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the formless planes, for them the feeling-aggregate is ceasing there, but for them the form-aggregate is not ceasing there. For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane of existence, for them both the feeling-aggregate is ceasing there and the form-aggregate is ceasing there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual

107. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

107. For a person for whom the form aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing?

Arūpā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the formless plane, their form aggregate is not ceasing, but their feeling aggregate is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, neither their form aggregate nor their feeling aggregate is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, is the form aggregate not ceasing?

Asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca [T 1.0056] na nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the non-percipient plane, their feeling aggregate is not ceasing, but their form aggregate is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, neither their feeling aggregate nor their form aggregate is ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative: Plane

108. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

108. (Ka) In the plane where the form aggregate is not ceasing, in that plane, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing? It is ceasing.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

(Kha) Or, in the plane where the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, in that plane, is the form aggregate not ceasing? It is ceasing.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: Person-Plane

109. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0071][M 1.0046] yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

109. For a person, in a plane where the form aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, in that plane, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing?

Arūpā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the formless plane, their form aggregate is not ceasing in that plane, but their feeling aggregate is ceasing in that plane. For all those who are being reborn, neither their form aggregate nor their feeling aggregate is ceasing in that plane.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person, in a plane where the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, in that plane, is the form aggregate not ceasing?

Asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the non-percipient plane, their feeling aggregate is not ceasing there, but their form aggregate is ceasing there. For all who are being reborn, neither their feeling aggregate nor their form aggregate is ceasing there.

(2) The Past Section

110. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

110. (Ka) For whom the form aggregate has ceased, for that one has the feeling aggregate ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the feeling aggregate has ceased, for that one has the form aggregate ceased? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Direct Order: Location

111. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

111. (Ka) Where the form aggregate has ceased, there has the feeling aggregate ceased?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhattha, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhittha [T 1.0057] vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

In the non-percipient plane, there the form aggregate has ceased, but there the feeling aggregate has not ceased. In the five-aggregate plane, there both the form aggregate has ceased and the feeling aggregate has ceased.

(Kha) yattha [V 1.0072] vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, where the feeling aggregate has ceased, there has the form aggregate ceased?

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokāre tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

In the formless plane, there the feeling aggregate has ceased, but there the form aggregate has not ceased. In the five-aggregate plane, there both the feeling aggregate has ceased and the form aggregate has ceased.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

112. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

112. (Ka) For whomever, where the form aggregate has ceased, for that one, there has the feeling aggregate ceased?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhittha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For non-percipient beings, their form aggregate has ceased there, but their feeling aggregate has not ceased there. For beings of the five-aggregate planes, both their form aggregate has ceased there and their feeling aggregate has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, where the feeling aggregate has ceased, for that one, there has the form aggregate ceased?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ [M 1.0047] tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For those in the formless plane, for them, there the feeling aggregate has ceased, but for them, there the form aggregate has not ceased. For those in the five-aggregate planes, for them, there both the feeling aggregate has ceased and the form aggregate has ceased.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative: Individual

113. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Natthi.

113. (Ka) For whomever the form aggregate has not ceased, for that one, has the feeling aggregate not ceased? There is none.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the feeling aggregate has not ceased, for that one, has the form aggregate not ceased? There is none.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

114. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

114. (Ka) In whichever plane the form aggregate has not ceased, in that plane, has the feeling aggregate not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yattha [V 1.0073] vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, in whichever plane the feeling aggregate has not ceased, in that plane, has the form aggregate not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: Person-Plane

115. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

115. (Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the form aggregate has not ceased, for that one, in that plane, has the feeling aggregate not ceased?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha, no [T 1.0058] ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhittha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha.

For those in the formless plane, for them, in that plane the form aggregate has not ceased, but for them, in that plane the feeling aggregate has ceased. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them, in that plane both the form aggregate has not ceased and the feeling aggregate has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whichever plane the feeling aggregate has not ceased, for that one, in that plane, has the form aggregate not ceased?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhittha.

For the non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane the feeling aggregate has not ceased, but for them, in that plane the form aggregate has ceased. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them, in that plane both the feeling aggregate has not ceased and the form aggregate has not ceased.

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Order: Individual

116. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

116. (Ka) For whomever the form aggregate will cease, for that one, will the feeling aggregate cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the feeling aggregate will cease, for that one, will the form aggregate cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna; for them, who are passing away, their feeling aggregate will cease, but their form aggregate will not cease. For the others, both their feeling aggregate and their form aggregate will cease.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity: Sphere

117. (Ka) yattha [V 1.0074][M 1.0048] rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

117. (Ka) Where the form aggregate will cease, will the feeling aggregate cease there?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

In the non-percipient realm, the form aggregate will cease there, but the feeling aggregate will not cease there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the form aggregate and the feeling aggregate will cease there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or where the feeling aggregate will cease, will the form aggregate cease there?

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre [T 1.0059] tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

In the formless realm, the feeling aggregate will cease there, but the form aggregate will not cease there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the feeling aggregate and the form aggregate will cease there.

118. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

118. (Ka) For whom, where the form aggregate will cease, for them will the feeling aggregate cease there?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them the form aggregate will cease there, but for them the feeling aggregate will not cease there. For beings of the five-aggregate realms, for them both the form aggregate and the feeling aggregate will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For formless beings, for them the feeling aggregate will cease there, but for them the form aggregate will not cease there. For beings of the five-aggregate realms, for them both the feeling aggregate and the form aggregate will cease there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual

119. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

119. (Ka) For whom the form aggregate will not cease, for them will the feeling aggregate not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ [V 1.0075] arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna; for them, who are passing away, the form aggregate will not cease, but their feeling aggregate will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, both their form aggregate and their feeling aggregate will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the feeling aggregate will not cease, for them will the form aggregate not cease? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: Sphere

120. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

120. (Ka) Where the form aggregate will not cease, there will the feeling aggregate not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

(Kha) Or where the feeling aggregate will not cease, there will the form aggregate not cease? It will cease.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Individual and Sphere

121. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0049] yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho [T 1.0060] na nirujjhissatīti?

121. (Ka) For whom, where the form aggregate will not cease, for them there will the feeling aggregate not cease?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the formless realm, for them there the form aggregate will not cease, but for them there the feeling aggregate will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, for them there both the form aggregate will not cease and the feeling aggregate will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the feeling aggregate will not cease, for them there will the form aggregate not cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For the non-percipient beings, for them there the feeling aggregate will not cease, but for them there the form aggregate will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, for them there both the feeling aggregate will not cease and the form aggregate will not cease.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive: Individual

122. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0076] rūpakkhandho nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

122. (Ka) For whom the form aggregate is ceasing, for them has the feeling aggregate ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the feeling aggregate has ceased, for them is the form aggregate ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For all those who are being reborn and for those who are passing away from the formless realms, for them the feeling aggregate has ceased, but for them the form aggregate is not ceasing. For those who are passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those who are passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them both the feeling aggregate has ceased and the form aggregate is ceasing.

123. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa saññākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

123. (Ka) For whom the feeling aggregate is ceasing, for them has the perception aggregate ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the perception aggregate has ceased, for them is the feeling aggregate ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nirujjhati. Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho ca nirujjhittha [T 1.0061] vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For all those who are being reborn and for those who are passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them the perception aggregate has ceased, but for them the feeling aggregate is not ceasing. For those who are passing away from the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms, for them both the perception aggregate has ceased and the feeling aggregate is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: Sphere

124. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

124. (Ka) Where the form aggregate is ceasing, has the feeling aggregate ceased there?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

In the non-percipient realm, the form aggregate is ceasing there, but the feeling aggregate has not ceased there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the form aggregate is ceasing there and the feeling aggregate has ceased there.

(Kha) yattha [V 1.0077] vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhatīti[M 1.0050]?

(Kha) Or again, where the feeling aggregate has ceased, is the form aggregate ceasing there?

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokāre tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati.

In the formless plane, the aggregate of feeling has ceased there, but the aggregate of form is not ceasing there. In the five-constituent plane, both the aggregate of feeling has ceased there and the aggregate of form is ceasing there.

125. (Ka) yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

125. Where the aggregate of feeling is ceasing, has the aggregate of perception ceased there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana saññākkhandho nirujjhittha tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, where the aggregate of perception has ceased, is the aggregate of feeling ceasing there? Yes.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

Positive: Persons and Planes

126. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

126. For whichever person in whichever plane the aggregate of form is ceasing, for that person in that plane has the aggregate of feeling ceased?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa planes and for those passing away from the asaññasatta plane, for them the aggregate of form is ceasing there, but for them the aggregate of feeling has not ceased there. For the others passing away from the pañcavokāra plane, for them both the aggregate of form is ceasing there and the aggregate of feeling has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whichever person in whichever plane the aggregate of feeling has ceased, for that person in that plane is the aggregate of form ceasing?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For those who are arising in the pañcavokāra plane and for those in the arūpa planes, for them the aggregate of feeling has ceased there, but for them the aggregate of form is not ceasing there. For those passing away from the pañcavokāra plane, for them both the aggregate of feeling has ceased there and the aggregate of form is ceasing there.

127. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0062] yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

127. For whichever person in whichever plane the aggregate of feeling is ceasing, for that person in that plane has the aggregate of perception ceased?

Suddhāvāse [V 1.0078] parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati saññākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa planes, for them the aggregate of feeling is ceasing there, but for them the aggregate of perception has not ceased there. For the others passing away from the catuvokāra and pañcavokāra planes, for them both the aggregate of feeling is ceasing there and the aggregate of perception has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whichever person in whichever plane the aggregate of perception has ceased, for that person in that plane is the aggregate of feeling ceasing?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati. Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca nirujjhittha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For those who are arising in the catuvokāra and pañcavokāra planes, for them the aggregate of perception has ceased there, but for them the aggregate of feeling is not ceasing there. For those passing away from the catuvokāra and pañcavokāra planes, for them both the aggregate of perception has ceased there and the aggregate of feeling is ceasing there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

Negative: Individuals

128. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

128. For whichever person the aggregate of form is not ceasing, for that person has the aggregate of feeling not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or again, for whichever person the aggregate of feeling has not ceased, for that person is the aggregate of form not ceasing? There is no such being.

129. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0051] vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa saññākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa planes and for those who are passing away from the asaññasatta plane, for them the aggregate of feeling has not ceased there, but it is not the case that for them the aggregate of form is not ceasing there. For those who are being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa plane and for those who are being reborn in the asaññasatta plane, for them there both the aggregate of feeling has not ceased and the aggregate of form is not ceasing.

132. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

For those who are being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa plane and for those in the asaññasatta plane, for them there both the aggregate of feeling is not ceasing and the aggregate of perception has not ceased.

Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

133. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0080] rūpakkhandho nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

133. For whichever person the aggregate of form is ceasing, for that person will the aggregate of feeling cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nirujjhati, no [T 1.0064] ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho [M 1.0052] nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for them the aggregate of form is ceasing, but for them the aggregate of feeling will not cease. For the others who are passing away from the five-constituent plane and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them both the aggregate of form is ceasing and the aggregate of feeling will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the aggregate of feeling will cease, for that person is the aggregate of form ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those passing away from the formless existence, their feeling-aggregate will cease, but their form-aggregate is not ceasing. For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, for them, their feeling-aggregate will cease, and their form-aggregate is ceasing.

134. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa saññākkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

For those attaining final Nibbāna, their feeling-aggregate is ceasing, but their perception-aggregate will not cease. For the others who are passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, their feeling-aggregate is ceasing, and their perception-aggregate will cease.

For all who are arising and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, their perception-aggregate will cease, but their feeling-aggregate is not ceasing. For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, their perception-aggregate will cease, and their feeling-aggregate is ceasing.
