(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

Or again, for whom, in which existence, will the perception aggregate cease? For that one, in that existence, has the feeling aggregate ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, in that existence, the perception aggregate will cease, but for them, in that existence, the feeling aggregate has not ceased. For other beings in the four-constituent existence and the five-constituent existence, for them, in that existence, both the perception aggregate will cease and the feeling aggregate has ceased.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Persons

148. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0069] rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

148. For whom has the form aggregate not ceased? For that one, will the feeling aggregate not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or again, for whom will the feeling aggregate not cease? For that one, has the form aggregate not ceased? It has ceased.

149. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa saññākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

149. For whom has the feeling aggregate not ceased? For that one, will the perception aggregate not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or again, for whom will the perception aggregate not cease? For that one, has the feeling aggregate not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Occasion

150. Yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha…pe….

150. Where the form aggregate has not ceased… and so on….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Persons and Occasions

151. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0086][M 1.0056] yattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

151. For whom, in which existence, has the form aggregate not ceased? For that one, in that existence, will the feeling aggregate not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhittha, vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, in that existence, the form aggregate has not ceased, but for them, in that existence, the feeling aggregate will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, for them, in that existence, both the form aggregate has not ceased and the feeling aggregate will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

Or again, for whom, in which existence, will the feeling aggregate not cease? For that one, in that existence, has the form aggregate not ceased?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that existence, the feeling aggregate will not cease, but for them, in that existence, the form aggregate has ceased. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, for them, in that existence, both the feeling aggregate will not cease and the form aggregate has not ceased.

152. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

152. For whom, in which existence, has the feeling aggregate not ceased? For that one, in that existence, will the perception aggregate not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0070] vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, for them there the feeling aggregate has not ceased, but for them there the perception aggregate will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them there the feeling aggregate has not ceased, and the perception aggregate will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

(b) Or alternatively, for whom, where the perception aggregate will not cease, for them there, has the feeling aggregate not ceased?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them there the perception aggregate will not cease, but for them there the feeling aggregate has ceased. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them there the perception aggregate also will not cease, and the feeling aggregate also has not ceased.

Nirodhavāro.

The Section on Cessation.

3. Uppādanirodhavāro

3. The Section on Arising and Cessation

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Order: The Individual

153. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0087] rūpakkhandho uppajjati tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti? No.

153. (a) For whom the form aggregate is arising, for that person, is the feeling aggregate ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa rūpakkhandho uppajjatīti? No.

(b) Or alternatively, for whom the feeling aggregate is ceasing, for that person, is the form aggregate arising? No.

154. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0057] vedanākkhandho uppajjati tassa saññākkhandho nirujjhatīti? No.

154. (a) For whom the feeling aggregate is arising, for that person, is the perception aggregate ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti? No.

(b) Or alternatively, for whom the perception aggregate is ceasing, for that person, is the feeling aggregate arising? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Direct Order: The Plane of Existence

155. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti?

155. (a) Where the form aggregate is arising, is the feeling aggregate ceasing there?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati, no ca tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati.

In the non-percipient plane, the form aggregate is arising there, but the feeling aggregate is not ceasing there. In the five-constituent plane, both the form aggregate is arising there and the feeling aggregate is ceasing there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjatīti?

(b) Or alternatively, where the feeling aggregate is ceasing, is the form aggregate arising there?

Arūpe tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati, no ca tattha rūpakkhandho [T 1.0071] uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjati.

In the formless plane, the feeling aggregate is ceasing there, but the form aggregate is not arising there. In the five-constituent plane, both the feeling aggregate is ceasing there and the form aggregate is arising there.

156. (Ka) yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

156. (a) Where the feeling aggregate is arising, is the perception aggregate ceasing there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha [V 1.0088] vā pana saññākkhandho nirujjhati tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or alternatively, where the perception aggregate is ceasing, is the feeling aggregate arising there? Yes.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Direct Order: The Individual and the Plane of Existence

157. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho uppajjati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhatīti? No.

157. (a) For whom, where the form aggregate is arising, for that person, is the feeling aggregate ceasing there? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjatīti? No.

(b) Or alternatively, for whom, where the feeling aggregate is ceasing, for that person, is the form aggregate arising there? No.

158. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjati tassa tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhatīti? No.

158. (a) For whom, where the feeling aggregate is arising, for that person, is the perception aggregate ceasing there? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho nirujjhati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjatīti? No.

(b) Or alternatively, for whom, where the perception aggregate is ceasing, for that person, is the feeling aggregate arising there? No.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: The Individual

159. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

159. (a) For whom the form aggregate is not arising, for that person, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati. Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them the form aggregate is not arising, but for them the feeling aggregate is ceasing. For those being reborn into the formless plane and those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them both the form aggregate is not arising and the feeling aggregate is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or alternatively, for whom the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, is the form aggregate not arising?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati, no [M 1.0058] ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho nuppajjati. Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent plane and those being reborn into the non-percipient plane, for them the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, but for them the form aggregate is arising. For those being reborn into the formless plane and those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them both the feeling aggregate is not ceasing and the form aggregate is not arising.

160. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0072][V 1.0089] vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tassa saññākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

160. (a) For whom the feeling aggregate is not arising, for that person, is the perception aggregate not ceasing?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saññākkhandho na nirujjhati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them the feeling aggregate is not arising, but for them the perception aggregate is ceasing. For non-percipient beings, for them both the feeling aggregate is not arising and the perception aggregate is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or alternatively, for whom the perception aggregate is not ceasing, for that person, is the feeling aggregate not arising?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nuppajjati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them the perception aggregate is not ceasing, but for them the feeling aggregate is arising. For non-percipient beings, for them both the perception aggregate is not ceasing and the feeling aggregate is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(e) Negative: The Plane of Existence

161. (Ka) yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

161. (a) Where the form aggregate is not arising, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing there? It is ceasing.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(b) Or alternatively, where the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, is the form aggregate not arising there? It is arising.

162. (Ka) yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

162. (a) Where the feeling aggregate is not arising, is the perception aggregate not ceasing there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana saññākkhandho na nirujjhati tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or alternatively, where the perception aggregate is not ceasing, is the feeling aggregate not arising there? Yes.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative: The Individual and the Plane of Existence

163. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

163. (a) For whom, where the form aggregate is not arising, for that person, is the feeling aggregate not ceasing there?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati. Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them there the form aggregate is not arising, but for them there the feeling aggregate is ceasing. For those being reborn into the formless plane and those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them there both the form aggregate is not arising and the feeling aggregate is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjatīti[T 1.0073]?

Or, for whichever person in whichever plane the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, for that person in that plane is the form aggregate not arising?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho [V 1.0090] na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjati. Arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhati rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those who are being reborn in the five-constituent plane and for those who are being reborn in the non-percipient plane, for them in that plane the feeling aggregate is not ceasing, but for them in that plane the form aggregate is arising. For those who are being reborn in the formless plane and for those who are passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them in that plane both the feeling aggregate is not ceasing and the form aggregate is not arising.

164. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0059] yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati tassa tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhatīti?

164. For whichever person in whichever plane the feeling aggregate is not arising, for that person in that plane is the perception aggregate not ceasing?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhati.

For those who are passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them in that plane the feeling aggregate is not arising, but for them in that plane the perception aggregate is ceasing. For those in the non-percipient plane, for them in that plane both the feeling aggregate is not arising and the perception aggregate is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjatīti?

Or, for whichever person in whichever plane the perception aggregate is not ceasing, for that person in that plane is the feeling aggregate not arising?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them, there, the perception aggregate is not ceasing, but for them, there, the feeling aggregate is arising. For those in the non-percipient plane, for them, there, both the perception aggregate is not ceasing and the feeling aggregate is not arising.

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Concordant Individual

165. (Ka) yassa rūpakkhandho uppajjittha tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

165. (Ka) For whom the form aggregate arose, for them did the feeling aggregate cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the feeling aggregate ceased, for them did the form aggregate arise? Yes.

166. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho uppajjittha tassa saññākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

166. (Ka) For whom the feeling aggregate arose, for them did the perception aggregate cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0091] vā pana saññākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa [T 1.0074] vedanākkhandho uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the perception aggregate ceased, for them did the feeling aggregate arise? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Concordant Occasion

167. Yattha rūpakkhandho uppajjittha…pe….

167. Where the form aggregate arose… and so on….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) The Concordant Individual and Occasion

168. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho uppajjittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhitthāti?

168. (Ka) For whom, where the form aggregate arose, for them, there, did the feeling aggregate cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha.

For non-percipient beings, for them, there, the form aggregate arose, but for them, there, the feeling aggregate did not cease. For beings in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, both the form aggregate arose and the feeling aggregate ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whom, where the feeling aggregate ceased, for them, there, did the form aggregate arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjittha.

For formless beings, for them, there, the feeling aggregate ceased, but for them, there, the form aggregate did not arise. For beings in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, both the feeling aggregate ceased and the form aggregate arose.

169. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0060] yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha tassa tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

169. (Ka) For whom, where the feeling aggregate arose, for them, there, did the perception aggregate cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom, where the perception aggregate ceased, for them, there, did the feeling aggregate arise? Yes.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0092] vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjitthāti? Natthi.

Or, for whom the aggregate of feeling had not ceased, for that one, had the aggregate of form not arisen? There is not.

171. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha tassa saññākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Natthi.

171. For whom the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, for that one, had the aggregate of perception not ceased? There is not.

Or, for whom the aggregate of perception had not ceased, for that one, had the aggregate of feeling not arisen? There is not.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

172. Yattha [T 1.0075] rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha…pe….

172. Where the aggregate of form had not arisen… and so on….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Individual and Occasion of Opposition

173. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti?

173. For whom, where the aggregate of form had not arisen, for that one, there, had the aggregate of feeling not ceased?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha.

For those in the formless realms, for them, there, the aggregate of form had not arisen, but for them, there, the aggregate of feeling had ceased. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the aggregate of form had not arisen and the aggregate of feeling had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjitthāti?

Or, for whom, where the aggregate of feeling had not ceased, for that one, there, had the aggregate of form not arisen?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhittha rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjittha.

For non-percipient beings, for them, there, the aggregate of feeling had not ceased, but for them, there, the aggregate of form had arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the aggregate of feeling had not ceased and the aggregate of form had not arisen.

174. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha tassa tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

174. For whom, where the aggregate of feeling had not arisen, for that one, there, had the aggregate of perception not ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or, for whom, where the aggregate of perception had not ceased, for that one, there, had the aggregate of feeling not arisen? Yes.

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Positive Individual

175. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0093][M 1.0061] rūpakkhandho uppajjissati tassa vedanākkhandho nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

175. For whom the aggregate of form will arise, for that one, will the aggregate of feeling cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho uppajjissatīti?

Or, for whom the aggregate of feeling will cease, for that one, will the aggregate of form arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpakkhandho uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those who are in their final existence and are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the feeling aggregate will cease, but for them the form aggregate will not arise. For the other persons, for them both the feeling aggregate will cease and the form aggregate will arise.

Or for whomever the perception aggregate will cease, for them will the feeling aggregate arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vedanākkhandho uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ saññākkhandho ca nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, for them the perception aggregate will cease, but for them the feeling aggregate will not arise. For the others, for them both the perception aggregate will cease and the feeling aggregate will arise.

For non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the form aggregate will arise, but for them, in that plane, the feeling aggregate will not cease. For those in the five-constituent planes, for them, in that plane, both the form aggregate will arise and the feeling aggregate will cease.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent plane, and for those in the formless planes, for them, in that plane, the feeling aggregate will cease, but for them, in that plane, the form aggregate will not arise. For the others in the five-constituent planes, for them, in that plane, both the feeling aggregate will cease and the form aggregate will arise.

For non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the feeling aggregate will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the form aggregate will arise. For those attaining final extinguishment, for them, in that plane, both the feeling aggregate will not cease and the form aggregate will not arise.

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca uppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For the other beings in the five-constituent existence, for them, therein, both the aggregate of form has arisen and the aggregate of feeling will cease.

For the other beings in the five-constituent existence, for them, therein, both the aggregate of feeling will cease and the aggregate of form has arisen.

200. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha tassa tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissatīti?

200. For whichever person, wherein the aggregate of feeling has arisen, for that person, therein, will the aggregate of perception cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca uppajjittha saññākkhandho ca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them, therein, the aggregate of feeling has arisen, but for them, therein, the aggregate of perception will not cease. For the other beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, therein, both the aggregate of feeling has arisen and the aggregate of perception will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whichever person, wherein the aggregate of perception will cease, for that person, therein, has the aggregate of feeling arisen?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca uppajjittha.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, therein, the aggregate of perception will cease, but for them, therein, the aggregate of feeling has not arisen. For the other beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, therein, both the aggregate of perception will cease and the aggregate of feeling has arisen.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

The Negative: Person

201. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0102][M 1.0067] rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha tassa vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

201. For whichever person the aggregate of form has not arisen, for that person, will the aggregate of feeling not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa rūpakkhandho nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

Or, for whom the feeling aggregate will not cease, has the form aggregate not arisen for that person? It has arisen.

202. (Ka) yassa vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha tassa saññākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

202. For whom the feeling aggregate has not arisen, will the perception aggregate not cease for that person? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa [T 1.0084] vedanākkhandho nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

Or, for whom the perception aggregate will not cease, has the feeling aggregate not arisen for that person? It has arisen.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

Negative: Location Section

203. Yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha…pe….

203. Where the form aggregate has not arisen... and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

Negative: Person and Location Section

204. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha tassa tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

204. For a person for whom, and in a plane where, the form aggregate has not arisen, for that person, in that plane, will the feeling aggregate not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjittha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for beings in the formless realms, for them, the form aggregate has not arisen there, but for them, the feeling aggregate will cease there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, for them, both the form aggregate has not arisen there and the feeling aggregate will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjitthāti?

Or, for a person for whom, and in a plane where, the feeling aggregate will not cease, for that person, in that plane, has the form aggregate not arisen?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpakkhandho nuppajjittha[V 1.0103]. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati rūpakkhandho ca nuppajjittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, the feeling aggregate will not cease there, but for them, the form aggregate has arisen there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, for them, both the feeling aggregate will not cease there and the form aggregate has not arisen there.

205. (Ka) yassa yattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha tassa tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissatīti?

205. For a person for whom, and in a plane where, the feeling aggregate has not arisen, for that person, in that plane, will the perception aggregate not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjittha saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, the feeling aggregate has not arisen there, but for them, the perception aggregate will cease there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the feeling aggregate has not arisen there and the perception aggregate will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjitthāti?

Alternatively, for a person in a plane where the perception-aggregate will not cease, for that person in that plane, has the feeling-aggregate not arisen?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho na nirujjhissati[T 1.0085], no ca tesaṃ tattha vedanākkhandho nuppajjittha[M 1.0068]. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha saññākkhandho ca na nirujjhissati vedanākkhandho ca nuppajjittha.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them, therein, the aggregate of perception will not cease, but for them, therein, the aggregate of feeling has arisen. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, therein, both the aggregate of perception will not cease and the aggregate of feeling has not arisen.

Uppādanirodhavāro.

The Section on Arising and Cessation.

Pavattivāro niṭṭhito.

The Section on Occurrence is concluded.

3. Pariññāvāro

3. The Section on Comprehension

1. Paccuppannavāro

1. The Section on the Present

206. (Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānātīti? Āmantā.

206. Does a person who comprehends the form-aggregate also comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo [V 1.0104] vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānāti so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Alternatively, does a person who comprehends the feeling-aggregate also comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Whoever does not comprehend the form-aggregate, does that one not comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānāti so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Or again, whoever does not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, does that one not comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

2. Atītavāro

2. The Section on the Past

207. (Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānittha so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

207. Whoever comprehended the form-aggregate, did that one also comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānittha so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, whoever comprehended the feeling-aggregate, did that one also comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānittha so vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Whoever did not comprehend the form-aggregate, did that one also not comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānittha so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, whoever did not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, did that one also not comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

3. Anāgatavāro

3. The Section on the Future

208. (Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānissati so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

208. Whoever will comprehend the form-aggregate, will that one also comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, whoever will comprehend the feeling-aggregate, will that one also comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

(Ka) yo [M 1.0069] rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānissati so vedanākkhandhaṃ [T 1.0086] na parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Whoever will not comprehend the form-aggregate, will that one also not comprehend the feeling-aggregate? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, whoever will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, will that one also not comprehend the form-aggregate? Yes.

4. Paccuppannātītavāro

4. The Section on the Present and Past

209. (Ka) yo [V 1.0105] rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānitthāti? No.

209. Whoever comprehends the form-aggregate, has that one comprehended the feeling-aggregate? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānittha so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānātīti? No.

Or again, whoever has comprehended the feeling-aggregate, is that one comprehending the form-aggregate? No.

(Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānitthāti?

Whoever does not comprehend the form-aggregate, has that one not comprehended the feeling-aggregate?

Arahā rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti, no ca vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā rūpakkhandhañca na parijānanti vedanākkhandhañca na parijānittha.

The Arahant does not comprehend the form-aggregate, but has comprehended the feeling-aggregate. Setting aside the one endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons do not comprehend the form-aggregate and have not comprehended the feeling-aggregate.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānittha so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānātīti?

Or again, whoever has not comprehended the feeling-aggregate, is that one not comprehending the form-aggregate?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānittha, no ca rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā vedanākkhandhañca na parijānittha rūpakkhandhañca na parijānanti.

The one endowed with the highest path has not comprehended the feeling-aggregate, but comprehends the form-aggregate. Setting aside the one endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons have not comprehended the feeling-aggregate and do not comprehend the form-aggregate.

5. Paccuppannānāgatavāro

5. The Section on the Present and Future

210. (Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissatīti? No.

210. Whoever comprehends the form-aggregate, will that one comprehend the feeling-aggregate? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānātīti? No.

Or again, whoever will comprehend the feeling-aggregate, is that one comprehending the form-aggregate? No.

(Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti so vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissatīti?

Whoever does not comprehend the form-aggregate, will that one not comprehend the feeling-aggregate?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānanti, no ca vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissanti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te rūpakkhandhañca na parijānanti vedanākkhandhañca na parijānissanti.

Those who will attain the path do not comprehend the form-aggregate, but they will comprehend the feeling-aggregate. The Arahant and those worldlings who will not attain the path do not comprehend the form-aggregate and will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānātīti?

Or again, whoever will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, is that one not comprehending the form-aggregate?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissati, no [T 1.0087] ca rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānāti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te vedanākkhandhañca na parijānissanti rūpakkhandhañca na parijānanti.

The one endowed with the highest path will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, but comprehends the form-aggregate. The Arahant and those worldlings who will not attain the path will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate and do not comprehend the form-aggregate.

6. Atītānāgatavāro

6. The Section on the Past and Future

211. (Ka) yo [V 1.0106][M 1.0070] rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānittha so vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissatīti? No.

211. Whoever has comprehended the form-aggregate, will that one comprehend the feeling-aggregate? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ parijānitthāti? No.

Or again, whoever will comprehend the feeling-aggregate, has that one comprehended the form-aggregate? No.

(Ka) yo rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānittha so vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissatīti?

Whoever has not comprehended the form-aggregate, will that one not comprehend the feeling-aggregate?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānittha, no ca vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissanti. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te rūpakkhandhañca na parijānittha vedanākkhandhañca na parijānissanti.

Those who will attain the path have not comprehended the form-aggregate, but they will comprehend the feeling-aggregate. The one endowed with the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path have not comprehended the form-aggregate and will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate.

(Kha) yo vā pana vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissati so rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānitthāti?

Or again, whoever will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, has that one not comprehended the form-aggregate?

Arahā vedanākkhandhaṃ na parijānissati, no ca rūpakkhandhaṃ na parijānittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te vedanākkhandhañca na parijānissanti rūpakkhandhañca na parijānittha.

The Arahant will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate, but has comprehended the form-aggregate. The one endowed with the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path will not comprehend the feeling-aggregate and have not comprehended the form-aggregate.

Pariññāvāro.

The Section on Comprehension.

Khandhayamakapāḷi niṭṭhitā.

The Pāḷi of the Yamaka on the Aggregates is concluded.

Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa

Homage to the Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One.

10. (Ka) cakkhu [V 1.0116] cakkhāyatananti?

10. (A) Is the eye the eye-sphere?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhāyatanaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhu ceva cakkhāyatanañca.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are the eye, but not the eye-base. The eye-base is both the eye and the eye-base.

(Kha) cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhūti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the eye-base the eye? Yes.

(Ka) sotaṃ sotāyatananti?

(A) Is the ear the ear-base?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ sotaṃ, na sotāyatanaṃ. Sotāyatanaṃ sotañceva sotāyatanañca.

The divine ear and the stream of craving are the ear, but not the ear-base. The ear-base is both the ear and the ear-base.

(Kha) sotāyatanaṃ sotanti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the ear-base the ear? Yes.

(Ka) ghānaṃ ghānāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is the nose the nose-base? Yes.

(Kha) ghānāyatanaṃ ghānanti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the nose-base the nose? Yes.

(Ka) jivhā jivhāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is the tongue the tongue-base? Yes.

(Kha) jivhāyatanaṃ jivhāti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the tongue-base the tongue? Yes.

(Ka) kāyo [M 1.0076] kāyāyatananti?

(A) Is the body the body-base?

Kāyāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso kāyo, na kāyāyatanaṃ. Kāyāyatanaṃ kāyo ceva kāyāyatanañca.

Excluding the body-base, the remainder is the body, but not the body-base. The body-base is both the body and the body-base.

(Kha) kāyāyatanaṃ kāyoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the body-base the body? Yes.

(Ka) rūpaṃ rūpāyatananti?

(A) Is form the form-base?

Rūpāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ rūpaṃ, na rūpāyatanaṃ. Rūpāyatanaṃ rūpañceva [T 1.0092] rūpāyatanañca.

Excluding the form-base, the remainder is form, but not the form-base. The form-base is both form and the form-base.

(Kha) rūpāyatanaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the form-base form? Yes.

(Ka) saddo [V 1.0117] saddāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is sound the sound-base? Yes.

(Kha) saddāyatanaṃ saddoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the sound-base sound? Yes.

(Ka) gandho gandhāyatananti?

(A) Is odor the odor-base?

Sīlagandho samādhigandho paññāgandho gandho, na gandhāyatanaṃ. Gandhāyatanaṃ gandho ceva gandhāyatanañca.

The odor of virtue, the odor of concentration, and the odor of wisdom are odor, but not the odor-base. The odor-base is both odor and the odor-base.

(Kha) gandhāyatanaṃ gandhoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the odor-base odor? Yes.

(Ka) raso rasāyatananti?

(A) Is taste the taste-base?

Attharaso dhammaraso vimuttiraso raso, na rasāyatanaṃ. Rasāyatanaṃ raso ceva rasāyatanañca.

The taste of the meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation are taste, but not the taste-base. The taste-base is both taste and the taste-base.

(Kha) rasāyatanaṃ rasoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the taste-base taste? Yes.

(Ka) phoṭṭhabbo phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is the tangible the tangible-base? Yes.

(Kha) phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabboti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the tangible-base the tangible? Yes.

(Ka) mano manāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is the mind the mind-base? Yes.

(Kha) manāyatanaṃ manoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the mind-base the mind? Yes.

(Ka) dhammo dhammāyatananti?

(A) Is a phenomenon the phenomenon-base?

Dhammāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso dhammo, na dhammāyatanaṃ. Dhammāyatanaṃ dhammo ceva dhammāyatanañca.

Excluding the phenomenon-base, the remainder is a phenomenon, but not the phenomenon-base. The phenomenon-base is both a phenomenon and a phenomenon-base.

(Kha) dhammāyatanaṃ dhammoti? Āmantā.

(B) Is the phenomenon-base a phenomenon? Yes.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) The Negative

11. (Ka) na cakkhu na cakkhāyatananti? Āmantā.

11. (A) Is that which is not the eye not the eye-base? Yes.

(Kha) na cakkhāyatanaṃ na cakkhūti?

(B) Is that which is not the eye-base not the eye?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu na cakkhāyatanaṃ, cakkhu. Cakkhuñca cakkhāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ avasesā (syā. pī.) na ceva cakkhu na ca cakkhāyatanaṃ.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are the eye, but not the eye-base. Setting aside the eye and the eye-base, the remainder is neither the eye nor the eye-base.

(Ka) na sotaṃ na sotāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is that which is not the ear not the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) na sotāyatanaṃ na sotanti?

(B) Is that which is not the ear-base not the ear?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ na sotāyatanaṃ, sotaṃ. Sotañca sotāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva sotaṃ na ca sotāyatanaṃ.

The divine ear and the stream of craving are the ear, but not the ear-base. Setting aside the ear and the ear-base, the remainder is neither the ear nor the ear-base.

(Ka) na [V 1.0118][M 1.0077] ghānaṃ na ghānāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is that which is not the nose not the nose-base? Yes.

(Kha) na ghānāyatanaṃ na ghānanti? Āmantā.

(B) Is that which is not the nose-base not the nose? Yes.

(Ka) na jivhā na jivhāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is that which is not the tongue not the tongue-base? Yes.

(Kha) na jivhāyatanaṃ na jivhāti? Āmantā[T 1.0093].

Is that which is not the tongue-base not the tongue? Yes.

(Ka) na kāyo na kāyāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not the body not the body-base? Yes.

(Kha) na kāyāyatanaṃ na kāyoti?

Is that which is not the body-base not the body?

Kāyāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na kāyāyatanaṃ, kāyo. Kāyañca kāyāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ avaseso (syā.) na ceva kāyo na ca kāyāyatanaṃ.

Setting aside the body-base, the remainder is not the body-base, but is the body. Setting aside the body and the body-base, the remainder is neither the body nor the body-base.

(Ka) na rūpaṃ na rūpāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not form not the form-base? Yes.

(Kha) na rūpāyatanaṃ na rūpanti?

Is that which is not the form-base not form?

Rūpāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ, rūpaṃ. Rūpañca rūpāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva rūpaṃ na ca rūpāyatanaṃ.

Setting aside the form-base, the remainder is not the form-base, but is form. Setting aside form and the form-base, the remainder is neither form nor the form-base.

(Ka) na saddo na saddāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not sound not the sound-base? Yes.

(Kha) na saddāyatanaṃ na saddoti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not the sound-base not sound? Yes.

(Ka) na gandho na gandhāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not odor not the odor-base? Yes.

(Kha) na gandhāyatanaṃ na gandhoti?

Is that which is not the odor-base not odor?

Sīlagandho samādhigandho paññāgandho na gandhāyatanaṃ, gandho. Gandhañca gandhāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ avasesā (syā.) na ceva gandho na ca gandhāyatanaṃ.

The odor of virtue, the odor of concentration, and the odor of wisdom are not the odor-base, but are odor. Setting aside odor and the odor-base, the remainder is neither odor nor the odor-base.

(Ka) na raso na rasāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not taste not the taste-base? Yes.

(Kha) na rasāyatanaṃ na rasoti?

Is that which is not the taste-base not taste?

Attharaso dhammaraso vimuttiraso na rasāyatanaṃ, raso. Rasañca rasāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva raso na ca rasāyatanaṃ.

The taste of the goal, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation are not the taste-base, but are taste. Setting aside taste and the taste-base, the remainder is neither taste nor the taste-base.

(Ka) na phoṭṭhabbo na phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not tangible not the tangible-base? Yes.

(Kha) na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ na phoṭṭhabboti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not the tangible-base not tangible? Yes.

(Ka) na [V 1.0119] mano na manāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not mind not the mind-base? Yes.

(Kha) na manāyatanaṃ na manoti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not the mind-base not mind? Yes.

(Ka) na dhammo na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not a dhamma not the dhamma-base? Yes.

(Kha) na dhammāyatanaṃ na dhammoti?

Is that which is not the dhamma-base not a dhamma?

Dhammāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na dhammāyatanaṃ, dhammo. Dhammañca dhammāyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dhammo na ca dhammāyatanaṃ.

Setting aside the dhamma-base, the remainder is not the dhamma-base, but is a dhamma. Setting aside a dhamma and the dhamma-base, the remainder is neither a dhamma nor the dhamma-base.

12. (Ka) cakkhu [T 1.0094][M 1.0078] cakkhāyatananti?

12. Is the eye the eye-base?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhāyatanaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhu ceva cakkhāyatanañca…pe….

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are 'eye', but not the eye-base. The eye-base is both 'eye' and the eye-base.

(Kha) āyatanā sotāyatananti?

Are the bases the ear-base?

Sotāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva sotāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na sotāyatanaṃ.

The ear-base is both a base and the ear-base. The remaining bases are not the ear-base.

Cakkhu cakkhāyatananti?

Is the eye the eye-base?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhāyatanaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhu ceva cakkhāyatanañca…pe….

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are 'eye', but not the eye-base. The eye-base is both 'eye' and the eye-base.

Āyatanā ghānāyatananti…pe… āyatanā dhammāyatananti?

Are the bases the nose-base? …and so on… Are the bases the dhamma-base?

Dhammāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva dhammāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ.

The dhamma-base is both a base and the dhamma-base. The remaining bases are not the dhamma-base.

Sotaṃ sotāyatananti?…Pe… avasesā āyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

Is the ear the ear-base? …and so on…

Dhammo dhammāyatananti?

Is a dhamma the dhamma-base?

Dhammāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso dhammo, na dhammāyatanaṃ. Dhammāyatanaṃ dhammo ceva dhammāyatanañca…pe….

Setting aside the dhamma-base, the remainder is a dhamma, but not the dhamma-base. The dhamma-base is both a dhamma and the dhamma-base.

Āyatanā [V 1.0120] cakkhāyatananti?

Are the bases the eye-base?

Cakkhāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva cakkhāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na cakkhāyatanaṃ.

The eye-base is both a base and the eye-base. The remaining bases are not the eye-base.

Dhammo dhammāyatananti?

Is a dhamma the dhamma-base?

Dhammāyatanaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso dhammo, na dhammāyatanaṃ. Dhammāyatanaṃ dhammo ceva dhammāyatanañca.

Setting aside the dhamma-base, the remainder is a dhamma, but not the dhamma-base. The dhamma-base is both a dhamma and the dhamma-base.

Āyatanā sotāyatananti…pe… āyatanā manāyatananti?

Are the bases the ear-base? …and so on… Are the bases the mind-base?

Manāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva manāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na manāyatanaṃ.

The mind-base is both a base and the mind-base. The remaining bases are not the mind-base.

(Ekekapadamūlakaṃ cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ asammohantena).

(The wheel based on each single term should be constructed without confusion.)

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) Negative

13. (Ka) na cakkhu na cakkhāyatananti? Āmantā.

13. (A) Is what is not the eye also not the eye-base? Yes.

(Kha) nāyatanā na sotāyananti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not bases also not the ear-base? Yes.

(A) Is what is not the eye also not the eye-base? Yes.

(Kha) nāyatanā na ghānāyatananti? Āmantā.…Pe….

(B) Are what are not bases also not the nose-base? Yes.…pe….

Nāyatanā na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases also not the dhamma-base? Yes.

Na [M 1.0079] sotaṃ na sotāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is what is not the ear also not the ear-base? Yes.

Nāyatanā na [T 1.0095] cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… nāyatanā na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases also not the eye-base?…pe… are what are not bases also not the dhamma-base? Yes.

Na ghānaṃ na ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… nāyatanā na dhammāyatananti?

Is what is not the nose also not the nose-base?…pe… are what are not bases also not the dhamma-base?

Āmantā.…Pe….

Yes.…pe….

(Ka) na dhammo na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is what is not a dhamma also not the dhamma-base? Yes.

(Kha) nāyatanā na cakkhāyatananti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not bases also not the eye-base? Yes.

Na dhammo na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is what is not a dhamma also not the dhamma-base? Yes.

Nāyatanā na sotāyatanaṃ…pe… nāyatanā na manāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases also not the ear-base?…pe… are what are not bases also not the mind-base? Yes.

(Cakkaṃ bandhantena sabbattha āmantāti kātabbaṃ).

(When constructing the wheel, 'Yes' should be stated everywhere.)

3. Suddhāyatanavāro

3. The Section on Pure Bases

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(A) Positive

14. (Ka) cakkhu [V 1.0121] āyatananti? Āmantā.

14. (A) Is the eye a base? Yes.

(Kha) āyatanā cakkhāyatananti?

(B) Are bases the eye-base?

Cakkhāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva cakkhāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na cakkhāyatanaṃ.

The eye-base is both a base and the eye-base. The remaining bases are not the eye-base.

Sotaṃ āyatananti?

Is the ear a base?

Āmantā.…Pe… ghānaṃ… jivhā… kāyo… rūpaṃ… saddo… gandho… raso… phoṭṭhabbo… mano… dhammo āyatananti?

Yes.…pe… Is the nose a base? Is the tongue a base? Is the body a base? Is form a base? Is sound a base? Is smell a base? Is taste a base? Is the tangible a base? Is the mind a base? Is a dhamma a base?

Āmantā.

Yes.

Āyatanā dhammāyatananti?

Are bases the dhamma-base?

Dhammāyatanaṃ āyatanañceva dhammāyatanañca. Avasesā āyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ.

The dhamma-base is both a base and the dhamma-base. The remaining bases are not the dhamma-base.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) Negative

15. (Ka) na cakkhu nāyatananti?

15. (A) Is what is not the eye not a base?

Cakkhuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā āyatanā na cakkhu, āyatanā. Cakkhuñca āyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca āyatanā.

Except for the eye, the remaining bases are not the eye, but are bases. Except for the eye and the bases, the remaining things are neither the eye nor bases.

(Kha) nāyatanā na cakkhāyatananti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not bases not the eye-base? Yes.

Na sotaṃ nāyatananti?

Is what is not the ear not a base?

Sotaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… ghānaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… jivhaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… na ca āyatanā.

Except for the ear…pe… except for the nose…pe… except for the tongue…pe… and are not bases.

Nāyatanā na jivhāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases not the tongue-base? Yes.

(Ka) na [V 1.0122][M 1.0080] kāyo nāyatananti? Āmantā.

(A) Is what is not the body not a base? Yes.

(Kha) nāyatanā na [T 1.0096] kāyāyatananti? Āmantā.

(B) Are what are not bases not the body-base? Yes.

Na rūpaṃ nāyatananti?

Is what is not form not a base?

Rūpaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… saddaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… gandhaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… rasaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… phoṭṭhabbaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… na ca āyatanā. Nāyatanā na phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā.

Except for form…pe… except for sound…pe… except for smell…pe… except for taste…pe… except for the tangible…pe… and are not bases. Are what are not bases not the tangible-base? Yes.

(Ka) na mano nāyatananti?

(A) Is what is not mind not a base?

Manaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā āyatanā na mano, āyatanā. Manañca āyatanañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva mano na ca āyatanā.

Except for the mind, the remaining bases are not mind, but they are bases. Except for the mind and the base, the remaining things are neither mind nor bases.

(Kha) nāyatanā na manāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases not the mind-base? Yes.

(Ka) na dhammo nāyatananti? Āmantā.

Is what is not a dhamma not a base? Yes.

(Kha) nāyatanā na dhammāyatananti? Āmantā.

Are what are not bases not the dhamma-base? Yes.
