2. Pavattivāro 1. uppādavāro

2. Section on Occurrence. 1. Section on Arising.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) Present Occasion

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Person in Direct Order

18. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

18. (Ka) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them is the ear-base arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati[V 1.0125], no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0082] tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati sotāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with the eye-base but without the ear-base, for them the eye-base is arising, but the ear-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with both the eye-base and the ear-base, for them both the eye-base is arising and the ear-base is arising.

(Kha) yassa [T 1.0098] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever the ear-base is arising, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sasotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sasotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with the ear-base but without the eye-base, for them the ear-base is arising, but the eye-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with both the ear-base and the eye-base, for them both the ear-base is arising and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them is the nose-base arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with the eye-base but without the nose-base, for them the eye-base is arising, but the nose-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with both the eye-base and the nose-base, for them both the eye-base is arising and the nose-base is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them is the eye-base arising?

Saghānakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with the nose-base but without the eye-base, for them the nose-base is arising, but the eye-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with both the nose-base and the eye-base, for them both the nose-base is arising and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them is the form-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sarūpakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with form but without the eye-base, for them the form-base is arising, but the eye-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the eye-base, for them both the form-base is arising and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them is the mind-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base is arising, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sacittakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati[T 1.0099][V 1.0126], no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with mind but without the eye-base, for them the mind-base is arising, but the eye-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the eye-base, for them both the mind-base is arising and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the dhamma-base is arising, for them is the eye-base arising?

Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn without the eye-base, for them the dhamma-base is arising, but the eye-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the eye-base, for them both the dhamma-base is arising and the eye-base is arising. (Eye-base Root)

19. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

19. For whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them is the form-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti[M 1.0083]?

Or again, for whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them is the nose-base arising?

Sarūpakānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with form but without the nose-base, for them the form-base is arising, but the nose-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the nose-base, for them both the form-base is arising and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them is the mind-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base is arising, for them is the nose-base arising?

Sacittakānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with consciousness but without the nose-base, for them the mind-base is arising, but the nose-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the nose-base, for them both the mind-base is arising and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the dhamma-base is arising, for them is the nose-base arising?

Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no [T 1.0100] ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn without the nose-base, for them the dhamma-base is arising, but the nose-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with the nose-base, for them both the dhamma-base is arising and the nose-base is arising. (Nose-base Root)

20. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0127] rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

20. For whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them is the mind-base arising?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn without consciousness, for them the form-base is arising, but the mind-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with form and with consciousness, for them both the form-base is arising and the mind-base is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base is arising, for them is the form-base arising?

Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn without form, for them the mind-base is arising, but the form-base is not arising. For those who are being reborn with mind and with form, for them both the mind-base is arising and the form-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the dhamma-base is arising, for them is the form-base arising?

Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn in the formless planes, the dhamma-base is arising for them, but the form-base is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with form, both the dhamma-base and the form-base are arising for them. (The section rooted in the form-base.)

21. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

21. For one for whom the mind-base is arising, for that one is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the dhamma-base is arising, for that one is the mind-base arising?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca [M 1.0084] tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn without mind, the dhamma-base is arising for them, but the mind-base is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with mind, both the dhamma-base and the mind-base are arising for them. (The section rooted in the mind-base.)

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Direct Order: Plane Section

22. (Ka) yattha [T 1.0101] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

22. In whichever plane the eye-base is arising, in that plane is the ear-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, in whichever plane the ear-base is arising, in that plane is the eye-base arising? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

In whichever plane the eye-base is arising, in that plane is the nose-base arising?

Rūpāvacare tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati[V 1.0128]. Kāmāvacare tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the form plane, the eye-base is arising there, but the nose-base is not arising there. In the sense-sphere plane, both the eye-base and the nose-base are arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, in whichever plane the nose-base is arising, in that plane is the eye-base arising? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

In whichever plane the eye-base is arising, in that plane is the form-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, in whichever plane the form-base is arising, in that plane is the eye-base arising?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the non-percipient realm, the form-base is arising there, but the eye-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm, both the form-base and the eye-base are arising there.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

In whichever plane the eye-base is arising, in that plane is the mind-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, in whichever plane the mind-base is arising, in that plane is the eye-base arising?

Arūpe tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha manāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the formless realm, the mind-base is arising there, but the eye-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm, both the mind-base and the eye-base are arising there.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

In whichever plane the eye-base is arising, in that plane is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti[T 1.0102]?

Or again, in whichever plane the dhamma-base is arising, in that plane is the eye-base arising?

Asaññasatte arūpe tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

In the non-percipient realm and the formless realm, the dhamma-base is arising there, but the eye-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm, both the dhamma-base and the eye-base are arising there. (The section rooted in the eye-base.)

23. (Ka) yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

23. In whichever plane the nose-base is arising, in that plane is the form-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, in whichever plane the form-base is arising, in that plane is the nose-base arising?

Rūpāvacare tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Kāmāvacare tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the form realm, the form-base is arising there, but the nose-base is not arising there. In the sense-sphere realm, both the form-base and the nose-base are arising there.

(Yattha [M 1.0085] ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ dhammāyatanañca ekasadisaṃ, nānaṃ natthi, upari pana vārasaṅkhepo uparivāre saṅkhepo (syā.), uparivāre saṅkhepaṃ (sī. ka.) tīti jānitabbaṃ.)

(It should be known that where the nose-base arises, there the mind-base and the dhamma-base are the same; there is no difference. And in the following section, there will be an abbreviation.)

(Ka) yattha [V 1.0129] ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

In whichever plane the nose-base is arising, in that plane is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, in whichever plane the dhamma-base is arising, in that plane is the nose-base arising?

Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Kāmāvacare tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

In the form realm and the formless realm, the dhamma-base is arising there, but the nose-base is not arising there. In the sense-sphere, both the dhamma-base and the nose-base are arising there. (The section rooted in the nose-base.)

24. (Ka) yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

24. (Ka) In whichever plane the form-base is arising, in that plane is the mind-base arising?

Asaññasatte tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the non-percipient realm, the form-base is arising there, but the mind-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm, both the form-base and the mind-base are arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, in whichever plane the mind-base is arising, in that plane is the form-base arising?

Arūpe tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha [T 1.0103] rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha manāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

In the formless realm, the mind-base is arising there, but the form-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm, both the mind-base and the form-base are arising there.

(Ka) yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) In whichever plane the form-base is arising, in that plane is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, in whichever plane the dhamma-base is arising, in that plane is the form-base arising?

Arūpe tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre asaññasatte tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

In the formless realm, the dhamma-base is arising there, but the form-base is not arising there. In the five-constituent realm and the non-percipient realm, both the dhamma-base and the form-base are arising there. (The section rooted in the form-base.)

25. (Ka) yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

25. (Ka) In whichever plane the mind-base is arising, in that plane is the dhamma-base arising? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, in whichever plane the dhamma-base is arising, in that plane is the mind-base arising?

Asaññasatte tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

In the non-percipient realm, the dhamma-base is arising there, but the mind-base is not arising there. In the four-constituent realm and the five-constituent realm, both the dhamma-base and the mind-base are arising there. (The section rooted in the mind-base.)

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Direct Order: Individuals and Planes

26. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0130] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

26. (Ka) For whichever person in whichever realm the eye-base is arising, for that person in that realm is the ear-base arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ [M 1.0086] sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati sotāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are arising with the eye-base but without the ear-base, for them the eye-base arises there, but the ear-base does not arise there. For those who are arising with the eye-base and with the ear-base, for them both the eye-base and the ear-base arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the ear-base arises, for them does the eye-base arise there?

Sasotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sasotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0104] sotāyatanañca uppajjati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati (saṃkhittaṃ yassakasadisaṃ yassakampi sadisaṃ (sī.), yassekasadisaṃ (syā.) ).

For those who are arising with the ear-base but without the eye-base, for them the ear-base arises there, but the eye-base does not arise there. For those who are arising with the ear-base and with the eye-base, for them both the ear-base and the eye-base arise there. (Abbreviated, similar to the section on individuals.)

27. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

27. (Ka) For whom, where the mind-base arises, for them does the dhamma-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the dhamma-base arises, for them does the mind-base arise there?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are arising without mind, for them the dhamma-base arises there, but the mind-base does not arise there. For those who are arising with mind, for them both the dhamma-base and the mind-base arise there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individuals

28. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

28. (Ka) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them does the ear-base not arise?

Acakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the eye-base but with the ear-base, for them the eye-base does not arise, but the ear-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the eye-base and without the ear-base, for them both the eye-base and the ear-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0131] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the ear-base does not arise, for them does the eye-base not arise?

Asotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ asotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nuppajjati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the ear-base but with the eye-base, for them the ear-base does not arise, but the eye-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the ear-base and without the eye-base, for them both the ear-base and the eye-base do not arise.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them does the nose-base not arise?

Acakkhukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0105] aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the eye-base but with the nose-base, for them the eye-base does not arise, but the nose-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the eye-base and without the nose-base, for them both the eye-base and the nose-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the nose-base does not arise, for them does the eye-base not arise?

Aghānakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca [M 1.0087] tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the nose-base but with the eye-base, for them the nose-base does not arise, but the eye-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the nose-base and without the eye-base, for them both the nose-base and the eye-base do not arise.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them does the form-base not arise?

Acakkhukānaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the eye-base but with the form-base, for them the eye-base does not arise, but the form-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the form-base, for them both the eye-base and the form-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the form-base does not arise, for them does the eye-base not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them does the mind-base not arise?

Acakkhukānaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the eye-base but with mind, for them the eye-base does not arise, but the mind-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without mind, for them both the eye-base and the mind-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0132] vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the mind-base does not arise, for them does the eye-base not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them does the dhamma-base not arise?

Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca [T 1.0106] tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the eye-base, for them the eye-base does not arise, but the dhamma-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, for them both the eye-base and the dhamma-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whom the dhamma-base does not arise, for them does the eye-base not arise? Yes. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

29. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

29. (Ka) For whom the nose-base does not arise, for them does the form-base not arise?

Aghānakānaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the nose-base but with the form-base, for them the nose-base does not arise, but the form-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without the form-base, for them both the nose-base and the form-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the form-base does not arise, for them does the nose-base not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the nose-base does not arise, for them does the mind-base not arise?

Aghānakānaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the nose-base but with mind, for them the nose-base does not arise, but the mind-base arises for them. For all who are passing away, and for those who are arising without mind, for them both the nose-base and the mind-base do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the mind-base does not arise, for them does the nose-base not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them is the mental-phenomena-base not arising?

Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati[M 1.0088]. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are arising without the nose-faculty, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the mental-phenomena-base does not fail to arise. For all who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the mental-phenomena-base is not arising.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0133] vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whom the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, for them is the nose-base not arising? Yes. (Nose-Base Section)

30. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0107] rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

30. (Ka) For whom the form-base is not arising, for them is the mind-base not arising?

Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those arising in the formless realms, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the mind-base does not fail to arise. For all those passing away, for them both the form-base and the mind-base are not arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the mind-base is not arising, for them is the form-base not arising?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those arising without consciousness, for them the mind-base is not arising, but for them the form-base does not fail to arise. For all those passing away, for them both the mind-base and the form-base are not arising.

(Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whom the form-base is not arising, for them is the mental-phenomena-base not arising?

Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those arising in the formless realms, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the mental-phenomena-base does not fail to arise. For all those passing away, for them both the form-base and the mental-phenomena-base are not arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whom the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, for them is the form-base not arising? Yes. (Form-Base Section)

31. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

31. (Ka) For whom the mind-base is not arising, for them is the mental-phenomena-base not arising?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those arising without consciousness, for them the mind-base is not arising, but for them the mental-phenomena-base does not fail to arise. For all those passing away, for them both the mind-base and the mental-phenomena-base are not arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whom the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, for them is the mind-base not arising? Yes. (Mind-Base Section)

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Location Section

32. (Ka) yattha [V 1.0134] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

32. (Ka) Where the eye-base is not arising, is the ear-base not arising there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or where the ear-base is not arising, is the eye-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha [T 1.0108] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Where the eye-base is not arising, is the nose-base not arising there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or where the nose-base is not arising, is the eye-base not arising there?

Rūpāvacare tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Asaññasatte arūpe tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

In the form realm, the nose-base is not arising there, but the eye-base does not fail to arise there. In the non-percipient realm and in the formless realm, both the nose-base and the eye-base are not arising there.

(Ka) yattha [M 1.0089] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) Where the eye-base is not arising, is the form-base not arising there?

Asaññasatte tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Arūpe tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

In the non-percipient realm, the eye-base is not arising there, but the form-base does not fail to arise there. In the formless realm, both the eye-base and the form-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or where the form-base is not arising, is the eye-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) Where the eye-base is not arising, is the mind-base not arising there?

Arūpe tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Asaññasatte tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

In the formless realm, the eye-base is not arising there, but the mind-base does not fail to arise there. In the non-percipient realm, both the eye-base and the mind-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or where the mind-base is not arising, is the eye-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(Ka) Where the eye-base is not arising, is the mental-phenomena-base not arising there? It arises.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or where the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, is the eye-base not arising there? There is not. (Eye-Base Section)

33. (Ka) yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

33. (Ka) Where the nose-base is not arising, is the form-base not arising there?

Rūpāvacare tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati[T 1.0109]. Arūpe tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

In the form realm, the nose-base is not arising there, but the form-base does not fail to arise there. In the formless realm, both the nose-base and the form-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or where the form-base is not arising, is the nose-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha [V 1.0135] ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) Where the nose-base is not arising, is the mind-base not arising there?

Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Asaññasatte tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

In the form realm and the formless realm, the nose-base is not arising there, but the mind-base does not fail to arise there. In the non-percipient realm, both the nose-base and the mind-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or where the mind-base is not arising, is the nose-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(Ka) Where the nose-base is not arising, is the mental-phenomena-base not arising there? It arises.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or where the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, is the nose-base not arising there? There is not. (Nose-Base Section)

34. (Ka) yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

34. (Ka) Where the form-base is not arising, is the mind-base not arising there? It arises.

(Kha) yattha vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(Kha) Or where the mind-base is not arising, is the form-base not arising there? It arises.

(Ka) yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(Ka) Where the form-base is not arising, is the mental-phenomena-base not arising there? It arises.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or where the mental-phenomena-base is not arising, is the form-base not arising there? There is not. (Form-Base Section)

35. (Ka) yattha [M 1.0090] manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

35. (a) Where the mind-base is not arising, is the dhamma-base not arising there? It is arising.

(Kha) yattha vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or where the dhamma-base is not arising, is the mind-base not arising there? There is not. (The Mind-Base Section)

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(c) Negative: Person and Plane

36. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0110] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

36. (a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not arising, for them, is the ear-base not arising there?

Acakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are eyeless and possessed of the ear-base who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising there, but the ear-base is arising for them there. For all who are passing away, and for those who are eyeless and without the ear-base who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base and the ear-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0136] vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the ear-base is not arising, for them, is the eye-base not arising there?

Asotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ asotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nuppajjati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati…pe….

For those who are without the ear-base and possessed of the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the ear-base is not arising there, but the eye-base is arising for them there. For all who are passing away, and for those who are without the ear-base and eyeless who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base and the eye-base are not arising there... and so on.

37. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

37. (a) For whomever, wherever the mind-base is not arising, for them, is the dhamma-base not arising there?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are mindless who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not arising there, but the dhamma-base is arising for them there. For all who are passing away, for them both the mind-base and the dhamma-base are not arising there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base is not arising, for them, is the mind-base not arising there? Yes.

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Past Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

38. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

38. (a) For whomever the eye-base arose, for them, did the ear-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or, for whomever the ear-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise? Yes.

Yassa [T 1.0111] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever the eye-base arose, for them, did the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base... the dhamma-base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or, for whomever the dhamma-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise? Yes.

39. Yassa [V 1.0137][M 1.0091] ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

39. For whomever the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base arose, for them, did the dhamma-base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or, for whomever the dhamma-base arose, for them, did the mind-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: Plane

40. (Ka) yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha…pe… (yatthakaṃ paccuppannepi atītepi anāgatepi paccuppannātītepi paccuppannānāgatepi atītānāgatepi sabbattha sadisaṃ, uppajjati uppajjitthāti nāmaṃ atirekaṃ kātabbaṃ).

40. (a) Wherever the eye-base arose... and so on... (The section on the plane is the same everywhere: in the present, past, future, present-past, present-future, and past-future. The terms 'is arising' and 'arose' should be applied additionally.)

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

41. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

41. (a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base arose, for them, did the ear-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the ear-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base arose, for them, did the nose-base arise there?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those in the fine-material sphere, the eye-base arose for them there, but the nose-base did not arise for them there. For those in the sense-sphere, both the eye-base and the nose-base arose for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the nose-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0112] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base arose, for them, did the form-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the form-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise there?

Asaññasattānaṃ [V 1.0138] tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For non-percipient beings, the form-base arose for them there, but the eye-base did not arise for them there. For beings in the five-constituent planes, both the form-base and the eye-base arose for them there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base arose, for them, did the mind-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the mind-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise there?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those in the formless planes, the mind-base arose for them there, but the eye-base did not arise for them there. For beings in the five-constituent planes, both the mind-base and the eye-base arose for them there.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0092] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever, wherever the eye-base arose, for them, did the dhamma-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base arose, for them, did the eye-base arise there?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless planes, the dhamma-base arose for them there, but the eye-base did not arise for them there. For beings in the five-constituent planes, both the dhamma-base and the eye-base arose for them there. (The Eye-Base Section)

42. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

42. (a) For whomever, wherever the nose-base arose, for them, did the form-base arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha [T 1.0113] tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or, for whomever, wherever the form-base arose, for them, did the nose-base arise there?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those of the form realm, the form-sphere has arisen for them there, but the nose-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the sense-sphere, both the form-sphere and the nose-sphere have arisen for them there.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0139] yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever, in whichever realm, the nose-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the mind-sphere arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the mind-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the nose-sphere arisen?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those of the form realm and the formless realm, the mind-sphere has arisen for them there, but the nose-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the sense-sphere, both the mind-sphere and the nose-sphere have arisen for them there.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever, in whichever realm, the nose-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the dhamma-sphere arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the dhamma-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the nose-sphere arisen?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those of the form realm and the formless realm, the dhamma-sphere has arisen for them there, but the nose-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the sense-sphere, both the dhamma-sphere and the nose-sphere have arisen for them there. (The section rooted in the nose-sphere)

43. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

43. For whomever, in whichever realm, the form-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the mind-sphere arisen?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For non-percipient beings, the form-sphere has arisen for them there, but the mind-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the five-constituent existence, both the form-sphere and the mind-sphere have arisen for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā [T 1.0114] pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the mind-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the form-sphere arisen?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those of the formless realm, the mind-sphere has arisen for them there, but the form-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the five-constituent existence, both the mind-sphere and the form-sphere have arisen for them there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever, in whichever realm, the form-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the dhamma-sphere arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti[M 1.0093]?

Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the dhamma-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the form-sphere arisen?

Arūpānaṃ [V 1.0140] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittharūpāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ).

For those of the formless realm, the dhamma-sphere has arisen for them there, but the form-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the five-constituent existence and non-percipient beings, both the dhamma-sphere and the form-sphere have arisen for them there. (The section rooted in the form-sphere).

44. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

44. For whomever, in whichever realm, the mind-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the dhamma-sphere arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the dhamma-sphere has arisen, for them, in that realm, has the mind-sphere arisen?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For non-percipient beings, the dhamma-sphere has arisen for them there, but the mind-sphere has not arisen for them there. For those of the four-constituent existence and the five-constituent existence, both the dhamma-sphere and the mind-sphere have arisen for them there. (The section rooted in the mind-sphere).

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For non-percipient beings and for those of the formless realms, for them, the eye-base had not arisen there, but for them, the dhamma-base had arisen there. For those of the Pure Abodes, for them, both the eye-base had not arisen there and the dhamma-base had not arisen there.

(Ka) Forward Order (Individual)

52. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

52. (Ka) For whichever person the eye-base will arise, for that person will the ear-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person the ear-base will arise, for that person will the eye-base arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person the eye-base will arise, for that person will the nose-base arise?

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati [M 1.0096] ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those who, having been reborn in the form realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the eye-base will arise, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For the others, for them both the eye-base will arise and the nose-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person the nose-base will arise, for that person will the eye-base arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0144] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whichever person the eye-base will arise, for that person will the form-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ [T 1.0119] uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person the form-base will arise, for that person will the eye-base arise? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati (tassa manāyatanañca dhammāyatanañca sadisaṃ, ime dve sadisāyeva honti).

For whichever person the eye-base will arise (for that person the mind-base and the dhamma-base are similar; these two are indeed similar).

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whichever person the eye-base will arise, for that person will the dhamma-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person the dhamma-base will arise, for that person will the eye-base arise?

Ye arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, the mind-object base will arise, but the eye-base will not arise for them. For the remaining ones, both the mind-object base and the eye-base will arise. (Rooted in the eye-base)

53. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

53. (Ka) For whom the nose-base will arise, will the form-base arise for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Conversely, for whom the form-base will arise, will the nose-base arise for them?

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those who, having arisen in the Form Realm, will attain final Nibbāna, the form-base will arise, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For the remaining ones, both the form-base and the nose-base will arise.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the nose-base will arise, will the mind-base… and the mind-object base arise for them? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Conversely, for whom the mind-object base will arise, will the nose-base arise for them?

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca [T 1.0120] uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who, having arisen in the Form Realm or the Formless Realm, will attain final Nibbāna, the mind-object base will arise, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For the remaining ones, both the mind-object base and the nose-base will arise. (Rooted in the nose-base)

54. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

54. For whom the form-base will arise, will the mind-base… and the mind-object base arise for them? Yes.

Yassa [V 1.0145] vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Conversely, for whom the mind-object base will arise, will the form-base arise for them?

Ye arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ).

For those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, the mind-object base will arise, but the form-base will not arise for them. For the remaining ones, both the mind-object base and the form-base will arise. (Rooted in the form-base)

55. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0097] manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

55. (Ka) For whom the mind-base will arise, will the mind-object base arise for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Conversely, for whom the mind-object base will arise, will the mind-base arise for them? Yes. (Rooted in the mind-base)

(Kha) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever plane the mind-base will arise, for them in that plane will the eye-base arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those of the immaterial sphere, for them the mind-base will arise in that plane, but the eye-base will not arise for them in that plane. For beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-base and the eye-base will arise in that plane.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever in whatsoever plane the eye-base will arise, for them in that plane will the mind-object base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa [M 1.0098] tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever plane the mind-object base will arise, for them in that plane will the eye-base arise?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For non-percipient beings and formless beings, for them the mind-object base will arise in those planes, but the eye-base will not arise for them in those planes. For beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-object base and the eye-base will arise in that plane. (Rooted in the eye-base)

58. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

58. (Ka) For whomever in whatsoever plane the nose-base will arise, for them in that plane will the form-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati [T 1.0122] tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever plane the form-base will arise, for them in that plane will the nose-base arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ [V 1.0147] tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those of the fine-material sphere, for them the form-base will arise in that plane, but the nose-base will not arise for them in that plane. For those of the sense-sphere, for them both the form-base and the nose-base will arise in that plane.

Yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever in whatsoever plane the nose-base will arise, for them in that plane will the mind-base… and the mind-object base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever plane the mind-object base will arise, for them in that plane will the nose-base arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but the nose-base will not arise for them there. For those of the sense-sphere, for them both the dhamma-base and the nose-base will arise there. (The Nose-Base Section)

59. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them the form-base will arise there, but the mind-base will not arise for them there. For those of the five-constituent planes, for them both the form-base and the mind-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base will arise, for them will the form-base arise there?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever, wherever the form-base will arise, for them will the dhamma-base arise there? Yes.

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those of the formless planes, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but the form-base will not arise for them there. For those of the five-constituent planes and for non-percipient beings, for them both the dhamma-base and the form-base will arise there. (The Form-Base Section)

60. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0148][M 1.0099] yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will arise, for them will the mind-base arise there?

For non-percipient beings, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but the mind-base will not arise for them there. For those of the four-constituent planes and for those of the five-constituent planes, for them both the dhamma-base and the mind-base will arise there. (The Mind-Base Section)

61. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

61. Or again, for whomever the ear-base will not arise, for them will the eye-base not arise? Yes.

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain parinibbāna, for them the nose-base will not arise, but the eye-base will arise for them. For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain parinibbāna, for them both the nose-base and the eye-base will not arise.

Ye arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain parinibbāna, for them the eye-base will not arise, but the dhamma-base will arise for them. For those in their final existence, both the eye-base and the dhamma-base will not arise for them.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will not arise, for them will the eye-base not arise? Yes. (The Eye-Base Section)
