For non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not arise for them in that plane, but it is not the case that the form-base will not arise for them in that plane. For those in their final existence, for them both the mind-base and the form-base will not arise in that plane.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whomsoever in a certain plane the form-base will not arise, for them will the dhamma-base not arise in that plane?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those of the formless realm, the form-base will not arise for them there, but it is not that the mental-phenomena-base will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence, both the form-base will not arise for them there and the mental-phenomena-base will not arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or again, for whomsoever in a certain realm the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, for them will the form-base not arise there? Yes. (The section rooted in the form-base)

69. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

69. (a) For whomsoever in a certain realm the mind-base will not arise, for them will the mental-phenomena-base not arise there?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not arise for them there, but it is not that the mental-phenomena-base will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence, both the mind-base will not arise for them there and the mental-phenomena-base will not arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or again, for whomsoever in a certain realm the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, for them will the mind-base not arise there? Yes. (The section rooted in the mind-base)

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Order: The Individual

70. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

70. (a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them did the ear-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti[M 1.0103]?

(b) Or again, for whomsoever the ear-base arose, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha[V 1.0154], no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0129] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all those who are passing away, and for those without attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them the ear-base arose, but for them the eye-base is not arising. For those with attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base arose and the eye-base is arising.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them did the nose-base… the form-base… the mind-base… the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mental-phenomena-base arose, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them the mental-phenomena-base arose, but for them the eye-base is not arising. For those with attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them both the mental-phenomena-base arose and the eye-base is arising. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

71. Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

71. For whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them did the form-base… the mind-base… the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mental-phenomena-base arose, for them is the nose-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without an attainable nose who are being reborn, for them the mental-phenomena-base arose, but for them the nose-base is not arising. For those with an attainable nose who are being reborn, for them both the mental-phenomena-base arose and the nose-base is arising. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

72. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

72. For whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them did the mind-base… the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the mental-phenomena-base arose, for them is the form-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without attainable form who are being reborn, for them the mental-phenomena-base arose, but for them the form-base is not arising. For those with attainable form who are being reborn, for them both the mental-phenomena-base arose and the form-base is arising. (The section rooted in the form-base)

73. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0130] manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

73. (a) For whomsoever the mind-base is arising, for them did the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whomsoever the mental-phenomena-base arose, for them is the mind-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [V 1.0155] tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca uppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without mind who are being reborn, for them the mental-phenomena-base arose, but for them the mind-base is not arising. For those with mind who are being reborn, for them both the mental-phenomena-base arose and the mind-base is arising. (The section rooted in the mind-base)

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Direct Order: Place

74. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.…Pe….

74. Where the eye-base is arising, did the ear-base arise there? Yes.…Pe….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Direct Order: Individual and Place

75. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0104] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

75. (a) For whomsoever in a certain realm the eye-base is arising, for them did the ear-base arise there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati sotāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is arising there, but for them the ear-base did not arise there. For the others with attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the ear-base arose there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whomsoever in a certain realm the ear-base arose, for them is the eye-base arising there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for those without attainable eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them the ear-base arose there, but for them the eye-base is not arising there. For those with attainable eyes who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base arose there and the eye-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(a) For whomsoever in a certain realm the eye-base is arising, for them did the nose-base arise there?

Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ [T 1.0131] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the form-sphere, for them the eye-base is arising there, but for them the nose-base did not arise there. For those with attainable eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the nose-base arose there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0156] vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whomsoever in a certain realm the nose-base arose, for them is the eye-base arising there?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere plane, and for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them the nose-base has arisen there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them both the nose-base has arisen there and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

For whichever person the eye-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the form-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no [M 1.0105] ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0132] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is arising there, but the form-base has not arisen for them there. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the form-base has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the form-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the eye-base arising there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca ca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent plane, for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them the form-base has arisen there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the form-base has arisen there and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

For whichever person the eye-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the mind-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is arising there, but the mind-base has not arisen for them there. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the mind-base has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the mind-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the eye-base arising there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere existence, and for those in the formless existence, for them the mind-base has arisen there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base has arisen there and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0157] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

For whichever person the eye-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the dhamma-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is arising there, but the dhamma-base has not arisen for them there. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the dhamma-base has arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the dhamma-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the eye-base arising there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base has arisen there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base has arisen there and the eye-base is arising. (The Eye-Base Section)

76. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

76. For whichever person the nose-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the form-base arisen there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the form-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the nose-base arising there?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0133] rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those without a potential nose who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those in the form-sphere, for them the form-base has arisen there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with a potential nose who are being reborn, for them both the form-base has arisen there and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whichever person the nose-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the mind-base arisen there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the mind-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the nose-base arising there?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those without a potential nose who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for those in the form-sphere realm, and for those in the formless-sphere realm, for them the mind-base has arisen there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with a potential nose who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base has arisen there and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whichever person the nose-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the dhamma-base arisen there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0158] vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ [M 1.0106] uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the dhamma-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the nose-base arising there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without a potential nose who are being reborn, the dhamma-base has arisen for them there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with a potential nose who are being reborn, both the dhamma-base has arisen for them there and the nose-base is arising. (Rooted in the nose-base)

77. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

77. For whichever person the form-base is arising in whatsoever plane, for that person has the mind-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha[T 1.0134]. Itaresaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, for them the form-base is arising there, but the mind-base has not arisen for them there. For the others who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them both the form-base is arising there and the mind-base has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whichever person the mind-base has arisen in whatsoever plane, for that person is the form-base arising there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for formless beings being reborn, for them the mind-base has arisen there, but the form-base is not arising for them there. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-base has arisen there and the form-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom the form-base is arising in some realm, for them has the dhamma-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa realms, the form-base is arising for them there, but the dhamma-base has not arisen for them there. For the other beings with form who are being reborn, both the form-base is arising for them there and the dhamma-base has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the dhamma-base has arisen in some realm, for them does the form-base arise there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those passing away, and for formless beings being reborn, the dhamma-base has arisen for them there, but the form-base does not arise for them there. For beings with form who are being reborn, both the dhamma-base has arisen for them there and the form-base arises. (Rooted in the form-base)

78. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0159] yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

78. (Ka) For whom the mind-base arises in some realm, for them has the dhamma-base arisen there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa realms, the mind-base arises for them there, but the dhamma-base has not arisen for them there. For the other conscious beings who are being reborn, both the mind-base arises for them there and the dhamma-base has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa [T 1.0135] tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the dhamma-base has arisen in some realm, for them does the mind-base arise there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca uppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those passing away, and for unconscious beings being reborn, the dhamma-base has arisen for them there, but the mind-base does not arise for them there. For conscious beings who are being reborn, both the dhamma-base has arisen for them there and the mind-base arises. (Rooted in the mind-base)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative: The Individual

79. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0107] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

79. (Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them has the ear-base not arisen? It has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or, for whom the ear-base has not arisen, for them is the eye-base not arising? There is none.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them has the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base... the dhamma-base not arisen? It has arisen.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

Or, for whom the dhamma-base has not arisen, for them is the eye-base not arising? There is none.

80. Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

80. For whom the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base is not arising, for them has the dhamma-base not arisen? It has arisen.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

Or, for whom the dhamma-base has not arisen, for them is the mind-base not arising? There is none.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative: The Realm

81. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

81. Where the eye-base is not arising…etc.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: The Individual and the Realm

82. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0160] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

82. (Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising in some realm, for them has the ear-base not arisen there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for them the eye-base is not arising there, but the ear-base has arisen for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them both the eye-base is not arising there and the ear-base has not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ [T 1.0136] nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the ear-base has not arisen in some realm, for them is the eye-base not arising there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nuppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the ear-base has not arisen there, but the eye-base is arising for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them both the ear-base has not arisen there and the eye-base is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising in some realm, for them has the nose-base not arisen there?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for those without eyes being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for them the eye-base is not arising there, but the nose-base has arisen for them there. For those passing away from the form-sphere realm, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them both the eye-base is not arising there and the nose-base has not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the nose-base has not arisen in some realm, for them is the eye-base not arising there?

Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0108] tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the form-sphere, for them the nose-base has not arisen there, but the eye-base is arising for them there. For those passing away from the form-sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them both the nose-base has not arisen there and the eye-base is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising in some realm, for them has the form-base not arisen there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [V 1.0161] tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without eyes being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them the eye-base is not arising there, but the form-base has arisen for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them both the eye-base is not arising there and the form-base has not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ [T 1.0137] nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the form-base has not arisen in some realm, for them is the eye-base not arising there?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, the form-base had not arisen there, but for them, the eye-base is arising there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, both the form-base had not arisen there and the eye-base is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For whom, where the eye-base is not arising, for them, there, had the mind-base not arisen?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them, the eye-base is not arising there, but for them, the mind-base had arisen there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the eye-base is not arising there and the mind-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the mind-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the eye-base not arising?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, the mind-base had not arisen there, but for them, the eye-base is arising there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the mind-base had not arisen there and the eye-base is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For whom, where the eye-base is not arising, for them, there, had the dhamma-base not arisen?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For all who are ceasing and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them, the eye-base is not arising there, but for them, the dhamma-base had arisen there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, both the eye-base is not arising there and the dhamma-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the dhamma-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the eye-base not arising?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0138] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, the dhamma-base had not arisen there, but for them, the eye-base is arising there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, both the dhamma-base had not arisen there and the eye-base is not arising there. (The Eye-Base Section)

83. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0162][M 1.0109] yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

83. For whom, where the nose-base is not arising, for them, there, had the form-base not arisen?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those ceasing from the sense-sphere, for those without a nose who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the form-sphere, for them, the nose-base is not arising there, but for them, the form-base had arisen there. For those of the Pure Abodes and for those of the formless realms, for them, both the nose-base is not arising there and the form-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom, where the form-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the nose-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For whom, where the nose-base is not arising, for them, there, had the mind-base not arisen?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those without a nose being reborn into the sense-sphere, for beings of the form-sphere, and for beings of the formless-sphere, for them, the nose-base is not arising there, but for them, the mind-base had arisen there. For beings of the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the nose-base is not arising there and the mind-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom, where the mind-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the nose-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For whom, where the nose-base is not arising, for them, there, had the dhamma-base not arisen?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ [T 1.0139] tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For all who are passing away, and for those without a nose who are being reborn, for them, the nose-base is not arising there, but for them, the dhamma-base had arisen there. For beings of the Pure Abodes, for them, both the nose-base is not arising there and the dhamma-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom, where the dhamma-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the nose-base not arising? Yes. (The Nose-Base Section)

84. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

84. For whom, where the form-base is not arising, for them, there, had the mind-base not arisen?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them, the form-base is not arising there, but for them, the mind-base had arisen there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them, both the form-base is not arising there and the mind-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0163] vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the mind-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the form-base not arising?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjittha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn in the non-percipient plane, for them, the mind-base had not arisen there, but for them, the form-base is arising there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them, both the mind-base had not arisen there and the form-base is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For whom, where the form-base is not arising, for them, there, had the dhamma-base not arisen?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ [M 1.0110] tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For all who are passing away and for formless beings who are being reborn, for them, the form-base is not arising there, but for them, the dhamma-base had arisen there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, both the form-base is not arising there and the dhamma-base had not arisen there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the dhamma-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the form-base not arising?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse [T 1.0140] parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, the dhamma-base had not arisen, but the form-base is arising for them there. For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the dhamma-base had not arisen and the form-base is not arising. (The section rooted in the form-base)

85. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

85. (Ka) For whom, wherever the mind-base is not arising, for them, there, had the dhamma-base not arisen?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For all who are passing away and for those without consciousness who are being reborn, for them, there, the mind-base is not arising, but for them, there, the dhamma-base had arisen. For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the mind-base is not arising and the dhamma-base had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom, wherever the dhamma-base had not arisen, for them, there, is the mind-base not arising?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [V 1.0164] dhammāyatanañca nuppajjittha manāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, the dhamma-base had not arisen, but the mind-base is arising for them there. For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the dhamma-base had not arisen and the mind-base is not arising. (The section rooted in the mind-base)

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) The Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Order (Individual)

86. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is arising, for them, will the ear-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati sotāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna—for them, who are being reborn, the eye-base is arising, but the ear-base will not arise for them. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising and the ear-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

86. (Kha) Or again, for whom the ear-base will arise, for them, is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0141] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the ear-base will arise, but the eye-base is not arising for them. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base will arise and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is arising, for them, will the nose-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial sphere, will attain parinibbāna—for them, who are being reborn, the eye-base is arising, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising and the nose-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the nose-base will arise, for them, is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ [M 1.0111] cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati[V 1.0165], no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the nose-base will arise, but the eye-base is not arising for them. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base will arise and the eye-base is arising.

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

87. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā [T 1.0143] parinibbāyissanti [M 1.0112] tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For the other beings with a nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is arising and the form-base will arise.

For all who are passing away, and for those without a nose-base who are being reborn, for them the form-base will arise, but for them the nose-base is not arising. For those with a nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the form-base will arise and the nose-base is arising.

(a) For whom the nose-base is arising, for them will the mind-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base is arising, but for them the mind-base will not arise. For the other beings with a nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is arising and the mind-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

88. (Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

88. (a) For whom the form-base is arising, for them will the mind-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

(Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

(b) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will arise, for them is the form-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0145][V 1.0168] tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are passing away, and for the formless who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will arise, but for them the form-base is not arising. For those with form who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will arise and the form-base is arising. (Rooted in the Form-Base)

89. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

89. (a) For whom the mind-base is arising, for them will the dhamma-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjati, dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is arising, but for them the dhamma-base will not arise. For the other beings with mind who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is arising and the dhamma-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will arise, for them is the mind-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away, and for the mindless who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will arise, but for them the mind-base is not arising. For those with mind who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will arise and the mind-base is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: Sphere

90. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati…pe….

90. Where the eye-base is arising… and so on….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: Individual and Sphere

91. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

91. (a) For whom, where the eye-base is arising, for them, there will the ear-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati sotāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, for them, there the eye-base is arising, but for them, there the ear-base will not arise. For the other beings with an eye-base who are being reborn, for them, there both the eye-base is arising and the ear-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom, where the ear-base will arise, for them, there is the eye-base arising?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati[V 1.0169]. Sacakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0146] upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0114] tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-aggregate existence, and for the eyeless who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them in that plane the ear base will arise, but for them in that plane the eye base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the ear base will arise and the eye base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For the person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the nose-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for those being reborn in the form-sphere plane, for them in that plane the eye-base is arising, but for them in that plane the nose-base will not arise. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane both the eye-base is arising and the nose-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for the person for whom the nose-base will arise in a certain plane of existence, is the eye-base arising for that person in that plane of existence?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are passing away from the sense-sphere plane, and for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane the nose-base will arise, but for them in that plane the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane both the nose-base will arise and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For the person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the form-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent plane, for them in that plane the eye-base is arising, but for them in that plane the form-base will not arise. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the eye-base is arising and the form-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

For those who are passing away from the five-constituent plane, for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane the form-base will arise, but for them in that plane the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the form-base will arise and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0170] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For the person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the mind-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the eye-base is arising and the mind-base will arise.

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for formless beings, for them in that plane the mind-base will arise, but for them in that plane the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the mind-base will arise and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0115] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For the person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the dhamma-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate plane, for them in that plane the eye-base is arising, but for them in that plane the dhamma-base will not arise. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the eye-base is arising and the dhamma-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for the person for whom the dhamma-base will arise in a certain plane of existence, is the eye-base arising for that person in that plane of existence?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati[T 1.0148], no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are passing away, and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane the dhamma-base will arise, but for them in that plane the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the dhamma-base will arise and the eye-base is arising. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

92. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

92. For the person for whom the nose-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the form-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati[V 1.0171], no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane the nose-base is arising, but for them in that plane the form-base will not arise. For the other beings possessing a nose who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the nose-base is arising and the form-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for the person for whom the form-base will arise in a certain plane of existence, is the nose-base arising for that person in that plane of existence?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for those without a nose being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for beings of the form-sphere plane, for them in that plane the form-base will arise, but for them in that plane the nose-base is not arising. For those possessing a nose who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the form-base will arise and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For the person for whom the nose-base is arising in a certain plane of existence, will the mind-base arise for that person in that plane of existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane the nose-base is arising, but for them in that plane the mind-base will not arise. For the other beings possessing a nose who are being reborn, for them in that plane both the nose-base is arising and the mind-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for the person for whom the mind-base will arise in a certain plane of existence, is the nose-base arising for that person in that plane of existence?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ [T 1.0149] tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those without the nose-faculty being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for those in the form-sphere realm, and for those in the formless-sphere realm, for them the mind-base will arise there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base will arise there and the nose-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whichever being the nose-base is arising in whichever realm, for that being will the dhamma-base arise in that realm?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ [M 1.0116] saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base is arising for them there, but the mind-object-base will not arise for them there. For others with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is arising there and the mind-object-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0172] vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Alternatively, for a person for whom the mind-object-base will arise in a certain plane, is the nose-base arising for that person there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are passing away, and for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, the mind-object-base will arise for them there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the mind-object-base will arise there and the nose-base is arising there. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

93. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

93. For a person for whom the form-base is arising in a certain plane, will the mind-base arise for them there?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For persons in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, and for persons who are being reborn in the non-percipient existence, the form-base is arising for them there, but the mind-base will not arise for them there. For the other persons who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, for them both the form-base is arising there and the mind-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Alternatively, for a person for whom the mind-base will arise in a certain plane, is the form-base arising for that person there?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati[T 1.0150], no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For persons who are passing away from the five-aggregate existence, and for those in the formless existence, the mind-base will arise for them there, but the form-base is not arising for them there. For persons who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, for them both the mind-base will arise there and the form-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For a person for whom the form-base is arising in a certain plane, will the mind-object-base arise for them there?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, the form-base is arising for them there, but the mind-object-base will not arise for them there. For others possessing form who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is arising there and the mind-object-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whichever person the mind-object-base will arise in whichever existence, for that person is the form-base arising in that existence?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, the mind-object-base will arise for them there, but the form-base is not arising for them there. For those possessing form who are being reborn, for them both the mind-object-base will arise there and the form-base is arising there. (The section rooted in the form-base)

94. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0173] yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

94. For whichever person the mind-base is arising in whichever existence, for that person will the mind-object-base arise in that existence?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjati dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, the mind-base is arising for them there, but the mind-object-base will not arise for them there. For the other persons possessing consciousness who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is arising there and the mind-object-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whichever person the mind-object-base will arise in whichever existence, for that person is the mind-base arising in that existence?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [M 1.0117] dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no [T 1.0151] ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati manāyatanañca uppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are passing away and for those without consciousness who are being reborn, the mind-object-base will arise for them there, but the mind-base is not arising for them there. For those possessing consciousness who are being reborn, for them both the mind-object-base will arise there and the mind-base is arising there. (The section rooted in the mind-base)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Person (Negative)

95. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

95. For whichever person the eye-base is not arising, for that person will the ear-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the ear-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the ear-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or for one for whom the ear-base will not arise, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti [V 1.0174] tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are being reborn, for them the ear-base will not arise, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are passing away, for them both the ear-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For one for whom the eye-base is not arising, for them will the nose-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the nose-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising and the nose-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for one for whom the nose-base will not arise, for that one is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for those who are being reborn, the nose-base will not arise for them, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for those who are passing away, for them the nose-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For one for whom the eye-base is not arising, for that one will the form-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the form-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for those who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati [T 1.0152] tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the form-base will not arise, for that one is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for those who are being reborn, the form-base will not arise for them, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for those who are passing away, for them the form-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For one for whom the eye-base is not arising, for that one will the mind-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no [M 1.0118] ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the mind-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them the eye-base is not arising and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the mind-base will not arise, for that one is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate existence, for them the mind-base will not arise, but the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them the mind-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0175] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti[T 1.0153]?

For one for whom the eye-base is not arising, for that one will the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all those who are passing away and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but the dhamma-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them the eye-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the dhamma-base will not arise, for that one is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate existence, for them the dhamma-base will not arise, but the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them the dhamma-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Eye-Base)

96. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

96. For one for whom the nose-base is not arising, for that one will the form-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ [T 1.0154] rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ [M 1.0119] cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all those who are passing away and for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them the nose-base is not arising, but the form-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material realm and the immaterial realm, and for those who, having been reborn into the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away—for them the nose-base is not arising and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0176] vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the form-base will not arise, for that one is the nose-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn into the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are being reborn, the form-base will not arise for them, but for them the nose-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those who, having been reborn into the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna—for them who are passing away, for them the form-base will not arise and the nose-base is not arising.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For one for whom the nose-base is not arising, for that one will the mind-base... and so on... the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will arise. For those attaining parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their last existence in the form-sphere realm and the formless-sphere realm, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will not arise, for them is the nose-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their last existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere realm, for them the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them the nose-base is arising. For those attaining parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their last existence in the form-sphere realm and the formless-sphere realm, for them both the dhamma-base will not arise and the nose-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Nose-Base)

97. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0155] nuppajjissatīti?

97. For whom the form-base is not arising, for them will the mind-base... the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will arise. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those in their last existence in the formless realm, for them both the form-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.
