Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will not arise, for them is the form-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them the form-base is arising. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those in their last existence in the formless realm, for them both the dhamma-base will not arise and the form-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Form-Base)

98. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0177] manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

98. (a) For whom the mind-base is not arising, for them will the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without consciousness who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will arise. For those who are attaining parinibbāna, for them both the mind-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will not arise, for them is the mind-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ [M 1.0120] nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their last existence who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them the mind-base is arising. For those who are attaining parinibbāna, for them both the dhamma-base will not arise and the mind-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Mind-Base)

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(e) Negative (Plane)

99. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

99. Where the eye-base is not arising...

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative (Individual and Plane)

100. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

100. (a) For whom, where the eye-base is not arising, for them, there, will the ear-base not arise?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0156] tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for the eyeless who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for them, there, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, there, the ear-base will arise. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, there, both the eye-base is not arising and the ear-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom, where the ear-base will not arise, for them, there, is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, the ear-base will not arise, but for them, there, the eye-base is arising. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, there, both the ear-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0178] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whom, where the eye-base is not arising, for them, there, will the nose-base not arise?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for the eyeless who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for them, there, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, there, the nose-base will arise. For those attaining parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those passing away from the form-sphere realm, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, there, both the eye-base is not arising and the nose-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom, where the nose-base will not arise, for them, there, is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere realm and into the form-sphere realm, for them, there, the nose-base will not arise, but for them, there, the eye-base is arising. For those attaining parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those passing away from the form-sphere realm, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, there, both the nose-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0157] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whom, where the eye-base is not arising, for them, there, will the form-base not arise?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca [M 1.0121] nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, for the eyeless who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, there, the form-base will arise. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them, there, both the eye-base is not arising and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom, where the form-base will not arise, for them, there, is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent plane, for them there the form-base will not arise, but for them there the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for those in the formless plane, for them there both the form-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whichever plane the eye-base is not arising, for them there will the mind-base not arise?

Pañcavokārā [V 1.0179] cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent plane, for the eyeless who are being reborn into the sense-sphere plane, and for those in the formless plane, for them there the eye-base is not arising, but for them there the mind-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those in the non-percipient plane, for them there both the eye-base is not arising and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whichever plane the mind-base will not arise, for them there is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati [T 1.0158] cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent plane, for them there the mind-base will not arise, but for them there the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those in the non-percipient plane, for them there both the mind-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whichever plane the eye-base is not arising, for them there will the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away, and for the eyeless who are being reborn, for them there the eye-base is not arising, but for them there the dhamma-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the eye-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whichever plane the dhamma-base will not arise, for them there is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent plane, for them there the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them there the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the dhamma-base will not arise and the eye-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Eye-Base)

101. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

101. For whomever in whichever plane the nose-base is not arising, for them there will the form-base not arise?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ [V 1.0180] nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati[M 1.0122].

For those passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for those without a nose who are being reborn into the sense-sphere plane, and for those in the form-sphere plane, for them there the nose-base is not arising, but for them there the form-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere plane, and for those in the formless plane, for them there both the nose-base is not arising and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whichever plane the form-base will not arise, for them there is the nose-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare [T 1.0159] pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere plane, for them there the form-base will not arise, but for them there the nose-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere plane, and for those in the formless plane, for them there both the form-base will not arise and the nose-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whichever plane the nose-base is not arising, for them there will the mind-base not arise?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for those without a nose who are being reborn into the sense-sphere plane, for those in the form-sphere plane, and for those in the formless-sphere plane, for them there the nose-base is not arising, but for them there the mind-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere and formless-sphere planes, and for those in the non-percipient plane, for them there both the nose-base is not arising and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whichever plane the mind-base will not arise, for them there is the nose-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere, for them there the mind-base will not arise, but for them there the nose-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere and the formless sphere, and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the mind-base will not arise and the nose-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whichever plane the nose-base is not arising, for them there will the dhamma-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without a nose who are being reborn, for them there the nose-base is not arising, but for them there the dhamma-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, and for those in their final existence in the form-sphere and the formless sphere, for them there both the nose-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0181] vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whichever plane the dhamma-base will not arise, for them there is the nose-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0160] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere, for them there the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them there the nose-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, and for those in their final existence in the form-sphere and the formless sphere, for them there both the dhamma-base will not arise and the nose-base is not arising. (Rooted in the Nose-Base)

102. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

102. For whomever in whichever plane the form-base is not arising, for them there will the mind-base not arise?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca [M 1.0123] nuppajjati manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for those in the formless realm, for them there the form-base is not arising, but for them there the mind-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them there both the form-base is not arising and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or for whomever in whichever plane the mind-base will not arise, for them there is the form-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent plane, and for those being reborn in the non-percipient plane, for them there the mind-base will not arise, but for them there the form-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them there both the mind-base will not arise and the form-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whichever plane the form-base is not arising, for them there will the mental-phenomena-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all those who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, for them there the form-base is not arising, but for them there the mental-phenomena-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the form-base is not arising and the mental-phenomena-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0182] vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0161] nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or for whomever in whichever plane the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, for them there is the form-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent plane, for them there the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, but for them there the form-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the mental-phenomena-base will not arise and the form-base is not arising. (Form-Base Section)

103. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

103. For whomever in whichever plane the mind-base is not arising, for them there will the mental-phenomena-base not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For all those who are passing away and for those without mind who are being reborn, for them there the mind-base is not arising, but for them there the mental-phenomena-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them there both the mind-base is not arising and the mental-phenomena-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or for whomever in whichever plane the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, for them there is the mind-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, for them there the mental-phenomena-base will not arise, but for them there the mind-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them there both the mental-phenomena-base will not arise and the mind-base is not arising. (Mind-Base Section)

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) The Section on the Past and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Order (Individual)

104. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base has arisen, for them will the ear-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ [V 1.0183][M 1.0124] tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha sotāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the eye-base has arisen, but for them the ear-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the eye-base has arisen and the ear-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti[T 1.0162]? Āmantā.

104. Or for whomever the ear-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base has arisen, for them will the nose-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or the immaterial plane, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the eye-base has arisen, but for them the nose-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the eye-base has arisen and the nose-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or for whomever the nose-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base has arisen, for them will the form-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the eye-base has arisen, but for them the form-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the eye-base has arisen and the form-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or for whomever the form-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base has arisen, for them will the mind-base... and the mental-phenomena-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence, for them the eye-base has arisen, but for them the mental-phenomena-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the eye-base has arisen and the mental-phenomena-base will arise. Or for whomever the mental-phenomena-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen? Yes. (Eye-Base Section)

105. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the nose-base has arisen, for them will the form-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti [T 1.0163] tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the nose-base has arisen, but for them the form-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the nose-base has arisen and the form-base will arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0184] vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

105. Or for whomever the form-base will arise, for them has the nose-base arisen? Yes.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the nose-base has arisen, for them will the mind-base... and the mental-phenomena-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, for them the nose-base has arisen, but for them the mental-phenomena-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the nose-base has arisen and the mental-phenomena-base will arise.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the mind-object base will arise... has the nose-base arisen for them? Yes.

106. Yassa [M 1.0125] rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

106. For whomsoever the form-base has arisen, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, the form-base has arisen for them, but the mind-object base will not arise for them. For the others, both the form-base has arisen for them and the mind-object base will arise for them.

Yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the mind-object base will arise... has the form-base arisen for them? Yes.

107. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

107. (Ka) For whomsoever the mind-base has arisen, for them will the mind-object base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, the mind-base has arisen for them, but the mind-object base will not arise for them. For the others, both the mind-base has arisen for them and the mind-object base will arise for them.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomsoever the mind-object base will arise, for them has the mind-base arisen? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: Plane

108. Yattha [T 1.0164] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha…pe….

108. Wherein the eye-base has arisen...

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Person and Plane

109. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0185] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

109. (Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base has arisen, for them will the ear-base arise in that same plane?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha sotāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent plane, the eye-base has arisen for them there, but the ear-base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the five-constituent plane, both the eye-base has arisen for them there and the ear-base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the ear-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen in that same plane? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base has arisen, for them will the nose-base arise in that same plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere plane, and for those in the form-sphere plane, the eye-base has arisen for them there, but the nose-base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere plane, both the eye-base has arisen for them there and the nose-base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen in that same plane? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base has arisen, for them will the form-base arise in that same plane?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent plane, the eye-base has arisen for them there, but the form-base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the five-constituent plane, both the eye-base has arisen for them there and the form-base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti[M 1.0126]?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the form-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen in that same plane?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati [T 1.0165] cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For non-percipient beings, the form-base will arise for them there, but the eye-base has not arisen for them there. For beings in the five-constituent plane, both the form-base will arise for them there and the eye-base has arisen for them there.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0186] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base has arisen, for them will the mind-base arise in that same plane?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent plane, the eye-base has arisen for them there, but the mind-base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the five-constituent plane, both the eye-base has arisen for them there and the mind-base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the mind-base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen in that same plane?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For beings in the formless plane, the mind-base will arise for them there, but the eye-base has not arisen for them there. For beings in the five-constituent plane, both the mind-base will arise for them there and the eye-base has arisen for them there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base has arisen, for them will the mind-object base arise in that same plane?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent plane, the eye-base has arisen for them there, but the mind-object base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the five-constituent plane, both the eye-base has arisen for them there and the mind-object base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the mind-object base will arise, for them has the eye-base arisen in that same plane?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For non-percipient beings and for beings in the formless plane, the mind-object base will arise for them there, but the eye-base has not arisen for them there. For beings in the five-constituent plane, both the mind-object base will arise for them there and the eye-base has arisen for them there. (The Eye-Base Section ends.)

110. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti[T 1.0166]?

110. (Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base has arisen, for them will the form-base arise in that same plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere plane, the nose-base has arisen for them there, but the form-base will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere plane, both the nose-base has arisen for them there and the form-base will arise for them there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the form-base will arise, for them has the nose-base arisen in that same plane?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For beings in the form-sphere, the form-base will arise for them there, but the nose-base has not arisen for them there. For beings in the sense-sphere, both the form-base will arise for them there and the nose-base has arisen for them there.

Yassa [V 1.0187] yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base has arisen, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object base arise in that same plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ [M 1.0127] uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the sensuous sphere, for them the nose-base arose there, but for them the dhamma-base will not arise there. For the other beings in the sensuous sphere, for them both the nose-base arose there and the dhamma-base will arise there.

Yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the dhamma-base will arise, for them did the nose-base arise there?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but for them the nose-base did not arise there. For those in the sensuous sphere, for them both the dhamma-base will arise there and the nose-base arose there. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

111. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

111. (a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the form-base arose, for them will the mind-base arise there?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha manāyatanañca [T 1.0167] uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent sphere and for non-percipient beings, for them the form-base arose there, but for them the mind-base will not arise there. For the other beings in the five-constituent sphere, for them both the form-base arose there and the mind-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the mind-base will arise, for them did the form-base arise there?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha.

For those in the immaterial sphere, for them the mind-base will arise there, but for them the form-base did not arise there. For those in the five-constituent sphere, for them both the mind-base will arise there and the form-base arose there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the form-base arose, for them will the dhamma-base arise there?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [V 1.0188] tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent sphere, for them the form-base arose there, but for them the dhamma-base will not arise there. For the other beings in the five-constituent sphere and for non-percipient beings, for them both the form-base arose there and the dhamma-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the dhamma-base will arise, for them did the form-base arise there?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in the immaterial sphere, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but for them the form-base did not arise there. For those in the five-constituent sphere and for non-percipient beings, for them both the dhamma-base will arise there and the form-base arose there. (The section rooted in the form-base)

112. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

112. (a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the mind-base arose, for them will the dhamma-base arise there?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca uppajjittha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence, for them the mind-base arose there, but for them the dhamma-base will not arise there. For the other beings in the four-constituent sphere and the five-constituent sphere, for them both the mind-base arose there and the dhamma-base will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the dhamma-base will arise, for them did the mind-base arise there?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0168] uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ [M 1.0128] tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjittha. Catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca uppajjissati manāyatanañca uppajjittha. (Manāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For non-percipient beings, for them the dhamma-base will arise there, but for them the mind-base did not arise there. For beings in the four-constituent sphere and the five-constituent sphere, for them both the dhamma-base will arise there and the mind-base arose there. (The section rooted in the mind-base)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: Individual

113. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

113. (a) For whomever the eye-base did not arise, for them will the ear-base not arise? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(b) Or again, for whomever the ear-base will not arise, for them did the eye-base not arise? It arose.

Yassa [V 1.0189] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

For whomever the eye-base did not arise, for them will the nose-base… form-base… mind-base… dhamma-base not arise? There is not.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

Or again, for whomever the dhamma-base will not arise, for them did the eye-base not arise? It arose.

114. Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi. Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

114. For whomever the nose-base… form-base… mind-base did not arise, for them will the dhamma-base not arise? There is not. Or again, for whomever the dhamma-base will not arise, for them did the mind-base not arise? It arose.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(e) Negative: Sphere

115. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha…pe….

115. Where the eye-base did not arise… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative: Individual and Sphere

116. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

116. (a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the eye-base did not arise, for them will the ear-base not arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the ear-base will not arise, for them did the eye-base not arise there?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent sphere, for them the ear-base will not arise there, but for them the eye-base arose there. For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, for them both the ear-base will not arise there and the eye-base did not arise there.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0169] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the eye-base did not arise, for them will the nose-base not arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whomever in whatsoever sphere the nose-base will not arise, for them did the eye-base not arise there?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the sensuous sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere, for them the nose-base will not arise there, but for them the eye-base arose there. For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, for them both the nose-base will not arise there and the eye-base did not arise there.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0190][M 1.0129] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whomever in whatsoever sphere the eye-base did not arise, for them will the form-base not arise there?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, the eye-base did not arise for them there, but the form-base will arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them there both the eye-base did not arise and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the form-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the eye-base not arise?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent planes, the form-base will not arise for them there, but the eye-base did arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them there both the form-base will not arise and the eye-base did not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whatsoever realm the eye-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the mind-base not arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha manāyatanañca [T 1.0170] nuppajjissati.

For formless beings, the eye-base did not arise for them there, but the mind-base will arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the eye-base did not arise and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the mind-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the eye-base not arise?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent planes, the mind-base will not arise for them there, but the eye-base did arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the mind-base will not arise and the eye-base did not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whatsoever realm the eye-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the dhamma-base not arise?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ [V 1.0191] tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings and for formless beings, the eye-base did not arise for them there, but the dhamma-base will arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the eye-base did not arise and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the dhamma-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the eye-base not arise?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjittha. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent planes, the dhamma-base will not arise for them there, but the eye-base did arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them there both the dhamma-base will not arise and the eye-base did not arise. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

117. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

117. For whomever in whatsoever realm the nose-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the form-base not arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Rūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati[T 1.0171].

For those in the fine-material planes, the nose-base did not arise for them there, but the form-base will arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material plane and for formless beings, for them there both the nose-base did not arise and the form-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the form-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the nose-base not arise?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ [M 1.0130] tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere plane, the form-base will not arise for them there, but the nose-base did arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material plane and for formless beings, for them there both the form-base will not arise and the nose-base did not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whatsoever realm the nose-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the mind-base not arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the fine-material and immaterial planes, the nose-base did not arise for them there, but the mind-base will arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial planes, and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the nose-base did not arise and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the mind-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the nose-base not arise?

Kāmāvacare [V 1.0192] pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere plane, the mind-base will not arise for them there, but the nose-base did arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial planes, and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the mind-base will not arise and the nose-base did not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever in whatsoever realm the nose-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the dhamma-base not arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the fine-material and immaterial planes, the nose-base did not arise for them there, but the dhamma-base will arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial planes, for them there both the nose-base did not arise and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati [T 1.0172] tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever in whatsoever realm the dhamma-base will not arise, for them in that realm did the nose-base not arise?

Kāmāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjittha. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere plane, the dhamma-base will not arise for them there, but the nose-base did arise for them there. For those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial planes, for them there both the dhamma-base will not arise and the nose-base did not arise. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

118. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

118. For whomever in whatsoever realm the form-base did not arise, for them in that realm will the mind-base not arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the formless realm, the form-base has not arisen for them there, but the mind-base will arise for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them there, both the form-base has not arisen and the mind-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base will not arise, for them, there, has the form-base not arisen?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence in the five-aggregate existence, for them there, the mind-base will not arise, but for them there, the form-base has arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them there, both the mind-base will not arise and the form-base has not arisen.

(Ka) yassa =93 [M 1.0131] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the form-base has not arisen, for them, there, will the dhamma-base not arise?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the formless realm, for them there, the form-base has not arisen, but for them there, the dhamma-base will arise. For those in the Pure Abodes, and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for them there, both the form-base has not arisen and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will not arise, for them, there, has the form-base not arisen?

Pañcavokāre pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha[T 1.0173]. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjittha. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence in the five-constituent plane, for them, there, the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them, there, the form-base has arisen. For those in the Suddhāvāsa planes, and for those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them, there, both the dhamma-base will not arise and the form-base has not arisen. (The section rooted in the form-base.)

119. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the mind-base has not arisen, for them, there, will the dhamma-base not arise?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjittha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them there, the mind-base has not arisen, but for them there, the dhamma-base will arise. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them there, both the mind-base has not arisen and the dhamma-base will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

119. Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will not arise, for them, there, has the mind-base not arisen?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca nuppajjittha.

For those in their final existence, for them there, the dhamma-base will not arise, but for them there, the mind-base has arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes, for them there, both the dhamma-base will not arise and the mind-base has not arisen.

Uppādavāro.

The Section on Arising.

2. Pavatti 2. nirodhavāro

The Course of Existence. 2. The Section on Cessation.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Order: The Individual

120. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0194] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

For whomever the eye-base is ceasing, for them is the ear-base ceasing?

Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati sotāyatanañca nirujjhati.

2. For those with an eye-base but without an ear-base who are passing away, for them the eye-base is ceasing, but for them the ear-base is not ceasing. For those with an eye-base and with an ear-base who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing and the ear-base is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever the ear-base is ceasing, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

Or again, for whomever the dhamma-base is ceasing, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

For those without an eye-base who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base is ceasing, but for them the eye-base is not ceasing. For those with an eye-base who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base is ceasing and the eye-base is ceasing. (The section rooted in the eye-base.)

121. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the nose-base is ceasing, for them is the form-base ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever the form-base is ceasing, for them is the nose-base ceasing?

For those with form but without the nose-base who are passing away, for them the form-base is ceasing, but for them the nose-base is not ceasing. For those with the nose-base who are passing away, for them both the form-base is ceasing and the nose-base is ceasing.

Or again, for whomever the mind-base is ceasing, for them is the nose-base ceasing?

Sacittakānaṃ [M 1.0133] aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no [V 1.0196] ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati.

Or again, for whomever the mind-object-base is ceasing, for them is the nose-base ceasing?

Aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those with the nose-base who are passing away, for them both the mind-object-base is ceasing and the nose-base is ceasing. (The section rooted in the Nose-Base)

122. (Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

For those without mind who are passing away, for them the form-base is ceasing, but for them the mind-base is not ceasing. For those with form and with mind who are passing away, for them both the form-base is ceasing and the mind-base is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever the mind-base is ceasing, for them is the form-base ceasing?

Arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati.

123. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

123. For whomever the mind-base is ceasing, for them is the mind-object-base ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity Section: Plane of Existence

124. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati…pe… (uppādepi nirodhepi uppādanirodhepi yatthakaṃ sabbattha sadisaṃ).

124. Where the eye-base ceases... (The section on the plane of existence is the same in all respects for the section on arising, the section on ceasing, and the section on arising and ceasing).

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity Section: Individuals and Planes of Existence

125. Yassa [V 1.0197][M 1.0134] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? (Yassa yatthakampi sadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).

125. For whomever in whichever plane of existence the eye-base is ceasing, for them in that plane of existence is the ear-base ceasing? ... the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base... the mind-object-base is ceasing? (The section on 'for whomever, where' should also be expanded in the same way).

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative Section: Individual

126. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0177] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

126. For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them is the ear-base not ceasing?

Acakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the eye-base but with the ear-base who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the ear-base is ceasing. For all who are arising, and for those without the eye-base and without the ear-base who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the ear-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever the ear-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not ceasing?

Asotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the ear-base but with the eye-base who are passing away, for them the ear-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is ceasing. For all who are arising, and for those without the ear-base and without the eye-base who are passing away, for them both the ear-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them is the nose-base not ceasing?

Acakkhukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are arising, and for those without the nose-base and without the eye-base who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them is the form-base not ceasing?

Acakkhukānaṃ sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no [T 1.0178] ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the eye-base but with the form-base who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the form-base is ceasing. For all who are arising, and for those without the form-base who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the form-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the form-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0135] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

For whom the eye-base is not ceasing, for them is the mind-base not ceasing?

Acakkhukānaṃ sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the eye-base but with mind who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, and for those without mind who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not ceasing? Yes.

For whom the eye-base is not ceasing, for them is the phenomena-base not ceasing?

Acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Aghānakānaṃ sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the nose-base and with mind who are passing away, for them the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, and for those without mind who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is not ceasing and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the nose-base not ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

For whom the nose-base is not ceasing, for them is the phenomena-base not ceasing?

Aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without the nose-base who are passing away, for them the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them the phenomena-base is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is not ceasing and the phenomena-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

128. (Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

128. For whom the form-base is not ceasing, for them is the mind-base not ceasing?

Arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For the formless who are passing away, for them the form-base is not ceasing, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For all those who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is not ceasing and the mind-base is not ceasing.

Or again, for whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the form-base not ceasing?

Acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without mind who are passing away, for them the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them the form-base is ceasing. For all who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not ceasing and the form-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

For whom the form-base is not ceasing, for them is the phenomena-base not ceasing?

Arūpakānaṃ [V 1.0200] cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0180] nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For the formless who are passing away, for them the form-base is not ceasing, but for them the phenomena-base is ceasing. For all who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is not ceasing and the phenomena-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom the phenomena-base is not ceasing, for them is the form-base not ceasing? Yes. (The section rooted in the form-base.)

129. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

129. For whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the phenomena-base not ceasing?

Acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those without mind who are passing away, for them the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them the phenomena-base is ceasing. For all who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not ceasing and the phenomena-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the phenomena-base is not ceasing, for them is the mind-base not ceasing? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative Section on Location

130. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

130. In which plane the eye-base is not ceasing... and so on...

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative Section on Person and Location

131. Yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatī ti…pe… (yassa yatthakampi yassakasadisaṃ).

131. For whom in which plane the eye-base is not ceasing, for them in that plane is the ear-base not ceasing?... and so on... (The section on Person and Location is also similar to the section on Person.)

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Positive Section on the Person

132. Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

132. For whom the eye-base has ceased, for them has the ear-base ceased?

Āmantā. (Uppādavārepi nirodhavārepi uppādanirodhavārepi atītā pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi paccaniyampi (sī. syā. ka.) sadisaṃ.)

Yes. (In the section on arising, in the section on cessation, and in the section on arising and cessation, the past question is similar for both the positive and the negative.)

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Section on the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Positive Section on the Person

133. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0201][M 1.0137] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

133. (Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease, for them will the ear-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the ear-base will cease, for them will the eye-base cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0181]?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease, for them will the nose-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the eye-base will cease, but the nose-base will not cease. For the others, both the eye-base will cease and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whom the nose-base will cease, for them will the eye-base cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the eye-base will cease, for them will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whom the form-base will cease, for them will the eye-base cease? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the eye-base will cease, for them will the mind-base… the dhammā-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom the dhammā-base will cease, for them will the eye-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca [V 1.0202] nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhissati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the formless sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the dhammā-base will cease, but the eye-base will not cease. For the others, both the dhammā-base will cease and the eye-base will cease. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

134. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

134. For whom the nose-base will cease, for them will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom the form-base will cease, for them will the nose-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0182] rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the form-base will cease, but the nose-base will not cease. For the others, both the form-base will cease and the nose-base will cease.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the nose-base will cease, for them will the mind-base… the dhammā-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom the dhammā-base will cease, for them will the nose-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0138] ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere or the formless sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the formless sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the dhammā-base will cease, but the nose-base will not cease. For the others, both the dhammā-base will cease and the nose-base will cease. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

135. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

135. For whom the form-base will cease, for them will the mind-base… the dhammā-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom the dhammā-base will cease, for them will the form-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the formless sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless sphere, will attain final Nibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the dhammā-base will cease, but the form-base will not cease. For the others, both the dhammā-base will cease and the form-base will cease.

136. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0203] manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

136. (Ka) For whom the mind-base will cease, for them will the dhammā-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the dhammā-base will cease, for them will the mind-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity: Realm

137. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati…pe….

137. Where the eye-base will cease…

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity: Persons and Realms

138. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0183]? Āmantā.
