138. (Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the ear-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom, where the ear-base will cease…? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the nose-base cease in that realm?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ…pe… kāmāvacarānaṃ…pe….

For those of the fine-material sphere… for those of the sense-sphere…

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom, where the nose-base will cease…? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the form-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the form-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the eye-base cease in that realm?

Asaññasattānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ…pe….

For those of the non-percipient plane… for those of the five-constituent plane…

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the mind-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the mind-base will cease…?

Arūpānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ…pe….

For those of the formless plane… for those of the five-constituent plane…

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0204][M 1.0139] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the eye-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the dhammā-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the dhammā-base will cease…?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ…pe…. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those of the non-percipient plane, for those of the formless plane… for those of the five-constituent plane… (The section rooted in the eye-base)

139. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

139. (Ka) For whom the nose-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the form-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the form-base will cease…?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ…pe… kāmāvacarānaṃ…pe….

For those of the fine-material sphere… for those of the sense-sphere…

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the nose-base will cease in a certain realm, for them will the mind-base cease in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whom, where the mind-base will cease…?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ…pe… kāmāvacarānaṃ…pe….

For those of the form-sphere, for those of the formless-sphere... for those of the sense-sphere...

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the nose-base will cease, for that person, in that plane will the mind-object-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whomever, in whichever plane...?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ…pe… kāmāvacarānaṃ…pe…. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those of the form-sphere, for those of the formless-sphere... for those of the sense-sphere... (The section rooted in the nose-base).

140. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

140. (Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the form-base will cease, for that person, in that plane will the mind-base cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ…pe….

For those of the non-percipient plane... for those of the five-constituent plane...

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whomever, in whichever plane...?

Arūpānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ…pe….

For those in the formless realm... for those in the five-constituent realm...

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the form-base will cease, for that person, in that plane will the mind-object-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0205] vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whomever, in whichever plane...?

Arūpānaṃ…pe… pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in the formless realm... for those in the five-constituent realm, for non-percipient beings... (The section rooted in the form-base.)

141. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

141. (Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the mind-base...? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…?

(Kha) Or for whomever, in whichever plane...?

Asaññasattānaṃ…pe… catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca nirujjhissati. (Yathā uppādavāre yassa yatthake anāgatā pucchā vitthāritā, evaṃ nirodhepi vitthāretabbā).

For non-percipient beings... for those of the four-constituent realm, and for those of the five-constituent realm, for them, in that plane, both the mind-object-base will cease and the mind-base will cease. (As the future question in the Person-Plane section of the Arising Chapter was elaborated, so too should it be elaborated in the Cessation Chapter.)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Person

142. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0184] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

142. (Ka) For whomever the eye-base will not cease, for them will the ear-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomever the ear-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0140] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever the eye-base will not cease, for them will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whomever the nose-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those of the final existence who are being reborn in the form realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the form realm, will attain parinibbāna—for them at the moment of passing away, their nose-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent realm, for those of the final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna—for them at the moment of passing away, both their nose-base will not cease and their eye-base will not cease.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0206] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever the eye-base will not cease, for them will the form-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomever the form-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not cease? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base will not cease, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna, for them at the moment of passing away, their eye-base will not cease, but their mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, for them, both the eye-base will not cease and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ [T 1.0185] na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or for whomever the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not cease? Yes. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

143. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

143. (Ka) For whomever the nose-base will not cease, for them will the form-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the form realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the form realm, will attain parinibbāna, for them at the moment of passing away, their nose-base will not cease, but their form-base will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna, for them at the moment of passing away, both the nose-base will not cease and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomever the form-base will not cease, for them will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever the nose-base will not cease, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ [V 1.0207] ghānāyatanaṃ [M 1.0141] na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the form realm and the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the form realm and the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna, for them at the moment of passing away, their nose-base will not cease, but their mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, for them, both the nose-base will not cease and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomever the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

144. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

144. For whomever the form-base will not cease, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ arūpaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ [T 1.0186] tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain parinibbāna—for them, at the moment of passing away, the form-base will not cease, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining parinibbāna, for them both the form-base and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomever the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the form-base not cease? Yes.

145. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

145. (Ka) For whomever the mind-base will not cease, for them will the mind-object-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomever the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the mind-base not cease? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative Section on Plane

146. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati…pe….

146. Where the eye-base will not cease… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative Section on Person and Plane

147. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

147. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the eye-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the ear-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0208] vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the ear-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the eye-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the eye-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the eye-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those of the fine-material sphere, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the eye-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base and the eye-base will not cease.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0142] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the eye-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the form-base not cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre [T 1.0187] parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the eye-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the eye-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the mind-base not cease?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the eye-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0209] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the eye-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the phenomena-base not cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the phenomena-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base and the phenomena-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the phenomena-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the eye-base not cease? Yes. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

148. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

148. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the form-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those of the fine-material sphere, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0188] nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the mind-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati manāyatanañca na [M 1.0143] nirujjhissati.

For those of the fine-material sphere and the formless sphere, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the phenomena-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati[V 1.0210], no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those of the fine-material sphere and the formless sphere, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the phenomena-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base and the phenomena-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the phenomena-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease?

Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Yes. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

149. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

149. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the mind-base not cease?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For formless beings, for them, in that plane, the form-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the form-base and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the form-base not cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0189] manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the mind-base and the form-base will not cease.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the phenomena-base not cease?

Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the formless realms, their form-base will not cease there, but their phenomena-base will cease there. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither their form-base nor their phenomena-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or alternatively, for whomever in whatsoever plane the phenomena-base will not cease, for them in that plane will the form-base not cease? Yes. (The section rooted in the form-base)

150. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

150. For whomever in whatsoever plane the mind-base will not cease, for them in that plane will the phenomena-base not cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings, their mind-base will not cease there, but their phenomena-base will cease there. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither their mind-base nor their phenomena-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0211] vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or alternatively, for whomever in whatsoever plane the phenomena-base will not cease, for them in that plane will the mind-base not cease? Yes.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Individual: Forward Order

151. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0144] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

151. For whomever the eye-base is ceasing, for them has the ear-base ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or alternatively, for whomever the ear-base has ceased, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those without eyes who are passing away, their ear-base has ceased, but their eye-base is not ceasing. For those with eyes who are passing away, both their ear-base has ceased and their eye-base is ceasing.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ [T 1.0190]…pe… manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever the eye-base is ceasing, for them has the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base... the phenomena-base ceased? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or alternatively, for whomever the phenomena-base has ceased, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those without eyes who are passing away, their phenomena-base has ceased, but their eye-base is not ceasing. For those with eyes who are passing away, both their phenomena-base has ceased and their eye-base is ceasing.

152. Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

152. For whomever the nose-base is ceasing, for them has the form-base... the mind-base... the phenomena-base ceased? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or alternatively, for whomever the phenomena-base has ceased, for them is the nose-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those without the nose-faculty who are passing away, their phenomena-base has ceased, but their nose-base is not ceasing. For those with the nose-faculty who are passing away, both their phenomena-base has ceased and their nose-base is ceasing.

153. Yassa [V 1.0212] rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

153. For whomever the form-base is ceasing, for them has the mind-base... the phenomena-base ceased? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or alternatively, for whomever the phenomena-base has ceased, for them is the form-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those without form who are passing away, their phenomena-base has ceased, but their form-base is not ceasing. For those with form who are passing away, both their phenomena-base has ceased and their form-base is ceasing.

154. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

154. (Ka) For whomever the mind-base is ceasing, for them has the phenomena-base ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whomever the phenomena-base has ceased, for them is the mind-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0191] nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha manāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all who are arising and for those without mind who are passing away, their phenomena-base has ceased, but their mind-base is not ceasing. For those with mind who are passing away, both their phenomena-base has ceased and their mind-base is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Forward Order: The Plane

155. Yattha [M 1.0145] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

155. Where the eye-base is ceasing... etc.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Forward Order: The Person and Plane

156. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

156. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the eye-base is ceasing, for them, there has the ear-base ceased?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati sotāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, their eye-base is ceasing there, but their ear-base has not ceased there. For the others with eyes who are passing away, both their eye-base is ceasing there and their ear-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whomever, wherever the ear-base has ceased, for them, there is the eye-base ceasing?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati[V 1.0213]. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those who are arising in the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere, their ear-base has ceased there, but their eye-base is not ceasing there. For those with eyes who are passing away, both their ear-base has ceased there and their eye-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the eye-base is ceasing, for them, there has the nose-base ceased?

Rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, their eye-base is ceasing there, but their nose-base has not ceased there. For those with eyes passing away from the sense-sphere, both their eye-base is ceasing there and their nose-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whomever, wherever the nose-base has ceased, for them, there is the eye-base ceasing?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0192] tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those who are arising in the sense-sphere, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere, their nose-base has ceased there, but their eye-base is not ceasing there. For those with eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere, both their nose-base has ceased there and their eye-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whichever being the eye-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the form-base ceased in that realm?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but the form-base has not ceased for them there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the form-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the form-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the eye-base ceasing in that realm?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them the form-base has ceased there, but the eye-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the form-base has ceased there and the eye-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0146] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whichever being the eye-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the mind-base ceased in that realm?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca [V 1.0214] tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati manāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but the mind-base has not ceased for them there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the mind-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the mind-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the eye-base ceasing in that realm?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for formless beings, for them the mind-base has ceased there, but the eye-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the mind-base has ceased there and the eye-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0193] nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whichever being the eye-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the dhamma-base ceased in that realm?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but the dhamma-base has not ceased for them there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the dhamma-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the dhamma-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the eye-base ceasing in that realm?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all beings who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base has ceased there, but the eye-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base has ceased there and the eye-base is ceasing there. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

157. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

157. (Ka) For whichever being the nose-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the form-base ceased in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the form-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the nose-base ceasing in that realm?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those without a nose who are passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for them the form-base has ceased there, but the nose-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with a nose who are passing away, for them both the form-base has ceased there and the nose-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whichever being the nose-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the mind-base ceased in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0215] vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the mind-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the nose-base ceasing in that realm?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati[T 1.0194]. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for those without a nose who are passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those in the form realm, and for those in the formless realm, for them the mind-base has ceased there, but the nose-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with a nose who are passing away, for them both the mind-base has ceased there and the nose-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whichever being the nose-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the dhamma-base ceased in that realm? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ [M 1.0147] nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the dhamma-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the nose-base ceasing in that realm?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all who are being reborn and for those without a nose who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base has ceased there, but the nose-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with a nose who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base has ceased there and the nose-base is ceasing there. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

158. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

158. (Ka) For whichever being the form-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the mind-base ceased in that realm?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati manāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them the form-base is ceasing there, but the mind-base has not ceased for them there. For the other beings who are passing away from the five-aggregate realm, for them both the form-base is ceasing there and the mind-base has ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whichever being the mind-base has ceased in whichever realm, for that being is the form-base ceasing in that realm?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, for them the mind-base has ceased there, but the form-base is not ceasing for them there. For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm, for them both the mind-base has ceased there and the form-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0216] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whichever being the form-base is ceasing in whichever realm, for that being has the dhamma-base ceased in that realm?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ [T 1.0195] tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa planes, for them the form-base is ceasing there, but for them the dhamma-base has not ceased there. For the other beings with form who are passing away, for them there both the form-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base has ceased, for them there is the form-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are arising, and for formless beings who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base has ceased there, but for them the form-base is not ceasing there. For beings with form who are passing away, for them there both the dhamma-base has ceased and the form-base is ceasing. (The section rooted in the form-base)

159. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

159. For whomever, wherever the mind-base is ceasing, for them there has the dhamma-base ceased?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa planes, for them the mind-base is ceasing there, but for them the dhamma-base has not ceased there. For the other beings with consciousness who are passing away, for them there both the mind-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base has ceased, for them there is the mind-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhittha manāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are arising, and for beings without consciousness who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base has ceased there, but for them the mind-base is not ceasing there. For beings with consciousness who are passing away, for them there both the dhamma-base has ceased and the mind-base is ceasing.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative (Person)

160. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0148] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

160. For one for whom the eye-base is not ceasing, for them has the ear-base not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0217] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or again, for one for whom the ear-base has not ceased, for them is the eye-base not ceasing? There is no such case.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… [T 1.0196] rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

For one for whom the eye-base... the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base is not ceasing, for them has the dhamma-base not ceased? It has ceased.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or again, for one for whom the dhamma-base has not ceased, for them is the mind-base not ceasing? There is no such case.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative Plane

161. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

161. Where the eye-base is not ceasing... and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative Person and Plane

162. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

162. For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them there has the ear-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for them there the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them there the ear-base has ceased. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the eye-base is not ceasing and the ear-base has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the ear-base has not ceased, for them there is the eye-base not ceasing?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca na nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them there the ear-base has not ceased, but for them there the eye-base is ceasing. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the ear-base has not ceased and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them there has the nose-base not ceased?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha[T 1.0197].

For those who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for them there the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them there the nose-base has ceased. For those who are being reborn in the form-sphere plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the eye-base is not ceasing and the nose-base has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0218] vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the nose-base has not ceased, for them there is the eye-base not ceasing?

Rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [M 1.0149] arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those passing away from the form-sphere realm, for them there the nose-base has not ceased, but the eye-base is ceasing. For those being reborn in the form-sphere realm, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the nose-base has not ceased and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them there has the form-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for the eyeless passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them there the eye-base is not ceasing, but the form-base has ceased. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them there both the eye-base is not ceasing and the form-base has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the form-base has not ceased, for them there is the eye-base not ceasing?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them there the form-base has not ceased, but the eye-base is ceasing. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them there both the form-base has not ceased and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them there has the mind-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha[T 1.0198].

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for the eyeless passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for formless beings, their eye-sphere is not ceasing there, but their mind-sphere had ceased there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, their eye-sphere is not ceasing there, and their mind-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for whom, where the mind-sphere had not ceased, is their eye-sphere not ceasing there?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [V 1.0219] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, their mind-sphere had not ceased there, but their eye-sphere is ceasing there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, their mind-sphere had not ceased there, and their eye-sphere is not ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whom, where the eye-sphere is not ceasing, had their dhamma-sphere not ceased there?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For all those being reborn and for the eyeless who are passing away, their eye-sphere is not ceasing there, but their dhamma-sphere had ceased there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, their eye-sphere is not ceasing there, and their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for whom, where the dhamma-sphere had not ceased, is their eye-sphere not ceasing there?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there, but their eye-sphere is ceasing there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there, and their eye-sphere is not ceasing there. (Rooted in the Eye-Sphere)

163. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0150] yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

163. For whom, where the nose-sphere is not ceasing, had their form-sphere not ceased there?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn into the sense-sphere realm, for the noseless passing away from the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the form-sphere realm, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, but their form-sphere had ceased there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, and their form-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti[T 1.0199]? Āmantā.

Or, for whom, where the form-sphere had not ceased, is their nose-sphere not ceasing there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whom, where the nose-sphere is not ceasing, had their mind-sphere not ceased there?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca [V 1.0220] tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn into the sense-sphere realm, for the noseless passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those in the form-sphere realm, and for those in the formless-sphere realm, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, but their mind-sphere had ceased there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, and their mind-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or, for whom, where the mind-sphere had not ceased, is their nose-sphere not ceasing there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whom, where the nose-sphere is not ceasing, had their dhamma-sphere not ceased there?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For all those being reborn and for the noseless who are passing away, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, but their dhamma-sphere had ceased there. For those in the Pure Abodes, their nose-sphere is not ceasing there, and their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or, for whom, where the dhamma-sphere had not ceased, is their nose-sphere not ceasing there? Yes. (Rooted in the Nose-Sphere)

164. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

164. For whom, where the form-sphere is not ceasing, had their mind-sphere not ceased there?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, their form-sphere is not ceasing there, but their mind-sphere had ceased there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn into the non-percipient realm, their form-sphere is not ceasing there, and their mind-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for whom, where the mind-sphere had not ceased, is their form-sphere not ceasing there?

Suddhāvāse [T 1.0200] parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm, their mind-sphere had not ceased there, but their form-sphere is ceasing there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn into the non-percipient realm, their mind-sphere had not ceased there, and their form-sphere is not ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whom, where the form-sphere is not ceasing, had their dhamma-sphere not ceased there?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ [V 1.0221][M 1.0151] na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For all those being reborn and for the formless who are passing away, their form-sphere is not ceasing there, but their dhamma-sphere had ceased there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, their form-sphere is not ceasing there, and their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for whom, where the dhamma-sphere had not ceased, is their form-sphere not ceasing there?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there, but their form-sphere is ceasing there. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, their dhamma-sphere had not ceased there, and their form-sphere is not ceasing there.

165. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

165. For whom, where the mind-base is not ceasing, for them, there, had the dhamma-base not ceased?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For all those who are arising and for the mindless ones who are passing away, for them, there, the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them there the dhamma-base had ceased. For those arising in the Pure Abodes, for them, there, both the mind-base is not ceasing and the dhamma-base had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the dhamma-base had not ceased, for them, there, is the mind-base not ceasing?

Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0201] nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhittha manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa realms, for them there the dhamma-base had not ceased, but for them there the mind-base is ceasing. For those arising in the Suddhāvāsa realms, for them there both the dhamma-base had not ceased and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) The Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) The Direct Question (concerning the individual)

166. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

166. (a) For whom the eye-base is ceasing, for them will the ear-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca [V 1.0222] tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna, for them who are passing away, their eye-base is ceasing, but for them the ear-base will not cease. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing and the ear-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom the ear-base will cease, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are arising and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the ear-base will cease, but for them the eye-base is not ceasing. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whom the eye-base is ceasing, for them will the nose-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ [M 1.0152] ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having arisen in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, for them who are passing away, their eye-base is ceasing, but for them the nose-base will not cease. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ…pe….

(b) Or again, for whom the nose-base... etc.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whom the eye-base is ceasing, for them will the form-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti [T 1.0202] tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna, for them who are passing away, their eye-base is ceasing, but for them the form-base will not cease. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing and the form-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ…pe….

(b) Or again, for whom the form-base... etc.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the eye-base is ceasing, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base is ceasing, but for them the dhamma-base will not cease. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base will cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the eye-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ [V 1.0223] upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ…pe… sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ…pe….

For all those who are arising, and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them… etc. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them… etc.

167. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

167. (a) For whom the nose-base is ceasing, for them will the form-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere existence, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna, for them who are passing away, their nose-base is ceasing, but for them the form-base will not cease. For the other beings with a nose who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is ceasing and the form-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(b) Or again, for whom the form-base will cease, for them is the nose-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are arising, and for those without a nose who are passing away, for them the form-base will cease, but for them the nose-base is not ceasing. For those with a nose who are passing away, for them both the form-base will cease and the nose-base is ceasing.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0203] nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-base is ceasing, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base is ceasing, but for them the dhamma-base will not cease. For the other beings with a nose who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base will cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base... etc.

168. Yassa [M 1.0153] rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

168. For whom the form-base is ceasing, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the form-base is ceasing, but for them the dhamma-base will not cease. For the other beings with form who are passing away, for them both the form-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base will cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the form-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati[V 1.0224], no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are arising and for the formless ones who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base will cease, but for them the form-base is not ceasing. For those with form who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the form-base is ceasing.

169. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

169. (Ka) For whom the mind-base is ceasing, for them will the dhamma-base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna, their mind-base is ceasing, but their dhamma-base will not cease. For the other beings with consciousness who are passing away, for them both the mind-base is ceasing and the dhamma-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the mind-base ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are being reborn and for those without consciousness who are passing away, their dhamma-base will cease, but their mind-base is not ceasing. For those with consciousness who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the mind-base is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Section on Conformity Regarding Place

170. Yattha [T 1.0204] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

170. Where the eye-base is ceasing...

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) The Section on Conformity Regarding Individuals and Place

171. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

171. (Ka) For whom the eye-base is ceasing where, for them will the ear-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the ear-base will not cease there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the ear-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the ear-base will cease where, for them is the eye-base ceasing there?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere, for them the ear-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base is not ceasing there. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the ear-base will cease there and the eye-base is ceasing there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is ceasing where, for them will the nose-base cease there?

Kāmāvacare [V 1.0225] parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 1.0154] nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere and for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the nose-base will not cease there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the nose-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… (yathā paccuppannātītepi tividhaṃ vitthāritaṃ evaṃ idampi vitthāretabbaṃ).

(Kha) Or again, for whom the nose-base where... (and so on)... (Just as the threefold analysis was elaborated in the present-past section, so too should this also be elaborated).

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is ceasing where, for them will the form-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ [T 1.0205] tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the form-base will not cease there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the form-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ…pe….

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base where... (and so on)...

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is ceasing where, for them will the mind-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati manāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the mind-base will not cease there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the mind-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ…pe….

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind-base where... (and so on)...

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is ceasing where, for them will the dhamma-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the dhamma-base will not cease there. For the other beings with eyes who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is ceasing there and the dhamma-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base will cease where, for them is the eye-base ceasing there?

Sabbesaṃ [V 1.0226] upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the dhamma-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base is not ceasing there. For those with eyes who are passing away, for them both the dhamma-base will cease there and the eye-base is ceasing there. (The Eye-Base Section)

172. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

172. (Ka) For whom the nose-base is ceasing where, for them will the form-base cease there?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati[T 1.0206].

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base is ceasing there, but for them the form-base will not cease there. For the other beings with a nose who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is ceasing there and the form-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? Kāmāvacare parinibbāntānaṃ tesaṃ tattha…pe….

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base will cease where, for them is the nose-base ceasing there? For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them there... (and so on)...

Kāmāvacaraṃ [M 1.0155] upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha…pe….

For those being reborn into the sense-sphere, for those without a nose who are passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere, for them there... (and so on)...

Yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-base is ceasing where, for them will the mind-base... (and so on)... the dhamma-base cease there?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base is ceasing there, but for them the dhamma-base will not cease there. For the other beings with a nose who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is ceasing there and the dhamma-base will cease there.

Yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base where... (and so on)...

173. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

173. (Ka) For whom the form-base is ceasing where, for them will the mind-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati manāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for those who are passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them the form-base is ceasing there, but the mind-base will not cease for them there. For the others who are passing away from the five-constituent existence, for them both the form-base is ceasing there and the mind-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ…pe….

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whichever plane the mind-base... (etc.).

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0227] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the form-base is ceasing, for them will the mind-object-base cease there?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the form-base is ceasing there, but the mind-object-base will not cease for them there. For the others who possess form and are passing away, for them both the form-base is ceasing there and the mind-object-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whichever plane the mind-object-base will cease, for them is the form-base ceasing there?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati [T 1.0207] rūpāyatanañca nirujjhati.
