For all who are being reborn and for those without form who are passing away, for them the mind-object-base will cease there, but the form-base is not ceasing for them there. For those with form who are passing away, for them both the mind-object-base will cease there and the form-base is ceasing there.

174. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

174. (Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane the mind-base is ceasing, for them will the mind-object-base cease there?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them the mind-base is ceasing there, but for them the mind-object-base will not cease there. For the other conscious beings who are passing away, for them both the mind-base is ceasing there and the mind-object-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whichever plane the mind-object-base will cease, for them is the mind-base ceasing there?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are being reborn and for mindless beings who are passing away, for them the mind-object-base will cease there, but for them the mind-base is not ceasing there. For conscious beings who are passing away, for them both the mind-object-base will cease there and the mind-base is ceasing there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: The Individual

175. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0156] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them will the ear-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na [V 1.0228] nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

175. For all those who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the ear-base will cease. For those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the ear-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the ear-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who are passing away who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the ear-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base is ceasing. For those in their final existence in the formless plane, for them both the ear-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0208]?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them will the nose-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all those who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the nose-base will cease. For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those in their final existence in the immaterial sphere, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the nose-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the nose-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, the nose-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base is ceasing. For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those in their final existence in the immaterial sphere, for them both the nose-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them will the form-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all those who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the form-base will cease. For those in their final existence in the immaterial sphere, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the form-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no [V 1.0229] ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, the form-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base is ceasing. For those in their final existence in the immaterial sphere, for them both the form-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0209] na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them will the mind-base... (etc.)... will the mind-object-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 1.0157] na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless plane, for them both the eye-base is not ceasing and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever the mind-object-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, their mind-object-sphere will not cease, but their eye-sphere is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, their mind-object-sphere will not cease and their eye-sphere is not ceasing.

176. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

176. For whom the nose-sphere is not ceasing, for them will the form-sphere not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those without a nose who are passing away, their nose-sphere is not ceasing, but their form-sphere will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Form Realm, and for those in the formless realm who are in their final existence, their nose-sphere also is not ceasing and their form-sphere also will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the form-sphere will not cease, for them is the nose-sphere not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, their form-sphere will not cease, but their nose-sphere is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Form Realm, and for those in the formless realm who are in their final existence, their form-sphere also will not cease and their nose-sphere also is not ceasing.

Yassa [V 1.0230] ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-sphere is not ceasing, for them will the mind-sphere... will the mind-object-sphere not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ [T 1.0210] tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those without a nose who are passing away, their nose-sphere is not ceasing, but their mind-object-sphere will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Form Realm and the Formless Realm, their nose-sphere also is not ceasing and their mind-object-sphere also will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the mind-object-sphere will not cease, for them is the nose-sphere not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, their mind-object-sphere will not cease, but their nose-sphere is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Form Realm and the Formless Realm, their mind-object-sphere also will not cease and their nose-sphere also is not ceasing.

177. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

177. For whom the form-sphere is not ceasing, for them will the mind-sphere... will the mind-object-sphere not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn, and for formless beings who are passing away, their form-sphere is not ceasing, but their mind-object-sphere will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, their form-sphere also is not ceasing and their mind-object-sphere also will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the mind-object-sphere will not cease, for them is the form-sphere not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ [M 1.0158] na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, their mind-object-sphere will not cease, but their form-sphere is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, their mind-object-sphere also will not cease and their form-sphere also is not ceasing.

178. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0231] manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

178. For whom the mind-sphere is not ceasing, for them will the mind-object-sphere not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

Or again, for whom the mind-object-sphere will not cease, for them is the mind-sphere not ceasing? It is ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Section (Location)

179. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

179. Where the eye-sphere is not ceasing... and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative Section (Person-Location)

180. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0211] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

180. For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the eye-sphere is not ceasing, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the ear-sphere not cease?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for them, in that plane of existence, the eye-sphere is not ceasing, but for them, in that plane of existence, the ear-sphere will cease. For non-percipient beings and for formless beings, for them, in that plane of existence, the eye-sphere also is not ceasing and the ear-sphere also will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whatever plane the ear-sphere will not cease, for them in that plane is the eye-sphere not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for them in that plane the ear-sphere will not cease, but for them in that plane the eye-sphere is ceasing. For non-percipient beings and for formless beings, for them in that plane the ear-sphere also will not cease and the eye-sphere also is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever in whatever plane the eye-sphere is not ceasing, for them in that plane will the nose-sphere not cease?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane the eye-sphere is not ceasing, but for them in that plane the nose-sphere will cease. For those being reborn in the fine-material plane and for formless beings, for them in that plane the eye-sphere also is not ceasing and the nose-sphere also will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever in whatever plane the nose-sphere will not cease, for them in that plane is the eye-sphere not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati[V 1.0232]. Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, and for those passing away from the fine-material plane, for them in that plane the nose-sphere will not cease, but for them in that plane the eye-sphere is ceasing. For those being reborn in the fine-material plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them in that plane the nose-sphere also will not cease and the eye-sphere also is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0212] nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever in whatever plane the eye-sphere is not ceasing, for them in that plane will the form-sphere not cease?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ [M 1.0159] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere existence, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the form-base will cease. For formless beings, for them, there, both the eye-base is not ceasing and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the form-base will not cease, for them, there, is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, the form-base will not cease, but for them, there, the eye-base is ceasing. For formless beings, for them, there, both the form-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them, there, will the mind-base not cease?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for those without eyes who are passing away from the sense-sphere existence, and for formless beings, for them, there, the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, both the eye-base is not ceasing and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base will not cease, for them, there, is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, there, the eye-base is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, both the mind-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0233] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the eye-base is not ceasing, for them, there, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0213] tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn and for those without eyes who are passing away, for them, there, the eye-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless existence, for them, there, both the eye-base is not ceasing and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, there, is the eye-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them, there, the dhamma-base will not cease, but for them, there, the eye-base is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless existence, for them, there, both the dhamma-base will not cease and the eye-base is not ceasing. (Rooted in the Eye-Base)

181. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

181. For whomever, wherever the nose-base is not ceasing, for them, there, will the form-base not cease?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, for those without a nose who are passing away from the sense-sphere existence, and for beings in the form-sphere existence, for them, there, the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the form-sphere existence and for formless beings, for them, there, both the nose-base is not ceasing and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana [M 1.0160] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the form-base will not cease, for them, there, is the nose-base not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere existence, for them, there, the form-base will not cease, but for them, there, the nose-base is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the form-sphere existence and for formless beings, for them, there, both the form-base will not cease and the nose-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the nose-base is not ceasing, for them, there, will the mind-base not cease?

Kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ [V 1.0234] arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no [T 1.0214] ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, for those without a nose who are passing away from the sense-sphere existence, for beings in the form-sphere existence, and for beings in the formless-sphere existence, for them, there, the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the form-sphere and formless-sphere existences, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, both the nose-base is not ceasing and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base will not cease, for them, there, is the nose-base not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere existence, for them, there, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, there, the nose-base is ceasing. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the form-sphere and formless-sphere existences, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, both the mind-base will not cease and the nose-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever, wherever the nose-base is not ceasing, for them, there, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those without a nose who are passing away, for them, there, the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them, there, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the form-sphere and formless-sphere existences, for them, there, both the nose-base is not ceasing and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, there, is the nose-base not ceasing?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for them, in that realm, the mind-object-base will not cease, but for them, in that realm, the nose-base is ceasing. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the form-sphere and formless-sphere realms, for them, in that realm, both the mind-object-base will not cease and the nose-base is not ceasing. (The Nose-Base Section)

182. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

182. For a person for whom the form-base is not ceasing in a certain realm, for that person, in that realm, will the mind-base not cease?

Pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ [T 1.0215] na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ [V 1.0235] asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for them, in that realm, the form-base is not ceasing, but for them, in that realm, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the formless realm and for those being reborn into the non-percipient realm, for them, in that realm, both the form-base is not ceasing and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the mind-base will not cease in a certain realm, for that person, in that realm, is the form-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā [M 1.0161] cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for those who are passing away from the non-percipient existence, for them, in that existence, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, in that existence, the form-base is ceasing. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the formless existence and for those who are arising in the non-percipient existence, for them, in that existence, both the mind-base will not cease and the form-base is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person, in whichever existence, the form-base is not ceasing, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-object-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are arising and for formless beings who are passing away, for them, in that existence, the form-base is not ceasing, but for them, in that existence, the mind-object-base will cease. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the formless existence, for them, in that existence, both the form-base is not ceasing and the mind-object-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever existence, the mind-object-base will not cease, for that person, in that existence, is the form-base not ceasing?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them, in that existence, the mind-object-base will not cease, but for them, in that existence, the form-base is ceasing. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the formless existence, for them, in that existence, both the mind-object-base will not cease and the form-base is not ceasing. (The section rooted in the form-base)

183. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

183. For whichever person, in whichever existence, the mind-base is not ceasing, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-object-base not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

Or for whichever person, in whichever existence, the mind-object-base will not cease, for that person, in that existence, is the mind-base not ceasing? It is ceasing.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) The Section on the Past and Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Order: The Individual

184. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0236] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person the eye-base has ceased, for that person will the ear-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna—for them who are passing away, the eye-base has ceased, but for them the ear-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the eye-base has ceased and the ear-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

184. (b) Or for whom the ear-base will cease, for them has the eye-base ceased? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whom the eye-base has ceased, for them will the nose-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ [M 1.0162] tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those who, having arisen in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna—for them who are passing away, the eye-base has ceased, but for them the nose-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the eye-base has ceased and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(b) Or for whom...? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whom the eye-base has ceased, for them will the form-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna—for them who are passing away, the eye-base has ceased, but for them the form-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the eye-base has ceased and the form-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(b) Or for whom...? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the eye-base has ceased, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no [T 1.0217] ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati[V 1.0237]. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them the eye-base has ceased, but for them the mind-object-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the eye-base has ceased and the mind-object-base will cease. Or for whom...? Yes. (The Eye-Base Section)

185. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whom the nose-base has ceased, for them will the form-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna—for them who are passing away, the nose-base has ceased, but for them the form-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the nose-base has ceased and the form-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

185. (b) Or for whom...? Yes.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-base has ceased, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining Parinibbāna, for them the nose-base has ceased, but for them the mind-object-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the nose-base has ceased and the mind-object-base will cease.

Yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whom...? Yes.

186. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa manāyatana…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

186. For whom the form base has ceased, for them will the mind base... the phenomena base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, for them the form base has ceased, but for them the phenomena base will not cease. For the others, for them both the form base has ceased and the phenomena base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whom...? Yes.

187. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

187. For whom the mind base has ceased, for them will the phenomena base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ [T 1.0218] tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, for them the mind base has ceased, but for them the phenomena base will not cease. For the others, for them both the mind base has ceased and the phenomena base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whom...? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

Conformity (by way of) Realm

188. Yattha [V 1.0238][M 1.0163] cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha…pe….

188. Where the eye-base has ceased…etc.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

Conformity (by way of) Individuals and Realms

189. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

189. For whom the eye-base has ceased in a certain realm, for them will the ear-base cease in that realm?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the ear-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the eye-base has ceased there and the ear-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the ear-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the eye-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those arising in the Pure Abodes, for them the ear-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the ear-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person in whichever plane the eye-base has ceased, for that person in that plane will the nose-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere and for those in the form-sphere, for them the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the nose-base will not cease there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere, for them both the eye-base has ceased there and the nose-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the nose-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the eye-base ceased? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0219]?

For whichever person in whichever plane the eye-base has ceased, for that person in that plane will the form-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no [V 1.0239] ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the form-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the eye-base has ceased there and the form-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the form-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the eye-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those arising in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them the form-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the form-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person in whichever plane the eye-base has ceased, for that person in that plane will the mind-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [M 1.0164] cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the mind-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the eye-base has ceased there and the mind-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the mind-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the eye-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those arising in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them the mind-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person in whichever plane the eye-base has ceased, for that person in that plane will the phenomena-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ [T 1.0220] tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the phenomena-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the eye-base has ceased there and the phenomena-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the phenomena-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the eye-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ [V 1.0240] pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhittha. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those arising in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them the phenomena-base will cease there, but for them the eye-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the phenomena-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there. (Rooted in the Eye-Base)

190. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

190. For whichever person in whichever plane the nose-base has ceased, for that person in that plane will the form-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base has ceased there, but for them the form-base will not cease there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere, for them both the nose-base has ceased there and the form-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or alternatively, for whichever person in whichever plane the form-base will cease, for that person in that plane has the nose-base ceased?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those in the form-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the form-base will cease, but for them, in that plane of existence, the nose-base has not ceased. For those in the desire-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the form-base will cease and the nose-base has ceased.

Yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the nose-base has ceased, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the mind-base... the dhamma-base cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the desire-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the nose-base has ceased, but for them, in that plane of existence, the dhamma-base will not cease. For the other beings of the desire-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the nose-base has ceased and the dhamma-base will cease.

Yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the dhamma-base will cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, has the nose-base ceased?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ [T 1.0221] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Kāmāvacarānaṃ [M 1.0165] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhittha. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the dhamma-base will cease, but for them, in that plane of existence, the nose-base has not ceased. For those in the desire-sphere, for them, in that plane of existence, the dhamma-base will cease and the nose-base has ceased. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

191. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

191. For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the form-base has ceased, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the mind-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha[V 1.0241], no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane of existence, the form-base has ceased, but for them, in that plane of existence, the mind-base will not cease. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them, in that plane of existence, the form-base has ceased and the mind-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the mind-base will cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, has the form-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, the mind-base will cease there, but for them, the form-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them, both the mind-base will cease there and the form-base has ceased there.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the form-base has ceased, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the dhamma-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them, the form-base has ceased there, but for them, the dhamma-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the form-base has ceased there and the dhamma-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the dhamma-base will cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, has the form-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0222] tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nirujjhittha. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, the dhamma-base will cease there, but for them, the form-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, both the dhamma-base will cease there and the form-base has ceased there. (The section rooted in the form-base)

192. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

192. For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the mind-base has ceased, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the dhamma-base cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, the mind-base has ceased there, but for them, the dhamma-base will not cease there. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, both the mind-base has ceased there and the dhamma-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the dhamma-base will cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, has the mind-base ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ [V 1.0242] pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, the dhamma-base will cease there, but for them, the mind-base has not ceased there. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them, both the dhamma-base will cease there and the mind-base has ceased there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative (Analysis of) the Individual

193. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0166] cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

193. For whichever person the eye-base has not ceased, for that person will the ear-base not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or for whichever person the ear-base will not cease, for that person has the eye-base not ceased? It has ceased.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

For whichever person the eye-base... the nose-base... the form-base... the mind-base has not ceased, for that person will the dhamma-base not cease? There is not.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or for whichever person the dhamma-base will not cease, for that person has the mind-base not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative (Analysis of) the Plane of Existence

194. Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha…pe….

194. For whichever person the eye-base has not ceased...pe...

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative (Analysis of) the Individual and the Plane of Existence

195. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

195. For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the eye-base has not ceased, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the ear-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them the eye-base has not ceased there, but for them the ear-base will cease there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the eye-base has not ceased and the ear-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the ear-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, has the eye-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati[V 1.0243], no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the ear-base will not cease there, but the eye-base has ceased for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them there both the ear-base will not cease and the eye-base has not ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the nose-base not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the eye-base not ceased?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere plane and for those in the form-sphere plane, for them the nose-base will not cease in that plane, but for them the eye-base had ceased in that plane. For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless plane, for them in that plane both the nose-base will not cease and the eye-base had not ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the form-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0224] cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 1.0167] na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane the eye-base had not ceased, but for them in that plane the form-base will cease. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless plane, for them in that plane both the eye-base had not ceased and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the form-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the eye-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent plane, for them in that plane the form-base will not cease, but for them in that plane the eye-base had ceased. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless plane, for them in that plane both the form-base will not cease and the eye-base had not ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the mind-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ [V 1.0244] arūpe parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless plane, for them in that plane the eye-base had not ceased, but for them in that plane the mind-base will cease. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for those attaining Parinibbāna in the formless plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the eye-base had not ceased and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the mind-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the eye-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati, cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the mind-base will not cease there, but for them the eye-base had ceased there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for those attaining Parinibbāna in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the mind-base will not cease there and the eye-base had not ceased there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the eye-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the mind-object-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [T 1.0225] arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are arising in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them the eye-base had not ceased there, but for them the mind-object-base will cease there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining Parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them both the eye-base had not ceased there and the mind-object-base will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the mind-object-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the eye-base not ceased?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca na nirujjhittha. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for them the mind-object-base will not cease there, but for them the eye-base had ceased there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining Parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them both the mind-object-base will not cease there and the eye-base had not ceased there. (Rooted in the eye-base)

196. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

196. (Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the form-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati[M 1.0168].

For those of the form-sphere, for them the nose-base had not ceased there, but for them the form-base will cease there. For those attaining Parinibbāna in the form-sphere and for formless beings, for them both the nose-base had not ceased there and the form-base will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0245] vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the form-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the nose-base not ceased?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who attain Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for them the form-base will not cease in that realm, but for them the nose-base had ceased in that realm. For those who attain Parinibbāna in the form-sphere realm and for those in the formless realm, for them in that realm both the form-base will not cease and the nose-base had not ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the nose-base had not ceased, for them, in that plane will the mind-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0226] nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the form-sphere realm and the formless-sphere realm, for them the nose-base had not ceased in that realm, but for them the mind-base will cease in that realm. For those who attain Parinibbāna in the form-sphere realm and the formless-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that realm both the nose-base had not ceased and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane the mind-base will not cease, for them, in that plane had the nose-base not ceased?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who attain Parinibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for them the mind-base will not cease in that realm, but for them the nose-base had ceased in that realm. For those who attain Parinibbāna in the form-sphere realm and the formless-sphere realm, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that realm both the mind-base will not cease and the nose-base had not ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whichever person in whichever realm the nose-base did not cease, for that person in that realm will the dhamma-base not cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those of the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them the nose-base did not cease in that realm, but for them the dhamma-base will cease in that realm. For those who attain parinibbāna in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them in that realm both the nose-base did not cease and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

Or for whichever person in whichever realm the dhamma-base will not cease, for that person in that realm did the nose-base not cease?

Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhittha. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the sense-sphere, for them, in that realm, the dhamma-base will not cease, but for them, in that realm, the nose-base did cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the form-sphere and in the formless-sphere, for them, in that realm, both the dhamma-base will not cease and the nose-base did not cease. (The Nose-Base Section)

197. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0246] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

197. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever realm, the form-base did not cease, for that person, in that realm, will the mind-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ [T 1.0227] na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, in that realm, the form-base did not cease, but for them, in that realm, the mind-base will cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those who are attaining parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them, in that realm, both the form-base did not cease and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever realm, the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that realm, did the form-base not cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [M 1.0169] tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that realm, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, in that realm, the form-base did cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those who are attaining parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them, in that realm, both the mind-base will not cease and the form-base did not cease.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever realm, the form-base did not cease, for that person, in that realm, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are being reborn into the Pure Abodes and for formless beings, for them, in that realm, the form-base did not cease, but for them, in that realm, the dhamma-base will cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those who are attaining parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them, in that realm, both the form-base did not cease and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever realm, the dhamma-base will not cease, for that person, in that realm, did the form-base not cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhittha. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the five-aggregate existence, for them there the dhamma-base will not cease, but for them there the form-base did cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those who are attaining parinibbāna in the formless realm, for them there both the dhamma-base will not cease and the form-base did not cease. (The Form-Base Section)

198. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

198. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the mind-base did not cease, for them there will the dhamma-base not cease?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0228] manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha[V 1.0247], no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them there the mind-base did not cease, but for them there the dhamma-base will cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them there both the mind-base did not cease and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will not cease, for them there did the mind-base not cease?

Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who are attaining parinibbāna, for them there the dhamma-base will not cease, but for them there the mind-base did cease. For those who are attaining parinibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for them there both the dhamma-base will not cease and the mind-base did not cease.

Nirodhavāro.

The Cessation Section.

2. Pavatti 3. uppādanirodhavāro

2. Occurrence 3. The Section on Arising and Cessation.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Present Section.

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Person in Direct Order.

199. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

199. (Ka) For whomever the eye-base is arising, for them is the ear-base ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the ear-base is ceasing, for them is the eye-base arising? No.

Yassa [M 1.0170] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

For whomever the eye-base is arising, for them is the nose-base… the form-base… the mind-base… the dhamma-base ceasing? No.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? No …pe….

Or again, for whomever the dhamma-base is ceasing, for them is the eye-base arising? No… and so on….

200. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0248] manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

200. (Ka) For whomever the mind-base is arising, for them is the dhamma-base ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the dhamma-base is ceasing, for them is the mind-base arising? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Direct Order of Occasions.

201. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati…pe… (yatthakaṃ noti na kātabbaṃ, yatthakaṃ itaresaṃ yatthakānaṃ sadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, yatthakaṃ tīsupi vāresu sadisaṃ).

201. Where the eye-base arises... and so on... (The section on planes should not be answered with 'No'; this section on planes should be treated similarly to the other sections on planes; it is similar in all three sections).

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Individuals and Planes

202. Yassa [T 1.0229] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

202. For whom, where the eye-base is arising, for that person, there, is the ear-base ceasing? No.

Yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? No …pe….

Or again, for whom, where the ear-base is ceasing, for that person, there, is the eye-base arising? No... and so on...

203. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

203. (Ka) For whom, where the mind-base is arising, for that person, there, is the dhamma-base ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whom, where the dhamma-base is ceasing, for that person, there, is the mind-base arising? No.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual

204. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

204. (Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for that person, is the ear-base not ceasing?

Sasotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with the ear-base who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the ear-base is ceasing. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn and for those without the ear-base who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the ear-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the ear-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Asotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the ear-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those without the ear-base who are passing away and for those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0249][M 1.0171] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them is the nose-base not ceasing?

Saghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with the nose-base who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the nose-base is ceasing. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn and for those without the nose-base who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the nose-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the nose-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ [T 1.0230] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Aghānakānaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the nose-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those without the nose-base who are passing away and for those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them is the form-base not ceasing?

Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with form who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the form-base is ceasing. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn, and for those without form who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the form-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the form-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those without form who are passing away and for those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them is the mind-base not ceasing?

Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with mind who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn, and for those without mind who are passing away, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0250] vā pana manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?
