(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those without mind who are passing away and for those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them is the dhamma-base not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ [T 1.0231] cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base is ceasing. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the dhamma-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the dhamma-base is not ceasing, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those with the eye-base who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base is not ceasing, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those without the eye-base who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base is not ceasing and the eye-base is not arising. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

205. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0172] ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

205. (Ka) For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them is the form-base not ceasing?

Sarūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with form who are passing away, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the form-base is ceasing. For those without the nose-base who are being reborn, and for those without form who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the form-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base is not ceasing, for them is the nose-base not arising?

Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the nose-base who are being reborn, for them the form-base is not ceasing, but for them the nose-base is arising. For those without form who are passing away and for those without the nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is not ceasing and the nose-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them is the mind-base not ceasing?

Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ [V 1.0251] na nirujjhati. Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with mind who are passing away, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For those without the nose-base who are being reborn, and for those without mind who are passing away, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind-base is not ceasing, for them is the nose-base not arising?

Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ [T 1.0232] nuppajjati. Acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with the nose-base who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them the nose-base is arising. For those without mind who are passing away, and for those without the nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not ceasing and the nose-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them is the dhamma-base not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base is ceasing. For those without a nose who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the dhamma-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever being the dhamma-base is not ceasing, for that being is the nose-base not arising?

Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those with a nose who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base is not ceasing, but for them the nose-base is arising. For those without a nose who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base is not ceasing and the nose-base is not arising. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

206. (Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

206. (Ka) For whichever being the form-base is not arising, for that being is the mind-base not ceasing?

Sacittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ acittakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For those with mind who are passing away, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the mind-base is ceasing. For those without form who are being reborn and for those without mind who are passing away, for them both the form-base is not arising and the mind-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever being the mind-base is not ceasing, for that being is the form-base not arising?

Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Acittakānaṃ [M 1.0173] cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [V 1.0252] tesaṃ manāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with form who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not ceasing, but for them the form-base is arising. For those without mind who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not ceasing and the form-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whichever being the form-base is not arising, for that being is the dhamma-base not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati [T 1.0233] dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base is ceasing. For those without form who are being reborn, for them both the form-base is not arising and the dhamma-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever being the dhamma-base is not ceasing, for that being is the form-base not arising?

Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those with form who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base is not ceasing, but for them the form-base is arising. For those without form who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base is not ceasing and the form-base is not arising. (The section rooted in the form-base)

207. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

207. (Ka) For whichever being the mind-base is not arising, for that being is the dhamma-base not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati. Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, for them the mind-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base is ceasing. For those without mind who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base is not arising and the dhamma-base is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever being the dhamma-base is not ceasing, for that being is the mind-base not arising?

Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhati manāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those with mind who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base is not ceasing, but for them the mind-base is arising. For those without mind who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base is not ceasing and the mind-base is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Contrary Location

208. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

208. Where the eye-base is not arising… and so on….

209. Yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

209. For whom, where the eye-base is not arising… and so on….

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ).

(The section on individuals and the section on individuals and location are similar).

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Individual

210. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0253] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

210. (Ka) For whom the eye-base arose, for them did the ear-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā …pe….

(Kha) Or again, for whom the ear-base ceased, for them did the eye-base arise? Yes… and so on….

(Atītā [M 1.0174] pucchā uppādepi [T 1.0234] nirodhepi uppādanirodhepi anulomampi paccanīkampi sadisaṃ).

(The question on the past is similar in the arising section, the cessation section, and the arising-and-cessation section, for both the direct and the contrary sections).

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Section on the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Individual

211. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

211. To whatsoever person the eye-base will arise, to that person will the ear-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, to whatsoever person the ear-base will cease, to that person will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those who are being reborn into the formless existence after which they will attain Parinibbāna, for them the ear-base will cease, but for them the eye-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

To whatsoever person the eye-base will arise, to that person will the nose-base cease?

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ [V 1.0254] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are passing away, who will be reborn in the fine-material sphere and then attain Parinibbāna, for them the eye-base will arise, but for them the nose-base will not cease. For the others, for them both the eye-base will arise and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, to whatsoever person the nose-base will cease, to that person will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those who are being reborn, who will be reborn in the formless existence and then attain Parinibbāna, for them the nose-base will cease, but for them the eye-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the nose-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

To whatsoever person the eye-base will arise, to that person will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa [T 1.0235] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, to whatsoever person the form-base will cease, to that person will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, being reborn in the formless existence, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the form-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the form-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the eye-base will arise, for them will the mind-base... the phenomena-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whom the phenomena-base will cease, for them will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 1.0175] uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the phenomena-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the phenomena-base will cease and the eye-base will arise. (The Eye-Base Section)

212. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

212. (Ka) For whom the nose-base will arise, for them will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0255] vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base will cease, for them will the nose-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ upapajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the form-base will cease, but the nose-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the form-base will cease and the nose-base will arise.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the nose-base will arise, for them will the mind-base... the phenomena-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati [T 1.0236] tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whom the phenomena-base will cease, for them will the nose-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the phenomena-base will cease, but the nose-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the phenomena-base will cease and the nose-base will arise.

213. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

213. For whom the form-base will arise, for them will the mind-base... the phenomena-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whom the phenomena-base will cease, for them will the form-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, for them the phenomena-base will cease, but the form-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the phenomena-base will cease and the form-base will arise.

214. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

214. (Ka) For whom the mind-base will arise, for them will the phenomena-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the phenomena-base will cease, for them will the mind-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, for them the phenomena-base will cease, but the mind-base will not arise. For the others, for them both the phenomena-base will cease and the mind-base will arise.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Sphere of Conformity

215. Yattha [V 1.0256] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati…pe….

215. Where the eye-base will arise... and so on...

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity of Persons and Spheres

216. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0176] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

216. (Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever realm, the eye-base will arise, for them, in that realm, will the ear-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever realm, the ear-base will cease, for them, in that realm, will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no [T 1.0237] ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them there the ear-base will cease, but for them there the eye-base will not arise. For the others in the five-constituent existence, for them there both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever realm, the eye-base will arise, for them, in that realm, will the nose-base cease?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those in the fine-material sphere, for them there the eye-base will arise, but the nose-base will not cease. For those in the sense-sphere, for them there both the eye-base will arise and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever realm, the nose-base will cease, for them, in that realm, will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them there the nose-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise. For the others in the sense-sphere, for them there both the nose-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever realm the eye-base will arise, for them, in that realm, will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0257] vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever realm the form-base will cease, for them, in that realm, will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for non-percipient beings, for them there the form-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise. For the others in the five-constituent existence, for them there both the form-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever realm the eye-base will arise, for them, in that realm, will the mind-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ [T 1.0238] nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever realm the mind-base will cease, for them, in that realm, will the eye-base arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for formless beings, for them the mind-sphere will cease there, but the eye-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-sphere will cease there and the eye-sphere will arise there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever realm the eye-sphere will arise, for that person, in that realm, will the phenomena-sphere cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever realm the phenomena-sphere will cease, for that person, in that realm, will the eye-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0177] asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them the phenomena-sphere will cease there, but the eye-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the phenomena-sphere will cease there and the eye-sphere will arise there. (The Eye-Sphere Section)

217. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

217. (Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever existence the nose-sphere will arise, for that person, in that existence, will the form-sphere cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0258] vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever existence the form-sphere will cease, for that person, in that existence, will the nose-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, and for beings in the form-sphere existence, for them the form-sphere will cease there, but the nose-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere existence, for them both the form-sphere will cease there and the nose-sphere will arise there.

Yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ [T 1.0239]…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever, in whatsoever existence the nose-sphere will arise, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-sphere... the phenomena-sphere cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever existence the phenomena-sphere will cease, for that person, in that existence, will the nose-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, for beings in the form-sphere existence, and for beings in the formless-sphere existence, for them the phenomena-sphere will cease there, but the nose-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings in the sense-sphere existence, for them both the phenomena-sphere will cease there and the nose-sphere will arise there. (The Nose-Sphere Section)

218. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

218. (Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever existence the form-sphere will arise, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-sphere cease?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati manāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them the form-sphere will arise there, but the mind-sphere will not cease for them there. For beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the form-sphere will arise there and the mind-sphere will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever existence the mind-sphere will cease, for that person, in that existence, will the form-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for formless beings, for them the mind-sphere will cease there, but the form-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence, for them both the mind-sphere will cease there and the form-sphere will arise there.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0259] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever existence the form-sphere will arise, for that person, in that existence, will the phenomena-sphere cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever existence the phenomena-sphere will cease, for that person, in that existence, will the form-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0178] arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ [T 1.0240] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjissati. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for formless beings, for them the phenomena-sphere will cease there, but the form-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings of the five-constituent existence and for non-percipient beings, for them both the phenomena-sphere will cease there and the form-sphere will arise there. (The Form-Sphere Section)

219. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

219. (Ka) For whomever, in whatsoever existence the mind-sphere will arise, for that person, in that existence, will the phenomena-sphere cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever existence the phenomena-sphere will cease, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-sphere arise?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca uppajjissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for non-percipient beings, for them the phenomena-sphere will cease there, but the mind-sphere will not arise for them there. For the other beings of the four-constituent existence and the five-constituent existence, for them both the phenomena-sphere will cease there and the mind-sphere will arise there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: The Individual

220. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-sphere will not arise, for that person will the ear-sphere not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā [V 1.0260] parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

220. For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are being reborn, the eye-sphere will not arise, but the ear-sphere will cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having arisen in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-sphere will not arise and the ear-sphere will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the ear-sphere will not cease, for that person will the eye-sphere not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-sphere will not arise, for that person will the nose-sphere not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati[T 1.0241], no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are being reborn, the eye-base will not arise, but for them the nose-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their last existence in the form-sphere and formless-sphere realms, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-base will not arise and the nose-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

Or again, for whom the nose-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not arise?

Ye rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti [M 1.0179] tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those who, having been reborn in the form-sphere realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, the nose-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their last existence in the form-sphere and formless-sphere realms, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the nose-base will not cease and the eye-base will not arise.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the eye-base will not arise, for them will the form-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless existence, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are being reborn, the eye-base will not arise, but for them the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their last existence in the formless existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless existence, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-base will not arise and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0261] vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the form-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not arise? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the eye-base will not arise, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ [T 1.0242] upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless existence, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the eye-base will not arise, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the eye-base will not arise and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the eye-base not arise? Yes. (The section rooted in the eye-base.)

221. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

221. For whom the nose-base will not arise, for them will the form-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn in the five-constituent existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the form-sphere or formless-sphere realms, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are being reborn, the nose-base will not arise, but for them the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their last existence in the formless existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless existence, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the nose-base will not arise and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the form-base will not cease, for them will the nose-base not arise? Yes.

Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-base will not arise, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the form-sphere or formless-sphere realms, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the nose-base will not arise, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the nose-base will not arise and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the nose-base not arise? Yes.

222. Yassa [M 1.0180] rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

222. For whom the form-base will not arise, for them will the mind-base... the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ [V 1.0262] upapajjantānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ [T 1.0243] upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless existence, will attain final Nibbāna, for them the form-base will not arise, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the form-base will not arise and the mind-object-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the form-base not arise? Yes.

223. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

223. For whom the mind-base will not arise, for them will the mind-object-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn, for them the mind-base will not arise, but for them the mind-object-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the mind-base will not arise and the mind-object-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the mind-object-base will not cease, for them will the mind-base not arise? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: The Sphere

224. Yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati…pe….

In which plane the eye-base will not arise...

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: The Individual and Sphere

225. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

224. For whom, in whichever plane the eye-base will not arise, for them, in that plane, will the ear-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their last existence who are being reborn into the five-constituent existence, for them the eye-base will not arise there, but for them the ear-base will cease there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them both the eye-base will not arise there and the ear-base will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

225. Or again, for whom, in whichever plane the ear-base will not cease, for them, in that plane, will the eye-base not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom, in whichever plane the eye-base will not arise, for them, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0244] nirujjhissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [V 1.0263] arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the sense-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the nose-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, and the nose-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the eye-base not arise?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the form-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the eye-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those in their final existence in the form-sphere plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, and the eye-base will not arise.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0181] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the eye-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the form-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the five-constituent plane and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the eye-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the mind-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the five-constituent plane and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0245] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the eye-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ [V 1.0264] na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the five-constituent plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, the eye-base will not arise, and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes. (The section rooted in the eye-base)

226. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

226. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the nose-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the form-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the sense-sphere plane and for those in the form-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent plane and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the nose-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the mind-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the sense-sphere plane, for those in the form-sphere plane, and for those in the formless-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0182] yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the nose-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ [T 1.0246] arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the sense-sphere plane, for those in the form-sphere plane, and for those in the formless-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not arise, and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence... etc.? Yes. (The section rooted in the nose-base)

227. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0265] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

227. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the form-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the mind-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the five-constituent plane and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the form-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, the form-base will not arise, and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the form-base not arise?

Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati.

For non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the mind-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, the mind-base will not cease, and the form-base will not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever plane of existence the form-base will not arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are arising in the five-constituent plane and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, the form-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, the form-base will not arise, and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā. (Rūpāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane... and so on? Yes. (The section rooted in the form-base)

228. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ [T 1.0247] na nirujjhissatīti?

228. (a) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane, the mind-base will not arise, for them, in that plane, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjissati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the mind-base will not arise, but for them, in that plane, the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining Parinibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the mind-base will not arise and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane, the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, in that plane, will the mind-base not arise? Yes.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

4. The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Interrogation (Person)

229. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0266] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

229. (a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them has the ear-base ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti[M 1.0183]?

(b) Or for whomsoever the ear-base has ceased, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nirujjhittha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the ear-base has ceased, but for them the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base has ceased and the eye-base is arising.

(Yathā uppādavāre paccuppannātītā pucchā vibhattā evaṃ uppādanirodhepi paccuppannātītā pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhajitabbā vibhajitabbaṃ (sī syā. ka.) ).

(Just as the question concerning the present and past was analyzed in the Arising Section, so too, in the Arising-and-Cessation Section, should the question concerning the present and past be analyzed, both the forward and the negative.)

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

5. The Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Interrogation (Person)

230. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

230. (a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them will the ear-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or for whomsoever the ear-base will cease, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [V 1.0267] tesaṃ sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati [T 1.0248] cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the ear-base will cease, but for them the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them will the nose-base cease?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the fine-material sphere, for them the eye-base is arising, but for them the nose-base will not cease. For the other persons with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the eye-base is arising and the nose-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or for whomsoever the nose-base will cease, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them the nose-base will cease, but for them the eye-base is not arising. For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the nose-base will cease and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them will the form-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or for whomsoever the form-base will cease, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ…pe… sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them... and so on... For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the form-base will cease and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them will the mind-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti[M 1.0184]?

(b) Or for whomsoever the mind-base will cease, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ…pe… [T 1.0249] sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them... and so on... For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base will cease and the eye-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0268] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomsoever the eye-base is arising, for them will the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or for whomsoever the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the eye-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ…pe… sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without eyes who are being reborn, for them... and so on... For those with eyes who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the eye-base is arising.

231. Yassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

231. For whomsoever the nose-base is arising, for them will the form-base... and so on... the mind-base... the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whomsoever the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the nose-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without the nose-base who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will cease, but for them the nose-base is not arising. For those with the nose-base who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the nose-base is arising.

232. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

232. For whomsoever the form-base is arising, for them will the mind-base... and so on... the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whomsoever the dhamma-base will cease, for them is the form-base arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will cease, but for them the form-base is not arising. For those with form who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the form-base is arising.

233. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0250] manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

233. (a) For whomsoever the mind-base is arising, for them will the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…?

(b) Or for whomsoever the dhamma-base... and so on?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away and for those without consciousness who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will cease, but for them the mind-base is not arising. For those with consciousness who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease and the mind-base is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Direct Interrogation (Plane)

234. Yattha [V 1.0269] cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati…pe….

234. Where the eye-base is arising... etc.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Direct Order (Persons and Planes)

235. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

235. (Ka) For the person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane, for that person will the ear-base cease in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa [M 1.0185] tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for the person for whom the ear-base will cease in a certain plane, for that person is the eye-base arising in that plane?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them the ear-base will cease there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the ear-base will cease there and the eye-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane, will the nose-base cease for them in that plane?

Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn in the form-sphere, the eye-base is arising for them there, but the nose-base will not cease for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them both the eye-base is arising there and the nose-base will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the nose-base will cease in a certain plane, is the eye-base arising for them in that plane?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ [T 1.0251] acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them the nose-base will cease there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them both the nose-base will cease there and the eye-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane, will the form-base cease for them in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0270] vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the form-base will cease in a certain plane, is the eye-base arising for them in that plane?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those who are passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for non-percipient beings, for them the form-base will cease there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the form-base will cease there and the eye-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane, will the mind-base cease for them in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the mind-base will cease in a certain plane, is the eye-base arising for that person in that plane?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for formless beings, for them the mind-base will cease there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the mind-base will cease there and the eye-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom the eye-base is arising in a certain plane, will the dhamma-base cease for that person in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati [T 1.0252] tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the dhamma-base will cease in a certain plane, is the eye-base arising for that person in that plane?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 1.0186] uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca uppajjati. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away and for those without the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will cease there, but the eye-base is not arising for them there. For those with the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease there and the eye-base is arising there. (The Section on the Eye-Base)

236. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

236. For a person for whom the nose-base is arising in a certain plane, will the form-base cease for that person in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the form-base will cease in a certain plane, is the nose-base arising for that person in that plane?

Kāmāvacarā [V 1.0271] cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the form-sphere, for them the form-base will cease there, but the nose-base is not arising for them there. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the form-base will cease there and the nose-base is arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom the nose-base is arising in a certain plane, will the mind-base cease for that person in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ…pe…?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the mind-base... etc.?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ…pe… saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for those of the form-sphere, and for those of the formless-sphere, for them there the mind-base... etc. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them there both the mind-base will cease and the nose-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the nose-base arises, for them, there, will the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…[T 1.0253]?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base... etc.?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ…pe… saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati ghānāyatanañca uppajjati. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

For all those who are passing away, and for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them there the dhamma-base... etc. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them there both the dhamma-base will cease and the nose-base is arising. (The Section on the Nose-base)

237. (Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

237. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the form-base arises, for them, there, will the mind-base cease?

Asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha…pe… pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha…pe….

For those being reborn in the non-percipient plane, for them there the form-base arises, but the mind-base will not cease for them there. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them there both the form-base is arising and the mind-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ…pe…?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base... etc.?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha…pe… pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them there the mind-base will cease, but the form-base is not arising there. For those being reborn in the five-constituent existence, for them there both the mind-base will cease and the form-base is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the form-base arises, for them, there, will the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base... etc.?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [V 1.0272] tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all persons who are passing away, and for formless persons who are being reborn, for them there the dhamma-base will cease, but the form-base does not arise for them there. For persons with form who are being reborn, for them there both the dhamma-base will cease and the form-base arises.

238. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0187] yattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0254]? Āmantā.

238. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the mind-base arises, for them, there, will the dhamma-base cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the dhamma-base will cease, for them, there, does the mind-base arise?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanañca nirujjhissati manāyatanañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without consciousness who are being reborn, for them the dhamma-base will cease there, but the mind-base is not arising for them there. For those with consciousness who are being reborn, for them both the dhamma-base will cease there and the mind-base is arising.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: The Individual

239. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them will the ear-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

239. For all who are passing away, and for the eyeless who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the ear-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-base is not arising and the ear-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the ear-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them will the nose-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for the eyeless who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the nose-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the form realm or the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-base is not arising and the nose-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0273] vā pana ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the nose-base will not cease, for them is the eye-base not arising?

Pacchimabhavikānaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no [T 1.0255] ca tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the form realm, for them the nose-base will not cease, but for them the eye-base is arising. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the form realm or the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the nose-base will not cease and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them will the form-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ [M 1.0188] tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for the eyeless who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the form-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the eye-base is not arising and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base... etc.? Yes.

Yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the eye-base is not arising, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for the eyeless who are being reborn, for them the eye-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the eye-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom the dhamma-base... etc.? Yes. (Rooted in the eye-base.)

240. (Ka) yassa ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them will the form-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca [T 1.0256] na nirujjhissati.

240. For all who are passing away, and for the noseless who are being reborn, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the form-base will cease.
