For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, for them who are passing away, both the nose-base is not arising and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the form-base... etc.? Yes.

Yassa [V 1.0274] ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the nose-base is not arising, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them the nose-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the nose-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or, for whom the dhamma-base... etc.? Yes. (Rooted in the nose-base.)

241. Yassa rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa manāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the form-base is not arising, for them will the mind-base... etc... the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

241. For all who are passing away, and for formless beings who are being reborn, for them the form-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the form-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

Yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ…pe…? Āmantā.

Or, for whom the dhamma-base... etc.? Yes.

242. (Ka) yassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the mind-base is not arising, for them will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without mind who are being reborn, for them the mind-base is not arising, but for them the dhamma-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, for them both the mind-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or, for whom the dhamma-base will not cease, for him is the mind-base not arising? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative Plane

243. Yattha [M 1.0189] cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

243. Where the eye-base is not arising… etc….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: Person-Plane

244. (Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

244. (Ka) For whom, in which plane, the eye-base is not arising, for that person, in that plane, will the ear-base not cease?

Pañcavokārā [V 1.0275] cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha sotāyatanaṃ [T 1.0257] na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati sotāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence, and for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for them, in that plane, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the ear-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base is not arising and the ear-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for which person, in which plane, the ear-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, is the eye-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For which person, in which plane, the eye-base is not arising, for that person, in that plane, will the nose-base not cease?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are passing away from the sense-sphere plane, and for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the nose-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for those passing away from the form-sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base is not arising and the nose-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for which person, in which plane, the nose-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, is the eye-base not arising?

Rūpāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Kāmāvacare parinibbantānaṃ rūpāvacarā cavantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca na nirujjhissati cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those who are being reborn in the form-sphere plane, for them, in that plane, the nose-base will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the eye-base is arising. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere plane, for those who are passing away from the form-sphere plane, for non-percipient beings, and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base will not cease and the eye-base is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For which person, in which plane, the eye-base is not arising, for that person, in that plane, will the form-base not cease?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca na [T 1.0258] nirujjhissati.

For those who are passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for formless beings, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base is not arising and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for which person, in which plane, the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that plane, is the eye-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0276] yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For which person, in which plane, the eye-base is not arising, for that person, in that plane, will the mind-base not cease?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ [M 1.0190] tasaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who are passing away from the five-constituent existence, for those without the eye who are being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, and for those in the formless existence—for them, in that plane, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna and for those in the non-percipient existence—for them, in that plane, both the eye-base is not arising and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever existence, the mind-base will not cease, for that person, in that existence, is the eye-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever existence, the eye-base is not arising, for that person, in that existence, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cakkhāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without the eye who are being reborn, for them, in that plane, the eye-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the dhamma-base will cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, for them, in that plane, both the eye-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Cakkhāyatanamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever existence, the dhamma-base will not cease, for that person, in that existence, is the eye-base not arising? Yes. (The Eye-Base Section)

245. (Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

245. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever existence, the nose-base is not arising, for that person, in that existence, will the form-base not cease?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati rūpāyatanañca na nirujjhissati[T 1.0259].

For those who are passing away from the sense-sphere existence, for those without the nose who are being reborn into the sense-sphere existence, and for those in the fine-material existence—for them, in that plane, the nose-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the form-base will cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the five-constituent existence and for those in the formless existence—for them, in that plane, both the nose-base is not arising and the form-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha rūpāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whichever person, in whichever existence, the form-base will not cease, for that person, in that existence, is the nose-base not arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever existence, the nose-base is not arising, for that person, in that existence, will the mind-base not cease?

Kāmāvacarā cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ upapajjantānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ [V 1.0277] arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those without the faculty of smell who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for those in the form-sphere, and for those in the formless-sphere, for them, in that plane, the nose-base is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the mind-base will cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the nose-base is not arising and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, wherever the mind-base will not cease, for them, is the nose-base not arising there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the nose-base is not arising, for them, will the dhamma-base not cease there?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha ghānāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, and for those without the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them the nose-base does not arise there, but for them the dhamma-base will cease there. For those attaining Parinibbāna, for them, there, both the nose-base does not arise and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha ghānāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Ghānāyatanamūlakaṃ)

Or again, for whom, wherever the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, there, does the nose-base not arise? Yes. (Rooted in the Nose-Base)

246. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0191] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

246. For whom, wherever the form-base does not arise, for them, there, will the mind-base not cease?

Pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For those passing away from the five-constituent existence and for those of the formless realm, for them the form-base does not arise there, but for them the mind-base will cease there. For those attaining Parinibbāna and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, for them, there, both the form-base does not arise and the mind-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha manāyatanaṃ [T 1.0260] na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, wherever the mind-base will not cease, for them, there, does the form-base not arise?

Asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati. Parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca na nirujjhissati rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati.

For those being reborn into the non-percipient existence, for them the mind-base will not cease there, but for them the form-base does arise there. For those attaining Parinibbāna and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, for them, there, both the mind-base will not cease and the form-base does not arise.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0278] yattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom, wherein the form-base is not arising, for them, therein, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha rūpāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without form who are being reborn, for them, therein, the form-base is not arising, but for them, therein, the dhamma-base will cease. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them, therein, both the form-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha rūpāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom, wherein the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, therein, is the form-base not arising? Yes.

247. (Ka) yassa yattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

247. For whom, wherein the mind-base is not arising, for them, therein, will the dhamma-base not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati. Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha manāyatanañca nuppajjati dhammāyatanañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away and for those without mind who are being reborn, for them, therein, the mind-base is not arising, but for them, therein, the dhamma-base will cease. For those who are attaining Parinibbāna, for them, therein, both the mind-base is not arising and the dhamma-base will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha dhammāyatanaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha manāyatanaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom, wherein the dhamma-base will not cease, for them, therein, is the mind-base not arising? Yes.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) The Section on the Past and Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Direct Order: Person

248. (Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

248. For whom the eye-base has arisen, for them will the ear-base cease?

Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ arūpe pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca [T 1.0261] arūpaṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca uppajjittha sotāyatanañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are attaining Parinibbāna in the five-constituent existence, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those passing away who, having been reborn into the formless plane, will attain Parinibbāna—for them, the eye-base has arisen, but for them the ear-base will not cease. For the others, for them, both the eye-base has arisen and the ear-base will cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0279] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cakkhāyatanaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the ear-base will cease, for them has the eye-base arisen? Yes.

(Yathā [M 1.0192] nirodhavāre atītānāgatā atītenānāgatā (syā.) pucchā yassakampi yatthakampi yassayatthakampi anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhattaṃ, evaṃ uppādanirodhepi atītānāgatā pucchā vibhajitabbā.)

(Just as in the Cessation Section the past-and-future questions regarding 'for whom,' 'wherein,' 'for whom and wherein,' both in direct order and reverse order, have been analyzed, so too should the past-and-future questions be analyzed in the Arising and Cessation Section.)

Uppādanirodhavāro.

The Arising and Cessation Section.

Pavattivāro niṭṭhito.

The Occurrence Section is finished.

3. Pariññāvāro

3. The Section on Full Understanding

1. Paccuppannavāro

1. The Section on the Present

249. (Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ parijānātīti? Āmantā.

249. Does one who comprehends the eye-base also comprehend the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānāti so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Or again, does one who comprehends the ear-base also comprehend the eye-base? Yes.

(Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Does one who does not comprehend the eye-base also not comprehend the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na parijānāti so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānātīti? Āmantā.

Or again, does one who does not comprehend the ear-base also not comprehend the eye-base? Yes.

2. Atītavāro

2. The Section on the Past

250. (Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānittha so sotāyatanaṃ parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

250. Has one who has comprehended the eye-base also comprehended the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo [V 1.0280] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānittha so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, has one who has comprehended the ear-base also comprehended the eye-base? Yes.

(Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānittha so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Has one who has not comprehended the eye-base also not comprehended the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na [T 1.0262] parijānittha so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, has one who has not comprehended the ear-base also not comprehended the eye-base? Yes.

3. Anāgatavāro

3. The Section on the Future

251. (Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānissati so sotāyatanaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

251. Will one who will comprehend the eye-base also comprehend the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, will one who will comprehend the ear-base also comprehend the eye-base? Yes.

(Ka) yo [M 1.0193] cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānissati so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Will one who will not comprehend the eye-base also not comprehend the ear-base? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānissatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, will one who will not comprehend the ear-base also not comprehend the eye-base? Yes.

4. Paccuppannātītavāro

4. The Section on the Present and the Past

252. (Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ parijānitthāti? No.

252. Has one who comprehends the eye-base also comprehended the ear-base? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānittha so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānātīti? No.

Or again, does one who has comprehended the ear-base also comprehend the eye-base? No.

(Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānitthāti?

Has one who does not comprehend the eye-base also not comprehended the ear-base?

Arahā cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti, no ca sotāyatanaṃ na parijānittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā cakkhāyatanañca na parijānanti sotāyatanañca na parijānittha.

The Arahant does not fully comprehend the eye-base, but he has fully comprehended the ear-base. Setting aside the one endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons do not fully comprehend the eye-base and have not fully comprehended the ear-base.

(Kha) yo [V 1.0281] vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na parijānittha so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānātīti?

Or again, he who has not fully comprehended the ear-base, does he not fully comprehend the eye-base?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī sotāyatanaṃ na parijānittha, no ca cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā sotāyatanañca na parijānittha cakkhāyatanañca na parijānanti.

The one endowed with the highest path has not fully comprehended the ear-base, but does fully comprehend the eye-base. Setting aside the one endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons have not fully comprehended the ear-base and do not fully comprehend the eye-base.

5. Paccuppannānāgatavāro

5. The Section on the Present and the Future

253. (Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ parijānissatīti? No.

253. He who fully comprehends the eye-base, will he fully comprehend the ear-base? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānātīti? No.

Or again, he who will fully comprehend the ear-base, does he fully comprehend the eye-base? No.

(Ka) yo cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissatīti?

He who does not fully comprehend the eye-base, will he not fully comprehend the ear-base?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānanti[T 1.0263], no ca sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissanti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te cakkhāyatanañca na parijānanti sotāyatanañca na parijānissanti.

Those who will attain the path do not fully comprehend the eye-base, but they will fully comprehend the ear-base. The Arahant and those ordinary persons who will not attain the path neither fully comprehend the eye-base nor will they fully comprehend the ear-base.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānātīti?

Or again, he who will not fully comprehend the ear-base, does he not fully comprehend the eye-base?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissati, no ca cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānāti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te sotāyatanañca na parijānissanti cakkhāyatanañca na parijānanti.

The one endowed with the highest path will not fully comprehend the ear-base, but does fully comprehend the eye-base. The Arahant and those ordinary persons who will not attain the path will neither fully comprehend the ear-base nor do they fully comprehend the eye-base.

6. Atītānāgatavāro

6. The Section on the Past and Future

254. (Ka) yo [M 1.0194] cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānittha so sotāyatanaṃ parijānissatīti? No.

254. He who has fully comprehended the eye-base, will he fully comprehend the ear-base? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ parijānitthāti? No.

Or again, he who will fully comprehend the ear-base, has he fully comprehended the eye-base? No.

(Ka) yo [V 1.0282] cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānittha so sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissatīti?

He who has not fully comprehended the eye-base, will he not fully comprehend the ear-base?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānittha, no ca sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissanti. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te cakkhāyatanañca na parijānittha sotāyatanañca na parijānissanti.

Those who will attain the path have not fully comprehended the eye-base, but they will fully comprehend the ear-base. The one endowed with the highest path and those ordinary persons who will not attain the path have neither fully comprehended the eye-base nor will they fully comprehend the ear-base.

(Kha) yo vā pana sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissati so cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānitthāti?

Or again, he who will not fully comprehend the ear-base, has he not fully comprehended the eye-base?

Arahā sotāyatanaṃ na parijānissati, no ca cakkhāyatanaṃ na parijānittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te sotāyatanañca na parijānissanti cakkhāyatanañca na parijānittha.

An Arahant will not fully comprehend the ear-base, but he has fully comprehended the eye-base. The one endowed with the highest path and those ordinary persons who will not attain the path will not fully comprehend the ear-base, and they have not fully comprehended the eye-base.

Pariññāvāro.

The Chapter on Full Comprehension.

Āyatanayamakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Yamaka on the Bases is concluded.

Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa

Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One.

The Section of Exposition on Designations.

1. Padasodhanavāro

1. The Section on the Analysis of Terms.

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(a) Positive

10. (Ka) cakkhu [V 1.0289] cakkhudhātūti?

10. (a) Is the eye the eye-element?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhudhātu. Cakkhudhātu cakkhu ceva cakkhudhātu ca.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are the 'eye', but not the 'eye-element'. The eye-element is both the 'eye' and the 'eye-element'.

(Kha) cakkhudhātu cakkhūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the eye-element the eye? Yes.

(Ka) sotaṃ sotadhātūti?

(a) Is the ear the ear-element?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ sotaṃ, na sotadhātu. Sotadhātu sotañceva sotadhātu ca.

The divine ear and the ear of craving are the 'ear', but not the 'ear-element'. The ear-element is both the 'ear' and the 'ear-element'.

(Kha) sotadhātu sotanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the ear-element the ear? Yes.

(Ka) ghānaṃ ghānadhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the nose the nose-element? Yes.

(Kha) ghānadhātu ghānanti? Āmantā. (Jivhāpi ghānadhātusadisā).

(b) Is the nose-element the nose? Yes. (The tongue is also similar to the nose-element.)

(Ka) kāyo kāyadhātūti?

(a) Is the body the body-element?

Kāyadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso kāyo avaseso kāyo kāyo (syā.), na kāyadhātu. Kāyadhātu kāyo [T 1.0267] ceva kāyadhātu ca.

Excluding the body-element, the remainder is the body, but not the body-element. The body-element is both the body and the body-element.

(Kha) kāyadhātu kāyoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the body-element the body? Yes.

(Ka) rūpaṃ rūpadhātūti?

(a) Is form the form-element?

Rūpadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ rūpaṃ, na rūpadhātu. Rūpadhātu rūpañceva rūpadhātu ca.

Excluding the form-element, the remainder is form, but not the form-element. The form-element is both form and the form-element.

(Kha) rūpadhātu rūpanti? Āmantā. (Saddo ghānasadiso).

(b) Is the form-element form? Yes. (The case of sound is similar to that of the nose.)

(Ka) gandho [V 1.0290][M 1.0199] gandhadhātūti?

(a) Is odour the odour-element?

Sīlagandho samādhigandho paññāgandho gandho, na gandhadhātu. Gandhadhātu gandho ceva gandhadhātu ca.

The odour of virtue, the odour of concentration, and the odour of wisdom are odour, but not the odour-element. The odour-element is both odour and the odour-element.

(Kha) gandhadhātu gandhoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the odour-element odour? Yes.

(Ka) raso rasadhātūti?

(a) Is taste the taste-element?

Attharaso dhammaraso vimuttiraso raso, na rasadhātu. Rasadhātu raso ceva rasadhātu ca.

The taste of the meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation are taste, but not the taste-element. The taste-element is both taste and the taste-element.

(Kha) rasadhātu rasoti? Āmantā. (Phoṭṭhabbo ghānasadiso).

(b) Is the taste-element taste? Yes. (The case of the tangible is similar to that of the nose.)

(Ka) cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇadhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is eye-consciousness the eye-consciousness-element? Yes.

(Kha) cakkhuviññāṇadhātu cakkhuviññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the eye-consciousness-element eye-consciousness? Yes.

Sotaviññāṇaṃ…pe… ghānaviññāṇaṃ… jivhāviññāṇaṃ… kāyaviññāṇaṃ….

Ear-consciousness… and so forth… nose-consciousness… tongue-consciousness… body-consciousness….

(Ka) mano manodhātūti?

(a) Is mind the mind-element?

Manodhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso mano, na manodhātu. Manodhātu mano ceva manodhātu ca.

Excluding the mind-element, the remainder is mind, but not the mind-element. The mind-element is both mind and the mind-element.

(Kha) manodhātu manoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the mind-element mind? Yes.

(Ka) manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is mind-consciousness the mind-consciousness-element? Yes.

(Kha) manoviññāṇadhātu manoviññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the mind-consciousness-element mind-consciousness? Yes.

(Ka) dhammo dhammadhātūti?

(a) Is a mental-object the mental-object-element?

Dhammadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso dhammo, na dhammadhātu. Dhammadhātu dhammo ceva dhammadhātu ca.

Excluding the mental-object-element, the remainder is a mental-object, but not the mental-object-element. The mental-object-element is both a mental-object and the mental-object-element.

(Kha) dhammadhātu dhammoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the mental-object-element a mental-object? Yes.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(Kha) Negative

11. (Ka) na [V 1.0291] cakkhu na cakkhudhātūti? Āmantā.

11. (Ka) Is that which is not the eye also not the eye-element? Yes.

(Kha) na cakkhudhātu na cakkhūti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the eye-element also not the eye?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu na cakkhudhātu, cakkhu. Cakkhuñca cakkhudhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva cakkhu na ca cakkhudhātu.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are the eye, but not the eye-element. Excluding both the eye and the eye-element, the remainder is neither the eye nor the eye-element.

(Ka) na sotaṃ na [T 1.0268] sotadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not the ear also not the ear-element? Yes.

(Kha) na sotadhātu na sotanti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the ear-element also not the ear?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ na sotadhātu, sotaṃ. Sotañca sotadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva sotaṃ na ca sotadhātu.

The divine ear and the ear of craving are not the ear-element, but they are the ear. Excluding both the ear and the ear-element, the remainder is neither the ear nor the ear-element.

(Ka) na [M 1.0200] ghānaṃ na ghānadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not the nose also not the nose-element? Yes.

(Kha) na ghānadhātu na ghānanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not the nose-element also not the nose? Yes.

Na jivhā… (saṃkhittaṃ yaṃ saṃkhittaṃ (syā.), ubhato āmantā).

Not the tongue... (This is abbreviated; in both cases, the answer is 'Yes').

(Ka) na kāyo na kāyadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not the body also not the body-element? Yes.

(Kha) na kāyadhātu na kāyoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the body-element also not the body?

Kāyadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na kāyadhātu, kāyo. Kāyañca kāyadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avaseso avaseso kāyo (syā.) na ceva kāyo na ca kāyadhātu.

Excluding the body-element, the remainder is not the body-element, but it is the body. Excluding both the body and the body-element, the remainder is neither the body nor the body-element.

(Ka) na rūpaṃ na rūpadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not form also not the form-element? Yes.

(Kha) na rūpadhātu na rūpanti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the form-element also not form?

Rūpadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na rūpadhātu, rūpaṃ. Rūpañca rūpadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva rūpaṃ na ca rūpadhātu.

Excluding the form-element, the remainder is not the form-element, but it is form. Excluding both form and the form-element, the remainder is neither form nor the form-element.

Na saddo…pe… na gandho na gandhadhātūti? Āmantā.

Not sound... and so on... (Ka) Is that which is not odour also not the odour-element? Yes.

Na gandhadhātu na gandhoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the odour-element also not odour?

Sīlagandho samādhigandho paññāgandho na gandhadhātu, gandho. Gandhañca gandhadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva gandho na ca gandhadhātu.

The odour of virtue, the odour of concentration, and the odour of wisdom are not the odour-element, but they are odour. Excluding both odour and the odour-element, the remainder is neither odour nor the odour-element.

(Ka) na [V 1.0292] raso na rasadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not taste also not the taste-element? Yes.

(Kha) na rasadhātu na rasoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the taste-element also not taste?

Attharaso dhammaraso vimuttiraso na rasadhātu, raso. Rasañca rasadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva raso na ca rasadhātu.

The taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation are not the taste-element, but they are taste. Excluding both taste and the taste-element, the remainder is neither taste nor the taste-element.

Na phoṭṭhabbo…pe… na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na cakkhuviññāṇadhātūti? Āmantā.

Not the tangible... and so on... (Ka) Is that which is not eye-consciousness also not the eye-consciousness-element? Yes.

Na cakkhuviññāṇadhātu na cakkhuviññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not the eye-consciousness-element also not eye-consciousness? Yes.

Na sotaviññāṇaṃ…pe… na ghānaviññāṇaṃ… na jivhāviññāṇaṃ… na kāyaviññāṇaṃ….

Not ear-consciousness... and so on... not nose-consciousness... not tongue-consciousness... not body-consciousness...

(Ka) na mano na manodhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not mind also not the mind-element? Yes.

(Kha) na manodhātu na manoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the mind-element also not mind?

Manodhātuṃ ṭhapetvā [T 1.0269] avaseso na manodhātu, mano. Manañca manodhātuñca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva mano na ca manodhātu.

Excluding the mind-element, the remainder is not the mind-element, but it is mind. Excluding both mind and the mind-element, the remainder is neither mind nor the mind-element.

(Ka) na manoviññāṇaṃ na manoviññāṇadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not mind-consciousness also not the mind-consciousness-element? Yes.

(Kha) na manoviññāṇadhātu na manoviññāṇanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not the mind-consciousness-element also not mind-consciousness? Yes.

(Ka) na dhammo na dhammadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not a dhamma also not the dhamma-element? Yes.

(Kha) na dhammadhātu na dhammoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not the dhamma-element also not a dhamma?

Dhammadhātuṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na dhammadhātu, dhammo. Dhammañca dhammadhātuñca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva dhammo na ca dhammadhātu.

Excluding the dhamma-element, the remainder is a dhamma, but not the dhamma-element. Excluding both the dhamma and the dhamma-element, the remainder is neither a dhamma nor a dhamma-element.

2. Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

2. The Root Cycle on the Analysis of Terms

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(Ka) Positive

12. (Ka) cakkhu [M 1.0201] cakkhudhātūti?

12. (Ka) Is the eye the eye-element?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhudhātu. Cakkhudhātu cakkhu ceva cakkhudhātu ca.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are eyes, but not the eye-element. The eye-element is both an eye and the eye-element.

(Kha) dhātū [V 1.0293] sotadhātūti?

(Kha) Is an element the ear-element?

Sotadhātu dhātu ceva sotadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū avasesā dhātū dhātū (syā.) na sotadhātu.

The ear-element is both an element and the ear-element. The remaining elements are not the ear-element.

(Ka) cakkhu cakkhudhātūti?

(Ka) Is the eye the eye-element?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhudhātu. Cakkhudhātu cakkhu ceva cakkhudhātu ca. Dhātū ghānadhātu…pe… dhātū dhammadhātūti?

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are eyes, but not the eye-element. The eye-element is both an eye and the eye-element. Is an element the nose-element? ... Is an element the dhamma-element?

Dhammadhātu dhātu ceva dhammadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na dhammadhātu.

The dhamma-element is both an element and the dhamma-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the dhamma-element.

(Yathā āyatanayamake paṇṇatti evaṃ dhātuyamakepi paṇṇatti. Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ).

(As is the exposition in the pair on the sense-bases, so also is the exposition in the pair on the elements. The wheel should be constructed).

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

13. (Ka) na cakkhu na cakkhudhātūti? Āmantā.

13. (a) Is that which is not the eye, not the eye-element? Yes.

(Kha) na dhātū na sotadhātūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not an element, not the ear-element? Yes.

Na cakkhu na cakkhudhātūti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not the eye, not the eye-element? Yes.

Na dhātū na ghānadhātu…pe… na dhātū na dhammadhātūti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not an element, not the nose-element? ... Is that which is not an element, not the dhamma-element? Yes.

(Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ, sabbe āmantā ubhatopi sesepi).

(The wheel should be constructed; all are 'yes' in both cases and in the remainder).

3. Suddhadhātuvāro

3. The Section on Pure Elements

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(a) Direct Order

14. (Ka) cakkhu [T 1.0270] dhātūti? Āmantā.

14. (a) Is the eye an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū cakkhudhātūti?

(b) Is an element the eye-element?

Cakkhudhātu dhātu ceva cakkhudhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na cakkhudhātu.

The eye-element is both an element and the eye-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the eye-element.

Sotaṃ dhātūti? Āmantā.

Is the ear an element? Yes.

Ghānaṃ…pe… jivhā… kāyo… rūpaṃ… saddo… gandho… raso… phoṭṭhabbo….

Nose ... tongue ... body ... form ... sound ... smell ... taste ... tangible object ...

(Ka) cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is eye-consciousness an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū cakkhuviññāṇadhātūti?

(b) Is an element the eye-consciousness-element?

Cakkhuviññāṇadhātu dhātu ceva cakkhuviññāṇadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū [V 1.0294] na [M 1.0202] cakkhuviññāṇadhātu. Sotaviññāṇaṃ…pe… ghānaviññāṇaṃ… jivhāviññāṇaṃ… kāyaviññāṇaṃ….

The eye-consciousness-element is both an element and the eye-consciousness-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the eye-consciousness-element. Ear-consciousness ... nose-consciousness ... tongue-consciousness ... body-consciousness ...

(Ka) mano dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is mind an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū manodhātūti?

(b) Is an element the mind-element?

Manodhātu dhātu ceva manodhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na manodhātu.

The mind-element is both an element and the mind-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the mind-element.

(Ka) manoviññāṇaṃ dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is mind-consciousness an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū manoviññāṇadhātūti?

(b) Is an element the mind-consciousness-element?

Manoviññāṇadhātu dhātu ceva manoviññāṇadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na manoviññāṇadhātu.

The mind-consciousness-element is both an element and the mind-consciousness-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the mind-consciousness-element.

(Ka) dhammo dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is a dhamma an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū dhammadhātūti?

(b) Is an element the dhamma-element?

Dhammadhātu dhātu ceva dhammadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na dhammadhātu.

The dhamma-element is both an element and the dhamma-element. The remaining phenomena are elements, but not the dhamma-element.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

15. (Ka) na cakkhu na dhātūti?

15. (a) Is that which is not the eye not an element?

Cakkhuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā dhātū na cakkhu, dhātu. Cakkhuñca dhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca dhātū.

Setting aside the eye, the remaining elements are not the eye, but they are an element. Setting aside both the eye and the elements, the remaining phenomena are neither the eye nor an element.

(Kha) na dhātū na cakkhūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not an element not the eye? Yes.

Na sotaṃ na dhātūti?

Is that which is not the ear not an element?

Sotaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… ghānaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… jivha ṭhapetvā…pe….

Setting aside the ear... and so on... setting aside the nose... and so on... setting aside the tongue... and so on...

(Ka) na kāyo na dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the body not an element? Yes.

(Kha) na dhātū na kāyadhātūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not an element not the body-element? Yes.

Na rūpaṃ na dhātūti?

Is that which is not form not an element?

Rūpaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… saddaṃ… gandhaṃ… rasaṃ… phoṭṭhabbaṃ… cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… [T 1.0271] manoviññāṇaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe….

Setting aside form... and so on... sound... smell... taste... the tangible object... eye-consciousness... and so on... setting aside mind-consciousness... and so on...

(Ka) na [V 1.0295] dhammo na dhātūti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not a dhamma not an element? Yes.

(Kha) na dhātū na dhammadhātūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not an element not the dhamma-element? Yes.

4. Suddhadhātumūlacakkavāro

4. Section of the Root Cycle of Pure Elements

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(Ka) Direct Order

16. (Ka) cakkhu dhātūti? Āmantā.

16. (Ka) Is the eye an element? Yes.

(Kha) dhātū sotadhātūti?

(Kha) Is an element the ear-element?

Sotadhātu dhātu ceva sotadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na sotadhātu.

The ear-element is both an element and the ear-element. The remaining are elements, but they are not the ear-element.

Cakkhu dhātūti? Āmantā.

Is the eye an element? Yes.

Dhātū ghānadhātu…pe… dhātū dhammadhātūti?

Is an element the nose-element? ...and so on... Is an element the dhamma-element?

Dhammadhātu dhātu ceva dhammadhātu ca. Avasesā dhātū na dhammadhātu. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ).

The dhamma-element is both an element and the dhamma-element. The remaining are elements, but they are not the dhamma-element. (The wheel should be constructed).

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(Kha) Negative

17. (Ka) na [M 1.0203] cakkhu na dhātūti?

17. (Ka) Is that which is not the eye, not an element?

Cakkhuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā dhātū na cakkhudhātu. Cakkhuñca dhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca dhātu.

Setting aside the eye, the remaining elements are not the eye-element. Setting aside both the eye and the elements, the remaining phenomena are neither the eye nor an element.

(Kha) na dhātū na sotadhātūti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not an element, not the ear-element? Yes.

Na cakkhu na dhātūti?

Is that which is not the eye, not an element?

Cakkhuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā dhātū na cakkhu, dhātu. Cakkhu ca dhātuñca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca dhātu. Na dhātū na ghānadhātu…pe… na dhātū na dhammadhātūti? Āmantā.

Setting aside the eye, the remaining elements are not the eye, but are elements. Setting aside both the eye and the elements, the remaining phenomena are neither the eye nor an element. Is that which is not an element, not the nose-element? ...and so on... Is that which is not an element, not the dhamma-element? Yes.

(Ka) na dhammo na dhātūti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not a dhamma, not an element? Yes.

(Kha) na dhātū na cakkhudhātūti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is not an element, not the eye-element? Yes.

Na dhammo na dhātūti? Āmantā.

Is that which is not a dhamma, not an element? Yes.

Na [V 1.0296] dhātū na sotadhātu…pe… na dhātū na manoviññāṇadhātūti? Āmantā. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ).

Is that which is not an element, not the ear-element? ...and so on... Is that which is not an element, not the mind-consciousness-element? Yes. (The wheel should be constructed).

(Yathā āyatanayamakassa paṇṇatti evaṃ dhātuyamakassa paṇṇatti vitthāretabbā)

As is the chapter on concepts (Paṇṇattivāra) of the Āyatanayamaka, so should the chapter on concepts of the Dhātuyamaka be elaborated.

Paṇṇattiniddesavāro.

The Chapter on the Exposition of Concepts

2. Pavattivāro 1. uppādavāro

2. Chapter on Occurrence 1. Chapter on Arising

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) Chapter on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Order (Individual)

18. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0272] cakkhudhātu uppajjati tassa sotadhātu uppajjatīti?

18. (Ka) For whomever the eye-element is arising, for that person is the ear-element arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotadhātu uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati sotadhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with eyes but without ears, for them the eye-element is arising, but the ear-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with eyes and with ears, for them both the eye-element is arising and the ear-element is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotadhātu uppajjati tassa cakkhudhātu uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the ear-element is arising, for that person is the eye-element arising?

Sasotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotadhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati. Sasotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotadhātu ca uppajjati cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with ears but without eyes, for them the ear-element is arising, but the eye-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with ears and with eyes, for them both the ear-element is arising and the eye-element is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0297] cakkhudhātu uppajjati tassa ghānadhātu uppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the eye-element is arising, for that person is the nose-element arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānadhātu [M 1.0204] uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati ghānadhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with eyes but without a nose, for them the eye-element is arising, but the nose-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with eyes and with a nose, for them both the eye-element is arising and the nose-element is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānadhātu uppajjati tassa cakkhudhātu uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the nose-element is arising, for that person is the eye-element arising?

Saghānakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānadhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānadhātu ca uppajjati cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with a nose but without an eye, for them the nose-element is arising, but the eye-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose and with an eye, for them both the nose-element is arising and the eye-element is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhudhātu uppajjati tassa rūpadhātu uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever the eye-element is arising, for that person is the form-element arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana rūpadhātu uppajjati tassa cakkhudhātu uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the form-element is arising, for that person is the eye-element arising?

Sarūpakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpadhātu uppajjati[T 1.0273], no ca tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpadhātu ca uppajjati cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with form but without an eye, for them the form-element is arising, but the eye-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with an eye, for them both the form-element is arising and the eye-element is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhudhātu uppajjati tassa manoviññāṇadhātu uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever the eye-element is arising, for that person is the mind-consciousness-element arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manoviññāṇadhātu uppajjati tassa cakkhudhātu uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the mind-consciousness-element is arising, for that person is the eye-element arising?

Sacittakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manoviññāṇadhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudhātu uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manoviññāṇadhātu ca uppajjati cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with consciousness but without an eye, for them the mind-consciousness-element is arising, but the eye-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with an eye, for them both the mind-consciousness-element is arising and the eye-element is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhudhātu uppajjati tassa dhammadhātu uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever the eye-element is arising, for that person is the dhamma-element arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana dhammadhātu uppajjati tassa cakkhudhātu uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the dhamma-element is arising, for that person is the eye-element arising?

Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammadhātu uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ [V 1.0298] cakkhudhātu uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammadhātu ca uppajjati cakkhudhātu ca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn without an eye, for them the dhamma-element is arising, but the eye-element is not arising for them. For those who are being reborn with an eye, for them both the dhamma-element is arising and the eye-element is arising.

(Yathā āyatanayamakaṃ vibhattaṃ evaṃ dhātuyamakampi vibhajitabbaṃ, sadisaṃ kātabbaṃ).

(Just as the Āyatana Yamaka has been analyzed, so too should the Dhātu Yamaka be analyzed; it should be made similar.)

19. Whoever fully understands the eye-element, do they fully understand the ear-element? Yes. …Pe… (The Dhātu Yamaka is complete with the abbreviation.)

2. Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

2. The Root-Cycle Section on Analysis of Terms

1. Padasodhanavāro

1. The Section on Analysis of Terms

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(Ka) Positive

10. (Ka) dukkhaṃ [V 1.0305] dukkhasaccanti? Āmantā.

10. (Ka) Is suffering the truth of suffering? Yes.

(Kha) dukkhasaccaṃ dukkhanti?

(Kha) Is the truth of suffering suffering?

Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ (syā.) evamuparipi, na dukkhaṃ. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ dukkhañceva dukkhasaccañca.

Setting aside bodily suffering and mental suffering, the remaining truth of suffering is not suffering. Bodily suffering and mental suffering are both suffering and the truth of suffering.

(Ka) samudayo samudayasaccanti?

(Ka) Is origination the truth of origination?

Samudayasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso samudayo, na samudayasaccaṃ. Samudayasaccaṃ samudayo ceva samudayasaccañca.

Setting aside the truth of origination, the remaining origination is not the truth of origination. The truth of origination is both origination and the truth of origination.

(Kha) samudayasaccaṃ samudayoti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the truth of origination origination? Yes.

(Ka) nirodho nirodhasaccanti?

(Ka) Is cessation the truth of cessation?

Nirodhasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso nirodho, na nirodhasaccaṃ. Nirodhasaccaṃ [T 1.0277] nirodho ceva nirodhasaccañca.

Setting aside the truth of cessation, the remaining cessation is not the truth of cessation. The truth of cessation is both cessation and the truth of cessation.

(Kha) nirodhasaccaṃ nirodhoti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is the truth of cessation cessation? Yes.

(Ka) maggo maggasaccanti?

(Ka) Is the path the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso maggo, na maggasaccaṃ. Maggasaccaṃ maggo ceva maggasaccañca.

Setting aside the truth of the path, the remaining path is not the truth of the path. The truth of the path is both the path and the truth of the path.

(Kha) maggasaccaṃ maggoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the truth of the path the path? Yes.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

11. (Ka) na dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccanti?

(a) Is that which is not suffering, not the truth of suffering?

Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na dukkhaṃ avasesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na dukkhaṃ (sī. syā. ka.) evaṃ avasesesu tīsu saccesu dukkhasaccaṃ. Dukkhañca dukkhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca dukkhasaccaṃ.

11. Setting aside bodily suffering and mental suffering, the remaining truth of suffering is not suffering, but it is the truth of suffering. Setting aside suffering and the truth of suffering, the remainder is neither suffering nor the truth of suffering.

(Kha) na [V 1.0306] dukkhasaccaṃ na dukkhanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the truth of suffering, not suffering? Yes.

(Ka) na [M 1.0209] samudayo na samudayasaccanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the origin, not the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) na samudayasaccaṃ na samudayoti?

(b) Is that which is not the truth of the origin, not the origin?

Samudayasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na samudayasaccaṃ, samudayo. Samudayañca samudayasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva samudayo na ca samudayasaccaṃ.

Setting aside the truth of the origin, the remainder is the origin, not the truth of the origin. Setting aside the origin and the truth of the origin, the remainder is neither the origin nor the truth of the origin.

(Ka) na nirodho na nirodhasaccanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not cessation, not the truth of cessation? Yes.

(Kha) na nirodhasaccaṃ na nirodhoti?

(b) Is that which is not the truth of cessation, not cessation?

Nirodhasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodho. Nirodhañca nirodhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva nirodho na ca nirodhasaccaṃ.

Setting aside the truth of cessation, the remainder is cessation, not the truth of cessation. Setting aside cessation and the truth of cessation, the remainder is neither cessation nor the truth of cessation.

(Ka) na maggo na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the path, not the truth of the path? Yes.

(Kha) na maggasaccaṃ na maggoti?

(b) Is that which is not the truth of the path, not the path?

Maggasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na maggasaccaṃ, maggo. Maggañca maggasaccañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva maggo na ca maggasaccaṃ.

Setting aside the truth of the path, the remainder is the path, not the truth of the path. Setting aside the path and the truth of the path, the remainder is neither the path nor the truth of the path.

Samudayasaccaṃ saccañceva samudayasaccañca. Avasesā saccā avasesā saccā saccā (syā.) na [T 1.0278] samudayasaccaṃ.

The truth of the origin is both a truth and the truth of the origin. The remaining truths are not the truth of the origin.

13. Samudayo samudayasaccanti?

Is the origin the truth of the origin?

Samudayasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso samudayo, na samudayasaccaṃ. Samudayasaccaṃ samudayo ceva samudayasaccañca. Saccā dukkhasaccanti? …Pe… saccā nirodhasaccanti?…Pe… saccā maggasaccanti?

Setting aside the truth of the origin, the remainder is the origin, not the truth of the origin. The truth of the origin is both the origin and the truth of the origin. Are truths the truth of suffering? … Are truths the truth of cessation? … Are truths the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ saccañceva maggasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

The truth of the path is both a truth and the truth of the path. The remaining truths are not the truth of the path.

14. Nirodho nirodhasaccanti?

13. Is cessation the truth of cessation?

Nirodhasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso nirodho, na nirodhasaccaṃ. Nirodhasaccaṃ nirodho ceva nirodhasaccañca.

Setting aside the truth of cessation, the remainder is cessation, not the truth of cessation. The truth of cessation is both cessation and the truth of cessation.

Saccā dukkhasaccanti?…Pe… saccā samudayasaccanti? …Pe… saccā maggasaccanti?

Are truths the truth of suffering? … Are truths the truth of the origin? … Are truths the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ saccañceva maggasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

14. The truth of the path is both a truth and the truth of the path. The remaining truths are not the truth of the path.

15. Maggo [M 1.0210] maggasaccanti?

Is the path the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso maggo, na maggasaccaṃ. Maggasaccaṃ maggo ceva maggasaccañca.

Setting aside the truth of the path, the remainder is the path, not the truth of the path. The truth of the path is both the path and the truth of the path.

Saccā dukkhasaccanti?…Pe… saccā samudayasaccanti? …Pe… saccā nirodhasaccanti?

Are truths the truth of suffering? … Are truths the truth of origin? … Are truths the truth of cessation?

Nirodhasaccaṃ saccañceva nirodhasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na nirodhasaccaṃ.

15. The truth of cessation is both a truth and the truth of cessation. The remaining truths are not the truth of cessation.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

16. (Ka) na [V 1.0308] dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccanti?

(a) Is that which is not suffering not the truth of suffering?

Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na dukkhaṃ, dukkhasaccaṃ. Dukkhañca dukkhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca dukkhasaccaṃ.

Setting aside bodily suffering and mental suffering, the remainder of the truth of suffering is not suffering, but it is the truth of suffering. Setting aside both suffering and the truth of suffering, the remaining phenomena are neither suffering nor the truth of suffering.

(Kha) na saccā na samudayasaccanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are phenomena that are not truths not the truth of origin? Yes.

Na dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccanti?

Is that which is not suffering not the truth of suffering?

Kāyikaṃ [T 1.0279] dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na dukkhaṃ, dukkhasaccaṃ. Dukkhañca dukkhasaccañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca dukkhasaccaṃ.

16. Setting aside bodily suffering and mental suffering, the remainder of the truth of suffering is not suffering, but it is the truth of suffering. Setting aside both suffering and the truth of suffering, the remaining phenomena are neither suffering nor the truth of suffering.

Na saccā na nirodhasaccanti?…Pe… na saccā na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

Are phenomena that are not truths not the truth of cessation? … Are phenomena that are not truths not the truth of the path? Yes.

17. (A) Is that which is not origin not the truth of origin? Yes.

18. Is that which is not cessation not the truth of cessation? Yes.

Na saccā na dukkhasaccanti?…Pe… na saccā na samudayasaccanti?…Pe… na saccā na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

19. (Ka) na maggo na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

19. (A) Is that which is not the path not the truth of the path? Yes.

(Kha) na saccā na dukkhasaccanti? Āmantā.

20. (Ka) dukkhaṃ [V 1.0309] saccanti? Āmantā.

20. (A) Is suffering a truth? Yes.

(Kha) saccā dukkhasaccanti?

(B) Are truths the truth of suffering?

Dukkhasaccaṃ saccañceva dukkhasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na dukkhasaccaṃ.

The truth of suffering is both a truth and the truth of suffering. The remaining truths are not the truth of suffering.

Samudayo [M 1.0211] saccanti? Āmantā…pe….

Is the origin a truth? Yes…

Nirodho saccanti? Āmantā…pe….

Is cessation a truth? Yes…

(Ka) maggo saccanti? Āmantā.

(A) Is the path a truth? Yes.

(Kha) saccā maggasaccanti?

(B) Are truths the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ saccañceva maggasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

The truth of the path is both a truth and the truth of the path. The remaining truths are not the truth of the path.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) Negative Section

21. (Ka) na dukkhaṃ na saccanti?

21. (A) Is that which is not suffering not a truth?

Dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na dukkhaṃ, saccā. Dukkhañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ na ceva dukkhaṃ na [T 1.0280] ca saccā.

Except for suffering, the remaining truths are not suffering, but they are truths. Except for suffering and the truths, the remainder is neither suffering nor truths.

(Kha) na saccā na dukkhasaccanti? Āmantā.

(B) Are phenomena that are not truths not the truth of suffering? Yes.

Na samudayo na saccanti?

Is that which is not the origin not a truth?

Samudayaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe… nirodhaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe….

Except for the origin… except for cessation…

(Ka) na maggo na saccanti?

(A) Is that which is not the path not a truth?

Maggaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na maggo, saccā. Maggañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva maggo na ca saccā.

Except for the path, the remaining truths are not the path, but they are truths. Except for the path and the truths, the remaining things are neither the path nor truths.

(Kha) na saccā na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

(B) Are phenomena that are not truths not the truth of the path? Yes.

Saccā nirodhasaccanti?…Pe…. Saccā maggasaccanti?

Are truths the truth of cessation?… Are truths the truth of the path?

Maggasaccaṃ saccañceva maggasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

The truth of the path is both a truth and the truth of the path. The remaining truths are not the truth of the path.

Samudayo saccanti? Āmantā.…Pe….

Is the origin a truth? Yes…

Nirodho saccanti? Āmantā.…Pe….

Is cessation a truth? Yes…

Maggo saccanti? Āmantā.

Is the path a truth? Yes.

Saccā dukkhasaccanti?…Pe… saccā samudayasaccanti? …Pe… saccā nirodhasaccanti?

Are truths the truth of suffering?…(abridged)… Are truths the truth of the origin?…(abridged)… Are truths the truth of cessation?

Nirodhasaccaṃ saccañceva nirodhasaccañca. Avasesā saccā na nirodhasaccaṃ.

The truth of cessation is indeed a truth and the truth of cessation. The remaining truths are not the truth of cessation.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(B) Negative Section

23. (Ka) na [M 1.0212] dukkhaṃ na saccanti?

23. (A) Is that which is not suffering, not a truth?

Dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na dukkhaṃ, saccā. Dukkhañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca saccā.

Having set aside suffering, the remaining truths are not suffering, but they are truths. Having set aside both suffering and truth, the remaining things are neither suffering nor truths.

(Kha) na saccā na samudayasaccanti? Āmantā.

(B) Are things that are not truths, not the truth of the origin? Yes.

Na dukkhaṃ na saccanti?

Is that which is not suffering, not a truth?

Dukkhaṃ [V 1.0311] ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na dukkhaṃ, saccā. Dukkhañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca saccā.

Having set aside suffering, the remaining truths are not suffering, but they are truths. Having set aside both suffering and truth, the remainder is neither suffering nor truth.

Na saccā [T 1.0281] na nirodhasaccanti?…Pe… na saccā na maggasaccanti? Āmantā.

Are things that are not truths, not the truth of cessation?…(abridged)… Are things that are not truths, not the truth of the path? Yes.

24. Na samudayo na saccanti?

24. Is that which is not the origin, not a truth?

Samudayaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na samudayo, saccā. Samudayañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva samudayo na ca saccā.

Having set aside the origin, the remaining truths are not the origin, but they are truths. Having set aside both the origin and truth, the remainder is neither the origin nor truth.

Na saccā na dukkhasaccanti?…Pe….

Are things that are not truths, not the truth of suffering?…(abridged)…

25. Na nirodho na saccanti?

25. Is that which is not cessation, not a truth?

Nirodhaṃ ṭhapetvā…pe….

Having set aside cessation…(abridged)…

26. (Ka) na maggo na saccanti?

26. (A) Is that which is not the path, not a truth?

Maggaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na maggo, saccā. Maggañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva maggo na ca saccā.

Having set aside the path, the remaining truths are not the path, but they are truths. Having set aside both the path and truth, the remainder is neither the path nor truth.

(Kha) na saccā na dukkhasaccanti? Āmantā.

(B) Are things that are not truths, not the truth of suffering? Yes.

Na maggo na saccanti?

Is that which is not the path, not a truth?

Maggaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā saccā na maggo, saccā. Maggañca saccañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva maggo na ca saccā.

Having set aside the path, the remaining truths are not the path, but they are truths. Having set aside both the path and truth, the remainder is neither the path nor truth.

Na saccā na samudayasaccanti? Āmantā.…Pe….

Are things that are not truths, not the truth of the origin? Yes.…(abridged)…

Na saccā na nirodhasaccanti? Āmantā.

Are things that are not truths, not the truth of cessation? Yes.

Paṇṇattiniddesavāro.

The Section of the Exposition of Designation.
