2. The Section on Occurrence 1. The Section on Arising

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Direct Order: Person

27. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0312] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

27. (A) For whom the truth of suffering arises, for them does the truth of the origin arise?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ [M 1.0213] dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those in the course of existence at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving, for them the truth of suffering arises, but the truth of the origin does not arise for them. At the arising-moment of craving, for them both the truth of suffering arises and the truth of the origin arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin arises, for them does the truth of suffering arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(A) For whom the truth of suffering arises, for them does the truth of the path arise?

Sabbesaṃ [T 1.0282] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those in the course of existence at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the path, for them the truth of suffering arises, but the truth of the path does not arise for them. In the five-constituent existence, at the arising-moment of the path, for them both the truth of suffering arises and the truth of the path arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the path arises, for them does the truth of suffering arise?

Arūpe maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

In the formless existence, at the arising-moment of the path, the truth of the path arises for them, but the truth of suffering does not arise for them. In the five-constituent existence, at the arising-moment of the path, for them both the truth of the path arises and the truth of suffering arises.

28. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

28. (A) For whom the truth of the origin arises, for them does the truth of the path arise? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the path arises, for them does the truth of the origin arise? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) Direct Order: Plane

29. (Ka) yattha [V 1.0313] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

29. (A) Where the truth of suffering arises, does the truth of the origin arise there?

Asaññasatte tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

In the plane of non-percipient beings, the truth of suffering arises there, but the truth of the origin does not arise there. In the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, both the truth of suffering and the truth of the origin arise there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(B) Or again, where…(abridged)…? Yes.

(Ka) yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(A) Where the truth of suffering arises, does the truth of the path arise there?

Apāye asaññasatte tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjati. Avasese catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjati.

In the planes of deprivation and in the plane of non-percipient beings, the truth of suffering arises there, but the truth of the path does not arise there. In the remaining four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, both the truth of suffering and the truth of the path arise there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana maggasaccaṃ [T 1.0283] uppajjati tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or alternatively, where the truth of the path arises, does the truth of suffering arise there? Yes.

30. (Ka) yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

30. (A) Where the truth of the origin arises, does the truth of the path arise there?

Apāye tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjati. Avasese catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjati.

In the planes of misery, the truth of the origin arises there, but the truth of the path does not arise there. In the remaining four-constituent and five-constituent planes, both the truth of the origin and the truth of the path arise there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(B) Or alternatively, where... and so forth? Yes.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(C) Positive: Individuals and Planes

31. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?…Pe….

31. For whichever person, in whichever plane the truth of suffering arises, for that person, in that plane, does the truth of the origin arise? …and so forth….

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).

(The section on individuals and the section on individuals and planes should be elaborated in the same way.)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(D) Negative: Individuals

32. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0314][M 1.0214] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

32. (A) For a person for whom the truth of suffering does not arise, for that person, does the truth of the origin not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, for a person for whom the truth of the origin does not arise, for that person, does the truth of suffering not arise?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving, for them the truth of the origin does not arise, but the truth of suffering does arise for them. For all who are passing away, during the course of existence at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and in the formless plane at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of suffering do not arise.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(A) For a person for whom the truth of suffering does not arise, for that person, does the truth of the path not arise?

Arūpe maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe phalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjati.

In the formless plane, at the arising-moment of the path, for them the truth of suffering does not arise, but the truth of the path does arise for them. For all who are passing away, during the course of existence at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and in the formless plane at the arising-moment of the fruit, for them both the truth of suffering and the truth of the path do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa [T 1.0284] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, for a person for whom the truth of the path does not arise, for that person, does the truth of suffering not arise?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe phalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the path, for them the truth of the path does not arise, but the truth of suffering does arise for them. For all who are passing away, during the course of existence at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and in the formless plane at the arising-moment of the fruit, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of suffering do not arise.

33. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

33. (A) For a person for whom the truth of the origin does not arise, for that person, does the truth of the path not arise?

Maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttamaggavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the arising-moment of the path, for them the truth of the origin does not arise, but the truth of the path does arise for them. For all beings, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving and dissociated from the path, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of the path do not arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0315] vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, for a person for whom the truth of the path does not arise, for that person, does the truth of the origin not arise?

Taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe maggavippayuttataṇhāvippayuttacittassa taṇhāvippayuttamaggavippayuttacittassa (sī.) evaṃ puggalokāsepi nirodhavārepi uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the arising-moment of craving, for them the truth of the path does not arise, but the truth of the origin does arise for them. For all beings, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the path and dissociated from craving, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin do not arise.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(E) Negative: Planes

34. (Ka) yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

34. (A) Where the truth of suffering does not arise, does the truth of the origin not arise there? There is no such plane.

(Kha) yattha vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Uppajjati.

(B) Or alternatively, where the truth of the origin does not arise, does the truth of suffering not arise there? It does arise.

(Ka) yattha [M 1.0215] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

(A) Where the truth of suffering does not arise, does the truth of the path not arise there? There is no such plane.

(Kha) yattha vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti[T 1.0285]? Uppajjati.

(B) Or alternatively, where the truth of the path does not arise, does the truth of suffering not arise there? It does arise.

35. (Ka) yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

35. (A) Where the truth of the origin does not arise, does the truth of the path not arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, where the truth of the path does not arise, does the truth of the origin not arise there?

Apāye tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Asaññasatte tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

In the planes of misery, the truth of the path does not arise there, but the truth of the origin does arise there. In the non-percipient plane, both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin do not arise there.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(F) Negative: Individuals and Planes

36. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

36. (A) For whichever person, in whichever plane the truth of suffering does not arise, for that person, in that plane, does the truth of the origin not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, for whichever person, in whichever plane the truth of the origin does not arise, for that person, in that plane, does the truth of suffering not arise?

Sabbesaṃ [V 1.0316] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving, for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin does not arise, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering does arise. For all who are passing away, during the course of existence at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and in the formless plane at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit, for them, in that plane, both the truth of the origin and the truth of suffering do not arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(A) For whichever person, in whichever plane the truth of suffering does not arise, for that person, in that plane, does the truth of the path not arise?

Arūpe maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe phalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjati.

In the formless plane, at the arising-moment of the path, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering does not arise, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path does arise. For all who are passing away, during the course of existence at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and in the formless plane at the arising-moment of the fruit, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering and the truth of the path do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(B) Or alternatively, for whichever person, in whichever plane the truth of the path does not arise, for that person, in that plane, does the truth of suffering not arise?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ [T 1.0286] nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe phalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all those who are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the path in the course of existence, for them the truth of the path is not arising in that plane of existence, but for them the truth of suffering is arising in that plane of existence. For all those who are passing away, for those at the moment of dissolution of mind in the course of existence, and for those at the moment of arising of the fruit in the formless realm, for them in that plane of existence neither the truth of the path nor the truth of suffering is arising.

37. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

37. For whom, in whichever plane of existence the truth of the origin is not arising, for them, in that plane of existence, is the truth of the path not arising?

Maggassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttamaggavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of the path, for them the truth of the origin is not arising in that plane of existence, but for them the truth of the path is arising in that plane of existence. For all beings at the moment of dissolution of mind, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from craving and dissociated from the path, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane of existence neither the truth of the origin nor the truth of the path is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, in whichever plane of existence the truth of the path is not arising, for them, in that plane of existence, is the truth of the origin not arising?

Taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ [M 1.0216] tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe maggavippayuttataṇhāvippayuttacittassa [V 1.0317] uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of craving, for them the truth of the path is not arising in that plane of existence, but for them the truth of the origin is arising in that plane of existence. For all at the moment of dissolution of mind, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the path and dissociated from craving, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane of existence neither the truth of the path nor the truth of the origin is arising.

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Individual

38. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

38. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering arose, for them did the truth of the origin arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin arose, for them did the truth of suffering arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering arose, for them did the truth of the path arise?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha[T 1.0287]. Abhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those who have not penetrated the truths, for them the truth of suffering arose, but for them the truth of the path did not arise. For those who have penetrated the truths, for them both the truth of suffering arose and the truth of the path arose.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom…pe… arose? Yes.

39. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

39. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin arose, for them did the truth of the path arise?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those who have not penetrated the truths, for them the truth of the origin arose, but for them the truth of the path did not arise. For those who have penetrated the truths, for them both the truth of the origin arose and the truth of the path arose.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom…pe… arose? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Location in Conformity

40. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha…pe….

40. Where the truth of suffering arose…pe….

(Yatthakampi sabbattha sadisaṃ. Tantinānākaraṇaṃ heṭṭhā yatthakasadisaṃ).

(The section on location is also similar in all respects. The textual variation below is similar to the section on location).

41. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0318] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

41. (Ka) For whom, where the truth of suffering arose, for them, there did the truth of the origin arise?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha samudayasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes, when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them there the truth of suffering arose, but for them there the truth of the origin did not arise. For the other beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them there both the truth of suffering arose and the truth of the origin arose.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom where... did it arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0217] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom, where the truth of suffering arose, for them there did the truth of the path arise?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, for those who have not penetrated the truths, and for non-percipient beings, for them there the truth of suffering arose, but for them there the truth of the path did not arise. For those who have penetrated the truths, for them there both the truth of suffering arose and the truth of the path arose.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom where... did it arise? Yes.

42. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0288] yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

42. (Ka) For whom, where the truth of the origin arose, for them there did the truth of the path arise?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye akusale citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes when the second unwholesome consciousness is occurring, and for those who have not penetrated the truths, for them there the truth of the origin arose, but for them there the truth of the path did not arise. For those who have penetrated the truths, for them there both the truth of the origin arose and the truth of the path arose.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe… uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom where... did it arise? Yes.

43. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Natthi.

43. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering did not arise, for them did the truth of the origin not arise? There is none.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… nuppajjitthāti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or again, for whom... did it not arise? There is none.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0319] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Natthi.

44. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Natthi.

44. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin did not arise, for them did the truth of the path not arise? There is none.

46. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

46. (Ka) For whom, where the truth of suffering did not arise, for them, there did the truth of the origin not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom, where the truth of the origin did not arise, for them, there did the truth of suffering not arise?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0289] tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of origin had not arisen, but the truth of suffering had arisen for them there. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, in that plane, neither the truth of origin had arisen nor the truth of suffering had arisen.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0218] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

For whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of suffering had not arisen, for them, in that plane, had the truth of the path not arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or, on the other hand, for whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of the path had not arisen, for them, in that plane, had the truth of suffering not arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ [V 1.0320] nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjittha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, for those who have not realized the truths, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path had not arisen, but the truth of suffering had arisen for them there. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for them, in that plane, neither the truth of the path had arisen nor the truth of suffering had arisen.

47. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

47. For whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of origin had not arisen, for them, in that plane, had the truth of the path not arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

Or, on the other hand, for whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of the path had not arisen, for them, in that plane, had the truth of origin not arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye akusale citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjittha samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes, and for those who have not realized the truths when the second unwholesome consciousness is occurring, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path had not arisen, but the truth of origin had arisen for them there. For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, neither the truth of the path had arisen nor the truth of origin had arisen.

48. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

48. For whomever the truth of suffering will arise, for them will the truth of origin arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca [T 1.0290] uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them the truth of suffering will arise, but the truth of origin will not arise. For the others, both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomever, on the other hand...? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever the truth of suffering will arise, for them will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of suffering will arise, but the truth of the path will not arise. For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for others who will attain the path, for them both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe… uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomever, on the other hand... will it arise? Yes.

49. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

49. For whomever the truth of origin will arise, for them will the truth of the path arise?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati[V 1.0321], no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjissati [M 1.0219] maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of origin will arise, but the truth of the path will not arise. For those who will attain the path, for them both the truth of origin will arise and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or for whomever, on the other hand, the truth of the path will arise, for them will the truth of origin arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them the truth of the path will arise, but the truth of origin will not arise. For those who will attain the path, for them both the truth of the path will arise and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: Plane

50. In whichever plane the truth of suffering will arise... etc.

51. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

51. For whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of suffering will arise, for them, in that plane, will the truth of origin arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ [T 1.0291] paṭilabhissanti asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering will arise, but for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will not arise. For the remaining beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati…pe… uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or, on the other hand, for whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of origin will arise... will it arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of suffering will arise, for them, in that plane, will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti [V 1.0322] āpāyikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those in the planes of misery, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering will arise, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not arise. For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for others who will attain the path, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

Or, on the other hand, for whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of the path will arise, for them, in that plane, will the truth of suffering arise? Yes.

52. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

52. For whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of origin will arise, for them, in that plane, will the truth of the path arise?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjissati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those in the planes of misery, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will arise, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not arise. For those who will attain the path, for them, in that plane, both the truth of origin will arise and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

Or, on the other hand, for whomever, in whichever plane, the truth of the path will arise, for them, in that plane, will the truth of origin arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ [M 1.0220] paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati[T 1.0292], no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain mind of purification, for them the truth of the path will arise in that plane of existence, but the truth of the origin will not arise for them there. For those who will attain the path, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin will arise in that plane of existence.
