57. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti[T 1.0294]?

57. (Ka) For whomever, in whatever plane, the truth of the origin will not arise, for that person, in that plane, will the truth of the path not arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them the truth of the origin will not arise in that plane, but the truth of the path will arise for them there. For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of the path will not arise in that plane.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whatever plane, the truth of the path will not arise, for that person, in that plane, will the truth of the origin not arise?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For beings in the planes of misery and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the path will not arise in that plane, but the truth of the origin will arise for them there. For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin will not arise in that plane.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Forward: Individual

58. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0325] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

58. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for that person has the truth of the origin arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin has arisen, for that person is the truth of suffering arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjittha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For all beings who are passing away, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness during the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the moment of arising of the path and of the fruit—for them the truth of the origin has arisen, but for them the truth of suffering is not arising. For all beings who are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness during the course of existence—for them both the truth of the origin has arisen and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0222] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti? Anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ [T 1.0295] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

(A) For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for that person has the truth of the path arisen? For those who have not realized the truths, who are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness during the course of existence—for them the truth of suffering is arising, but for them the truth of the path has not arisen. For those who have realized the truths, who are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness during the course of existence—for them the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the path has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the path has arisen, for that person is the truth of suffering arising?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjittha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who have realized the truths and are passing away; for those in the course of existence at the moment of dissolution of consciousness; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of arising of the path and of the fruit—for them, the truth of the path has arisen, but for them the truth of suffering is not arising. For those who have realized the truths and are being reborn, and for those in the course of existence at the moment of arising of consciousness—for them, the truth of the path has arisen and the truth of suffering is arising.

59. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

59. (A) For whom the truth of the origin is arising, for that person has the truth of the path arisen?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya [V 1.0326] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, for them the truth of the origin is arising, but for them the truth of the path has not arisen. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, for them the truth of the origin is arising and the truth of the path has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the path has arisen, for that person is the truth of the origin arising?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjittha samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving; when a mind dissociated from craving is occurring; and for those who have attained the attainment of cessation—for them, the truth of the path has arisen, but for them the truth of the origin is not arising. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, for them the truth of the path has arisen and the truth of the origin is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) Positive: Sphere

60. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati…pe… (yatthakā sadisā sabbe).

60. Where the truth of suffering arises… and so on… (All the 'where' sections are similar).

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(C) Positive: Individual and Sphere

61. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

61. (A) For whom, in which realm the truth of suffering is arising, for that person, in that realm has the truth of the origin arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppatticittassa (syā.) uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0296] samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the moment of arising of rebirth-consciousness, and for those being reborn as non-percipient beings—for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is arising, but for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin has not arisen. For the others being reborn in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, and for those in the course of existence at the moment of arising of consciousness—for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the origin has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom, in which realm the truth of the origin has arisen, for that person, in that realm is the truth of suffering arising?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe [M 1.0223] arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjittha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent plane and the five-constituent plane, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the moment of arising of the path and of fruition—for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin has arisen, but for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is not arising. For those being reborn into the four-constituent plane and the five-constituent plane, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin has arisen and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0327] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(A) For whom, in which realm the truth of suffering is arising, for that person, in that realm has the truth of the path arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the moment of arising of the rebirth-linking consciousness; for those who have not realized the truths and are being reborn; for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those being reborn as non-percipient beings—for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is arising, but for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has not arisen. For those who have realized the truths and are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the path has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom, in which realm the truth of the path has arisen, for that person, in that realm is the truth of suffering arising?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe [T 1.0297] tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjittha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who have realized the truths and are passing away; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless plane at the moment of arising of the path and of fruition—for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has arisen, but for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering is not arising. For those who have realized the truths and are being reborn, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has arisen and the truth of suffering is arising.

62. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

62. (A) For whom, in which realm the truth of the origin is arising, for that person, in that realm has the truth of the path arisen?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of the arising of craving, for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin is arising, but for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has not arisen. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of the arising of craving, for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin is arising and the truth of the path has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or again, for whom, in which realm the truth of the path has arisen, for that person, in that realm is the truth of the origin arising?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjittha samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving, while a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has arisen, but for them, in that realm, the truth of the origin is not arising. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, for them, in that realm, the truth of the path has arisen and the truth of the origin is arising.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(D) Negative: The Person

63. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

63. (A) For whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for that person has the truth of the origin not arisen?

Uppajjittha.

It has arisen.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0328] vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti? Natthi.

(B) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin has not arisen, for that person is the truth of suffering not arising? There is no such case.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(A) For whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for that person has the truth of the path not arisen?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca [M 1.0224] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those who have comprehended, who are passing away; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of arising of the path and of the fruition—for them the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them the truth of the path had arisen. For those who have not comprehended, who are passing away; and for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence—for them both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the path had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti[T 1.0298]?

Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path had not arisen, for that person is the truth of suffering not arising?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjittha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those who have not comprehended, who are being reborn; and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them the truth of the path had not arisen, but for them the truth of suffering is arising. For those who have not comprehended, who are passing away; and for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence—for them both the truth of the path had not arisen and the truth of suffering is not arising.

64. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

64. For a person for whom the truth of origin is not arising, for that person had the truth of the path not arisen?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of the dissolution of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for those who have attained cessation, for them the truth of the origin is not arising, but for them the truth of the path had arisen. For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of the dissolution of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the origin is not arising and the truth of the path had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path had not arisen, for that person is the truth of the origin not arising?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjittha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of the arising of craving, for them the truth of the path had not arisen, but for them the truth of the origin is arising. For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of the dissolution of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the path had not arisen and the truth of the origin is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: Plane

65. Yattha [V 1.0329] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

Where the truth of suffering is not arising… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative Section on Individuals and Spheres

66. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

65. For a person for whom, in a realm where the truth of suffering is not arising, for that person in that realm, had the truth of the origin not arisen?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ [T 1.0299] upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those at the moment of arising of the path and its fruition in the formless plane, for them there the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them there the truth of the origin had arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes at the moment of dissolution of the rebirth-linking consciousness, and for non-percipient beings passing away, for them there both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the origin had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

66. Or again, for a person for whom, in a realm where the truth of the origin had not arisen, for that person in that realm, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the arising-moment of rebirth-consciousness, and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, for them there the truth of origin had not arisen, but for them there the truth of suffering is arising. For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution-moment of rebirth-consciousness, and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them there both the truth of origin had not arisen and the truth of suffering is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0225] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not arising in a certain realm, for that person in that realm, had the truth of the path not arisen?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those who have realized the truths who are passing away; for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the arising-moment of the path and its fruit—for them there the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them there the truth of the path had arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution-moment of rebirth-consciousness; for those who have not realized the truths who are passing away; for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm—for them there both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the path had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0330] vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path had not arisen in a certain realm, for that person in that realm, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ [T 1.0300] cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjittha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the arising-moment of rebirth-consciousness; for those who have not realized the truths who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm—for them there the truth of the path had not arisen, but for them there the truth of suffering is arising. For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution-moment of rebirth-consciousness; for those who have not realized the truths who are passing away; for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm—for them there both the truth of the path had not arisen and the truth of suffering is not arising.

67. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

For a person for whom the truth of origin is not arising in a certain realm, for that person in that realm, had the truth of the path not arisen?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those who have comprehended, at the moment of the dissolution of craving and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, for them the truth of origin is not arising there, but for them there the truth of the path had arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring; for those who have not comprehended, at the moment of the dissolution of craving and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the truth of origin is not arising and the truth of the path had not arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

67. Or again, for a person for whom, in a realm where the truth of the path had not arisen, for that person in that realm, is the truth of the origin not arising?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjittha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those who have not comprehended, at the moment of the arising of craving, for them the truth of the path had not arisen there, but for them there the truth of origin is arising. For those in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring; for those who have not comprehended, at the moment of the dissolution of craving and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; and for non-percipient beings, for them there both the truth of the path had not arisen and the truth of origin is not arising.

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

The Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

Positive: The Individual

68. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

68. For one for whom the truth of suffering is arising, will the truth of origin arise for that one?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ [T 1.0301] uppajjissati[V 1.0331]. Itaresaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [M 1.0226] pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

At the arising-moment of the highest path, at the arising-moment of the consciousness of arahants, and at the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path: for these persons, the truth of suffering is arising, but the truth of origin will not arise for them. For the other persons who are being reborn, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for one for whom the truth of origin will arise, is the truth of suffering arising for that one?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For all those who are passing away, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit in the formless realm—for them the truth of origin will arise, but for them the truth of suffering is not arising. For all those who are being reborn, at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them the truth of origin will arise and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For one for whom the truth of suffering is arising, will the truth of the path arise for that one?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

At the arising-moment of the highest path; at the arising-moment of the consciousness of arahants; and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for these persons, the truth of suffering is arising, but the truth of the path will not arise for them. At the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which one will attain the highest path, and for other persons who will attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for one for whom the truth of the path will arise, is the truth of suffering arising for that one?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ [T 1.0302] uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

At the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which one will attain the highest path; and for other persons who will attain the path, who are passing away, or are at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, or are at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit in the formless realm: for these persons, the truth of the path will arise, but the truth of suffering is not arising for them. At the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which one will attain the highest path, and for other persons who will attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them, the truth of the path will arise and the truth of suffering is arising.

69. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0332] samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

69. For one for whom the truth of origin is arising, will the truth of the path arise for that one?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are at the arising-moment of craving, for them the truth of origin is arising, but the truth of the path will not arise for them. For those who will attain the path, who are at the arising-moment of craving, for them the truth of origin is arising and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for one for whom the truth of the path will arise, is the truth of origin arising for that one?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye (sī. syā.) puggalokāsavārepi caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya [M 1.0227] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness; for other persons who will attain the path, who are at the dissolution-moment of craving; for those in whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; for those who have attained the attainment of cessation; and for non-percipient beings: for these persons, the truth of the path will arise, but the truth of origin is not arising for them. For those who will attain the path, who are at the arising-moment of craving, for them the truth of the path will arise and the truth of origin is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

Positive: The Sphere

70. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati…pe… (yatthakampi yassayatthakasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ).

70. Where the truth of suffering is arising...pe... (The section on 'where' should also be treated similarly to the section on 'for whom, where').

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

Positive: The Person and the Sphere

71. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti[T 1.0303]?

71. For one for whom, and where, the truth of suffering is arising, for that one, there, will the truth of origin arise?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

At the arising-moment of the highest path; at the arising-moment of the consciousness of arahants; at the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which one will attain the highest path; and for those being reborn into the non-percipient realm: for them, there, the truth of suffering is arising, but for them, there, the truth of origin will not arise. For other persons being reborn into the four-constituent or five-constituent realms, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them, there, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0333] vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for one for whom, and where, the truth of origin will arise, for that one, there, is the truth of suffering arising?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those at the arising-moment of the path and of fruition in the formless existence: for them, there, the truth of origin will arise, but for them, there, the truth of suffering is not arising. For those being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them, there, the truth of origin will arise and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For one for whom, and where, the truth of suffering is arising, for that one, there, will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [T 1.0304] tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those at the moment of arising of the supreme path, for Arahants at the moment of arising of consciousness, for those in the woeful states, for those worldlings who will not attain the path who are being reborn and at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those being reborn as non-percipient beings—for them the truth of suffering is arising there, but for them the truth of the path will not arise there. For those at the moment of arising of the vodāna-consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path, and for other beings who will attain the path who are being reborn and at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them both the truth of suffering is arising there and the truth of the path will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path will arise in a certain realm, is the truth of suffering arising for that person in that realm?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa [M 1.0228] ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of that vodāna-consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for others who will attain the path, who are passing away, at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of arising of the path and fruition—for them, the truth of the path will arise there, but the truth of suffering is not arising for them there. For those at the moment of arising of that vodāna-consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for others who will attain the path, who are being reborn, and at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, both the truth of the path will arise there and the truth of suffering is arising there.

72. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0334] yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

72. (Ka) For a person for whom the truth of origin is arising in a certain realm, will the truth of the path arise for that person in that realm?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those in the woeful states, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, at the moment of the arising of craving for them—for them, the truth of origin is arising there, but the truth of the path will not arise for them there. For those who will attain the path, at the moment of the arising of craving for them—for them, both the truth of origin is arising there and the truth of the path will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path will arise in a certain realm, is the truth of origin arising for that person in that realm?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe [T 1.0305] taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain vodāna-consciousness, and for others who will attain the path: for them, at the moment of dissolution of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, the truth of the path will arise there, but the truth of origin is not arising for them there. For those who will attain the path, at the moment of arising of craving—for them, both the truth of the path will arise there and the truth of origin is arising there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Contrary Individual

73. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not arising, will the truth of origin not arise for that person?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati.

73. For all who are passing away, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those at the moment of arising of the path and of the fruit in the formless sphere—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising, but it is not that the truth of origin will not arise for them. At the moment of dissolution of the highest path, at the moment of dissolution of the consciousness of Arahants, at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and at the moment of arising of the highest path and of the fruit in the formless sphere, for them both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of origin will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of origin will not arise, is the truth of suffering not arising for that person?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe [V 1.0335] arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of the highest path, at the moment of arising of the consciousness of Arahants, and at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for them the truth of origin will not arise, but the truth of suffering is arising for them. At the moment of dissolution of the highest path, at the moment of dissolution of the consciousness of Arahants, at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and at the moment of arising of the highest path and of the fruit in the formless sphere, for them both the truth of origin will not arise and the truth of suffering is not arising.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0229] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not arising, will the truth of the path not arise for that person?

Yassa [T 1.0306] cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for others who, while passing away, will attain the path; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those at the moment of arising of the path and its fruit in the formless realm—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising, but it is not that the truth of the path will not arise for them. For those at the moment of dissolution of the highest path; for Arahants at the moment of dissolution of consciousness; for those worldlings who, while passing away, will not attain the path; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those at the moment of arising of the highest path and its fruit in the formless realm—for them, both the truth of suffering is not arising, and the truth of the path will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path will not arise, is the truth of suffering not arising for that person?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness; for those worldlings who will not attain the path while being reborn; and for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of the path will not arise, but the truth of suffering is arising. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for those worldlings who will not attain the path while passing away; for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the arising moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, both the truth of the path will not arise and the truth of suffering is not arising.

74. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

74. For one for whom the truth of the origin is not arising, will the truth of the path not arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissānti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ [T 1.0307] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte [V 1.0336] vattamāne tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those who will attain the highest path immediately after a particular consciousness, and for others who will attain a path, for those at the dissolution moment of craving, for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the origin is not arising, but the truth of the path will arise. For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the dissolution moment of craving, and for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, both the truth of the origin is not arising and the truth of the path will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for one for whom the truth of the path will not arise, for them is the truth of the origin not arising?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ maggasaccañca nuppajjissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, at the arising moment of craving, for them the truth of the path will not arise, but the truth of the origin is arising. For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the dissolution moment of craving, and for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, both the truth of the path will not arise and the truth of the origin is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Occasion

75. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

75. Where the truth of suffering is not arising… etc.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Person and Occasion

76. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0230] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

76. For one for whom, where, the truth of suffering is not arising, for them, there, will the truth of the origin not arise?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ [T 1.0308] tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the arising moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, there, the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them, there, the truth of the origin will arise. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for those passing away from the non-percipient existence, and for those in the formless realm at the arising moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, there, both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the origin will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for one for whom, where, the truth of the origin will not arise, for them, there, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa [V 1.0337] cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those at the arising moment of the supreme path; for those at the arising moment of the consciousness of Arahants; for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path; and for those being reborn into the plane of non-percipient beings—for them, there, the truth of the origin will not arise, but for them, there, the truth of suffering is arising. For those at the dissolution moment of the supreme path; for those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness of Arahants; for those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path; for those in the formless plane at the arising moment of the supreme path and its fruition; and for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings—for them, there, both the truth of the origin will not arise and the truth of suffering is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

For one for whom, where, the truth of suffering is not arising, for them, there, will the truth of the path not arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññattā cavantānaṃ arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path; for others who will attain the path and are passing away; for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless plane at the arising moment of the path and its fruition—for them, there, the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them, there, the truth of the path will arise. For those at the dissolution moment of the supreme path; for those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness of Arahants; for those of the woeful planes; for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are passing away; for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence; for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings; and for those in the formless plane at the arising moment of the supreme path and its fruition—for them, there, both the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the path will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati [T 1.0309] tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for one for whom, where, the truth of the path will not arise, for them, there, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa [M 1.0231] bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those at the arising-moment of the Arahantship path, for Arahants at the arising-moment of the mind, for those in the woeful planes, for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are being reborn, for those at the arising-moment of the mind during the course of existence, and for those being reborn into the non-percipient sphere—for them, there, the truth of the path will not arise, but for them, there, the truth of suffering is arising. For those at the dissolution-moment of the Arahantship path, for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of the mind, for those in the woeful planes, for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of the mind during the course of existence, for those in the formless sphere at the arising-moment of the Arahantship path and of the fruit, and for those passing away from the non-percipient sphere—for them, there, both the truth of the path will not arise and the truth of suffering is not arising.

77. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0338] yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

77. For whom, where, is the truth of origin not arising? For them, there, will the truth of the path not arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ, āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those who will attain the Arahantship path immediately after a certain consciousness, for others who will attain the path, for those at the dissolution-moment of craving, and for those in whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, there, the truth of origin is not arising, but for them, there, the truth of the path will arise. For those endowed with the Arahantship path, for Arahants, for those in the woeful planes, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the dissolution-moment of craving, for those in whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them, there, both the truth of origin is not arising and the truth of the path will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, where, will the truth of the path not arise? For them, there, is the truth of origin not arising?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ [T 1.0310] tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those in the woeful planes, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them at the arising-moment of craving, the truth of the path will not arise there, but for them, there, the truth of origin is arising. For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those in the woeful planes, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the dissolution-moment of craving, for those in whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them, there, both the truth of the path will not arise and the truth of origin is not arising.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) Section on the Past and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Individual in Direct Order

78. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

78. For whom has the truth of suffering arisen, for them will the truth of origin arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them the truth of suffering has arisen, but the truth of origin will not arise for them. For the remaining beings, for them both the truth of suffering has arisen and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or, for whom will the truth of origin arise, for them has the truth of suffering arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

For whom has the truth of suffering arisen, for them will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati[V 1.0339]. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [M 1.0232] ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of suffering has arisen, but the truth of the path will not arise for them. For those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for those others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of suffering has arisen and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or, for whom... (etc.)...? Yes.

79. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti[T 1.0311]? Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

79. (Ka) For whom has the truth of origination arisen, for them will the truth of the path arise? For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of origination has arisen, but the truth of the path will not arise. For those who will attain the supreme path immediately after that vodāna-citta, and for those others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of origination has arisen and the truth of the path will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom... (etc.)...? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Sphere of Direct Order

80. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha…pe….

80. Where the truth of suffering has arisen... (etc.)...

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) The Sphere of Persons and Planes in Direct Order

81. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

81. (Ka) For whom, where, has the truth of suffering arisen, for them, there, will the truth of origination arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after that vodāna-citta, and for those in the plane of non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering has arisen, but the truth of origination will not arise. For the other beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering has arisen and the truth of origination will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or for whom, where, will the truth of origination arise, for them, there, has the truth of suffering arisen?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no [V 1.0340] ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those who are being reborn into the Pure Abodes, for them, in that plane, the truth of origination will arise, but the truth of suffering has not arisen. For the other beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them, in that plane, both the truth of origination will arise and the truth of suffering has arisen.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whom, where, has the truth of suffering arisen, for them, there, will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ [T 1.0312] uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those in the woeful planes, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of suffering has arisen there, but the truth of the path will not arise for them there. For those endowed with the mind immediately after which they will attain the supreme path, and for those others who will attain the path—for them, both the truth of suffering has arisen there and the truth of the path will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or, for whom and where the truth of the path will arise, for them there has the truth of suffering arisen?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Yassa cittassa [M 1.0233] anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the truth of the path will arise for them there, but the truth of suffering has not arisen for them there. For those endowed with the mind immediately after which they will attain the supreme path, and for those others who will attain the path—for them, both the truth of the path will arise there and the truth of suffering has arisen there.

82. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

82. For whom and where the truth of origin has arisen, for them there will the truth of the path arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjittha maggasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, and for those in the woeful planes—for them, the truth of origin has arisen there, but the truth of the path will not arise for them there. For those endowed with the mind immediately after which they will attain the supreme path, and for those others who will attain the path—for them, both the truth of origin has arisen there and the truth of the path will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjitthāti?

Or, for whom and where the truth of the path will arise, for them there has the truth of origin arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjittha. Yassa cittassa [V 1.0341] anantarā aggamaggaṃ [T 1.0313] paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca uppajjittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes, while the second mind is occurring, the truth of the path will arise for them there, but the truth of origin has not arisen for them there. For those endowed with the mind immediately after which they will attain the supreme path, and for those others who will attain the path—for them, both the truth of the path will arise there and the truth of origin has arisen there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative Permutation (Individual)

83. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

83. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering has not arisen, for them will the truth of origin not arise? There is no such case.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of origin will not arise, for them has the truth of suffering not arisen? It has arisen.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering has not arisen, for them will the truth of the path not arise? There is no such case.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of the path will not arise, for them has the truth of suffering not arisen? It has arisen.

84. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

84. (Ka) For whom the truth of origin has not arisen, for them will the truth of the path not arise? There is no such case.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of the path will not arise, for them has the truth of origin not arisen? It has arisen.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Permutation (Plane)

85. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha…pe….

85. Where the truth of suffering has not arisen… and so on….
