86. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

86. (Ka) For whom and where the truth of suffering has not arisen, for them there will the truth of origin not arise? It will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or, for whom and where the truth of origin will not arise, for them there has the truth of suffering not arisen? It has arisen.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0342][M 1.0234] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

(Ka) For whom and where the truth of suffering has not arisen, for them there will the truth of the path not arise? It will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or, for whom and where the truth of the path will not arise, for them there has the truth of suffering not arisen? It has arisen.

87. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0314] yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

87. (Ka) For whom and where the truth of origin has not arisen, for them there will the truth of the path not arise?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha maggasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those in the Pure Abodes, when the second mind is occurring, the truth of origin has not arisen for them there, but the truth of the path will arise for them there. For non-percipient beings, for them there both the truth of origin has not arisen and the truth of the path will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whom and where the truth of the path will not arise, for them there has the truth of origin not arisen?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjittha. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nuppajjissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjittha.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, and for those in the woeful planes—for them, the truth of the path will not arise there, but the truth of origin has arisen for them there. For non-percipient beings, for them there both the truth of the path will not arise and the truth of origin has not arisen.

Uppādavāro.

The Arising Section.

2. Pavatti 2. nirodhavāro

2. 2. Course of Existence: The Cessation Section

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Present Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive Permutation (Individual)

88. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

88. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is ceasing, for them is the truth of origin ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ [V 1.0343] nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati samudayasaccañca nirujjhati.

For all those who are passing away, and for those in the course of existence at the moment of dissolution of consciousness dissociated from craving, for them the truth of suffering is ceasing, but the truth of origin is not ceasing for them. At the moment of dissolution of craving, for them both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of origin is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of origin is ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is ceasing, for them is the truth of the path ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Pañcavokāre maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhati[T 1.0315].

For all those who are passing away, and for those in the course of existence at the moment of dissolution of consciousness dissociated from the path, for them the truth of suffering is ceasing, but the truth of the path is not ceasing for them. In the five-constituent existence, at the moment of dissolution of the path, for them both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the path is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of the path is ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Arūpe maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no [M 1.0235] ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Pañcavokāre maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those in the formless realm at the moment of dissolution of the path, their truth of the path is ceasing, but their truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those in the five-constituent realm at the moment of dissolution of the path, both their truth of the path is ceasing and their truth of suffering is ceasing.

89. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

89. (Ka) For whomever the truth of the origin is ceasing, for them is the truth of the path ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the path is ceasing, for them is the truth of the origin ceasing? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Affirmative: Plane Section

90. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

90. Where the truth of suffering is ceasing, there is the truth of the origin ceasing?

Asaññasatte tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

In the non-percipient realm, there the truth of suffering is ceasing... and so on.

(Yatthakaṃ uppādepi nirodhepi uppādanirodhepi sadisaṃ, natthi nānākaraṇaṃ).

(The section concerning place is the same in the case of arising, in the case of ceasing, and in the case of arising-and-ceasing; there is no differentiation).

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Affirmative: Individuals and Planes

91. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

91. For whom, where the truth of suffering is ceasing... and so on.

(Yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).

(The section concerning person and place should also be elaborated similarly).

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual

92. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0344] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

92. (Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them is the truth of the origin not ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, and for those during the course of existence at the dissolution moment of a consciousness dissociated from craving, for them the truth of the origin is not ceasing, but for them the truth of suffering is ceasing. For all who are arising, for those during the course of existence at the arising moment of consciousness, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of path and of fruition, for them both the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them is the truth of the path not ceasing?

Arūpe [T 1.0316] maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe phalassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path, for them the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the path is ceasing. For all who are arising, for those during the course of existence at the arising moment of consciousness, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of fruition, for them both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the path is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the path is not ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe [M 1.0236] arūpe phalassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For all who are passing away, and for those during the course of existence at the dissolution moment of a consciousness dissociated from the path, for them the truth of the path is not ceasing, but for them the truth of suffering is ceasing. For all who are arising, for those during the course of existence at the arising moment of consciousness, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of fruition, for them both the truth of the path is not ceasing and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

93. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

93. (Ka) For whomever the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them is the truth of the path not ceasing?

Maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttamaggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [V 1.0345] tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the path, their truth of the origin is not ceasing, but their truth of the path is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness dissociated from craving and dissociated from the path, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of the path is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the path is not ceasing, for them is the truth of the origin not ceasing?

Taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe maggavippayuttataṇhāvippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of craving, their truth of the path is not ceasing, but their truth of the origin is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness dissociated from the path and dissociated from craving, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the truth of the path is not ceasing and the truth of the origin is not ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: Plane Section

94. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

94. Where the truth of suffering is not ceasing... and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Individual and Planes

95. Yassa [T 1.0317] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

95. For whom, where the truth of suffering is not ceasing... and so on.

(Yassakampi yassakampi yatthakampi (sī. syā.) yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ, yassayatthakepi nirodhasamāpannānanti cetaṃ na kātabbaṃ).

(The section on the Individual and the section on the Individual and Plane are similar, but in the section on the Individual and Plane, the phrase 'for those who have attained cessation' should not be included.)

(2) Atītavāro

(2) Past Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Affirmative: Individual

96. Yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

96. For whomever the truth of suffering has ceased, for them has the truth of the origin ceased? Yes.

(Yathā uppādavāre atītā pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhattā evaṃ nirodhepi vibhajitabbā, natthi nānākaraṇaṃ).

(Just as in the Arising Section the past questions, both affirmative and negative, have been analyzed, so too should they be analyzed in the Cessation Section; there is no difference.)

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Affirmative: Individual

97. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0346][M 1.0237] dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

97. (Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering will cease, for them will the truth of the origin cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe (sī. syā.) uppādavāre pana pāṭhantaraṃ natthi tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those endowed with the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for them the truth of suffering will cease, but for them the truth of the origin will not cease. For the remaining persons, for them both the truth of suffering will cease and the truth of the origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever... and so on? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering will cease, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhissati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of suffering will cease, but for them the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the arising moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after that consciousness, and for those others who will attain the path, for them both the truth of suffering will cease and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…[T 1.0318]. Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever... and so on. Yes.

98. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

98. (Ka) For whomever the truth of the origin will cease, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the origin will cease, but the truth of the path will not cease. For those who will attain the path, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom the truth of the path will cease, will the truth of the origin cease for them?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ [V 1.0347] nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those who are at the arising moment of the highest path, and for those endowed with the mind-moment immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for them the truth of the path will cease, but for them the truth of the origin will not cease. For those who will attain the path, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin will cease.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity: The Location Section

99. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati…pe….

99. Where the truth of suffering will cease… and so on…

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity: The Person and Location Section

100. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

100. For whom, where the truth of suffering will cease, will the truth of the origin cease there for them?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [M 1.0238] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati…pe….

For those endowed with the highest path, for the Arahants, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain mind-moment, and for non-percipient beings, for them the truth of suffering will cease there, but for them the truth of the origin will not cease there. For the remaining beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both the truth of suffering and the truth of the origin will cease there... and so on.

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ).

The section concerning the individual and the section concerning the individual and location are similar.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: The Individual Section

101. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

101. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering will not cease, for them will the truth of the origin not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of the origin will not cease, for them will the truth of suffering not cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa [T 1.0319] anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for the Arahants, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain mind-moment, for them the truth of the origin will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering will cease. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of suffering will not cease.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0348] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering will not cease, for them will the truth of the path not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for them will the truth of suffering not cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for the Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering will cease. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of suffering will not cease.

102. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

102. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin will not cease, for them will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those who, at the arising moment of the highest path, will attain the highest path immediately after a certain mind-moment, for them the truth of the origin will not cease, but for them the truth of the path will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, and for Arahants, for them both the truth of the origin and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever the truth of the path will not cease, for them will the truth of the origin not cease?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of the origin will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, and for Arahants, for them both the truth of the path and the truth of the origin will not cease.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: The Location Section

103. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati…pe….

103. Where the truth of suffering will not cease… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: The Person and Location Section

104. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0320][M 1.0239] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

104. (Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane of existence the truth of suffering will not cease, for them, in that plane of existence will the truth of the origin not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0349] vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane of existence the truth of the origin will not cease, for them, in that plane of existence will the truth of suffering not cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain mind-moment, and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane of existence, the truth of the origin will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them, in that plane of existence, both the truth of the origin and the truth of suffering will not cease.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomsoever, in whatsoever plane of existence the truth of suffering will not cease, for them, in that plane of existence will the truth of the path not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whomsoever, in whatsoever plane of existence the truth of the path will not cease, for them, in that plane of existence will the truth of suffering not cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those in the planes of misery, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them, there, the truth of suffering will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them, there, both the truth of the path and the truth of suffering will not cease.

105. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

105. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the truth of the origin will not cease, for them, there, will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for Arahants, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the truth of the origin will not cease and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ [T 1.0321] na nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in which plane the truth of the path will not cease, for that person, in that plane, will the truth of the origin not cease?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the planes of misery and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for Arahants, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of the origin will not cease.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Individual in Forward Order

106. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0350] dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

106. (Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering is ceasing, for that person, has the truth of the origin ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the origin has ceased, for that person, is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ [M 1.0240] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For all who are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those at the dissolution moment of the path and the fruit in the formless realm, for them the truth of the origin has ceased, but for them the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For all who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them both the truth of the origin has ceased and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whomever the truth of suffering is ceasing, for that person, has the truth of the path ceased?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those who have not realized the truths, who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them the truth of the path has not ceased. For those who have realized the truths, who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence: for them both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the path has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the path has ceased, for that person, is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte [T 1.0322] cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those who have realized the truths who are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those at the dissolution moment of the path and the fruit in the formless realm, for them the truth of the path has ceased, but for them the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those who have realized the truths who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them both the truth of the path has ceased and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

107. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

107. (Ka) For whomever the truth of the origin is ceasing, for that person, has the truth of the path ceased?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the dissolution moment of craving, for them the truth of the origin is ceasing, but for them the truth of the path has not ceased. For those who have realized the truths, at the dissolution moment of craving, for them both the truth of the origin is ceasing and the truth of the path has ceased.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0351] vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the path has ceased, for that person, is the truth of the origin ceasing?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those who have realized the truths: at the arising moment of craving, when a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, and for those who have attained cessation attainment, for them the truth of the path has ceased, but for them the truth of the origin is not ceasing. For those who have realized the truths, at the dissolution moment of craving, for them both the truth of the path has ceased and the truth of the origin is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity in Respect of Place

108. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

108. Where the truth of suffering is ceasing…pe….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity of Individuals and Place

109. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

109. (Ka) For whomever, in which plane the truth of suffering is ceasing, for that person, in that plane, has the truth of the origin ceased?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution moment of the rebirth-consciousness, and for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin has not ceased. For other beings passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, and for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the origin has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā [M 1.0241] pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in which plane the truth of the origin has ceased, for that person, in that plane, is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca [T 1.0323] phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent planes; for those at the arising moment of a consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and its fruit—for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin has ceased, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, and for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, both the truth of the origin has ceased and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whomever, in which plane the truth of suffering is ceasing, for that person, in that plane, has the truth of the path ceased?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ [V 1.0352] pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution moment of the rebirth-consciousness; for those who have not realized the truths who are passing away; for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness in the course of existence; and for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has not ceased. For those who have realized the truths who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of a consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the path has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in which plane has the truth of the path ceased, for that person, in that plane, is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those who have realized the truths and are being reborn; for those at the moment of arising of a consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of the path and of the fruit—for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has ceased, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those who have realized the truths and are passing away, and for those at the moment of dissolution of a consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has ceased and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

110. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

110. For whom, in which plane, is the truth of origin ceasing? For that person, in that plane, has the truth of the path ceased?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca [T 1.0324] nirujjhittha.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving, for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has not ceased. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving, for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is ceasing and the truth of the path has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom, in which plane, has the truth of the path ceased? For that person, in that plane, is the truth of origin ceasing?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has ceased, but for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is not ceasing. For those who have realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving, for them, in that plane, the truth of the path has ceased and the truth of origin is ceasing.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: The Individual

111. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

111. For whomsoever the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them had the truth of the origin not ceased? It had ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or again, for whomsoever the truth of the origin had not ceased, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing? There are none.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0353][M 1.0242] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whomsoever the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them had the truth of the path not ceased?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who have realized the truths and are being reborn; for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of the dissolution of the path and fruition—for them, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the path had ceased. For those who have not realized the truths and are being reborn, and for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the path had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the truth of the path had not ceased, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those who have not realized the truths and are passing away, and for those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of the path had not ceased, but for them the truth of suffering is ceasing. For those who have not realized the truths and are being reborn, and for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, both the truth of the path had not ceased and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

112. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0325] samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

112. For whomsoever the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them had the truth of the path not ceased?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who have realized the truths—at the moment of the arising of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for those who have attained the cessation attainment—for them, the truth of the origin is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the path had ceased. For those who have not realized the truths—at the moment of the arising of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them, both the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of the path had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomsoever the truth of the path had not ceased, for them is the truth of the origin not ceasing?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of dissolution of craving, for them the truth of the path had not ceased, but for them the truth of the origin is ceasing. For those who have not realized the truths, at the moment of arising of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them the truth of the path had not ceased and the truth of the origin is not ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: The Plane

113. Yattha [V 1.0354] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

113. Where the truth of suffering is not ceasing…and so on….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: The Individual and the Plane

114. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

114. For whichever person, in whichever plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for that person, in that plane, had the truth of the origin not ceased?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

For those being reborn into the four-constituent plane and the five-constituent plane; for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of the path and of the fruition—for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin had ceased. For those of the Pure Abodes at the moment of arising of rebirth-consciousness, and for those being reborn into the non-percipient plane, for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the origin had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [M 1.0243] samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane, the truth of the origin had not ceased, for that person, in that plane, is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe [T 1.0326] asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those of the Pure Abodes at the moment of dissolution of rebirth-consciousness, and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane, for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin had not ceased, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is ceasing. For those of the Pure Abodes at the moment of arising of rebirth-consciousness, and for those being reborn into the non-percipient plane, for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin had not ceased and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

For whichever person, in whichever plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for that person, in that plane, had the truth of the path not ceased?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa [V 1.0355] uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who have comprehended and are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruition, for them there the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them there, the truth of the path has ceased. For those in the Pure Abodes at the arising moment of rebirth-consciousness, for those who have not comprehended and are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, for them there both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the path has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the truth of the path has not ceased, for them there is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ upapatticittassa uppādakkhaṇe anabhisametāvīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those in the Pure Abodes at the dissolution moment of rebirth-consciousness, for those who have not comprehended and are passing away, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm, for them there the truth of the path has not ceased, but for them there, the truth of suffering is ceasing. For those in the Pure Abodes at the arising moment of rebirth-consciousness, for those who have not comprehended and are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, for them there both the truth of the path has not ceased and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

115. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na [T 1.0327] nirujjhitthāti?

115. For whom, where the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them there has the truth of the path not ceased?

Abhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

For those who have comprehended, at the arising moment of craving, and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, for them there the truth of the origin is not ceasing, but for them there, the truth of the path has ceased. For those in the Pure Abodes while the second consciousness is occurring, for those who have not comprehended, at the arising moment of craving, and while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for those in the non-percipient realm, for them there both the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of the path has not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the truth of the path has not ceased, for them there is the truth of the origin not ceasing?

Anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne anabhisametāvīnaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those who have not comprehended, at the dissolution moment of craving, for them there the truth of the path has not ceased, but for them there the truth of the origin is ceasing. For those in the Pure Abodes while the second consciousness is occurring, for those who have not comprehended at the arising moment of craving, while a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them there both the truth of the path has not ceased and the truth of the origin is not ceasing.

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Individual in Conformity

116. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0356][M 1.0244] dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

116. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is ceasing, for them will the truth of the origin cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

At the dissolution moment of the highest path, at the dissolution moment of the consciousness of arahants, and at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for them the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them the truth of the origin will not cease. For the others who are passing away, and at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the truth of the origin will cease, for them is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0328] pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For all who are being reborn, at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruit, for them the truth of the origin will cease, but for them the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For all who are passing away, and at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them both the truth of the origin will cease and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is ceasing, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

At the dissolution moment of the Arahantship path, for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path who are passing away at the dissolution moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them the truth of suffering is ceasing, but the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the Arahantship path, and for those others who will attain the path who are passing away at the dissolution moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or for whom the truth of the path will cease, for them is the truth of suffering ceasing?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [V 1.0357] tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

At the arising moment of the Arahantship path; for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the Arahantship path; for those others who will attain the path who are being reborn; for those at the arising moment of consciousness during the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruit—for them the truth of the path will cease, but the truth of suffering is not ceasing. At the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the Arahantship path, and for those others who will attain the path who are passing away at the dissolution moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

117. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0329] samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

117. (Ka) For whom the truth of origin is ceasing, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ [M 1.0245] nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of their craving, the truth of origin is ceasing, but the truth of the path will not cease for them. For those who will attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of their craving, both the truth of origin is ceasing and the truth of the path will cease for them.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the path will cease, is the truth of origin ceasing for them?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those endowed with that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those others who will attain the path, at the arising-moment of craving; for those for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; for those who have attained cessation; and for those in the non-percipient realm—for them, the truth of the path will cease, but for them the truth of origin is not ceasing. For those who will attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of craving, for them both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of origin is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Conformity: Location

118. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

118. Where the truth of suffering is ceasing… and so on….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Conformity: Individual and Location

119. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0358] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

119. (Ka) For a person for whom the truth of suffering is ceasing in a certain plane, will the truth of origin cease for that person in that plane?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness; for those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for non-percipient beings who are passing away—for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will not cease. For other beings from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [T 1.0330] samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of origin will cease in a certain plane, is the truth of suffering ceasing for that person in that plane?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those being reborn in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes; for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those from the four-constituent and five-constituent planes who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them, in that plane, both the truth of origin will cease and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For a person for whom the truth of suffering is ceasing in a certain plane, will the truth of the path cease for that person in that plane?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [M 1.0246] tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness; for those in the planes of misery; for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are passing away; for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence; and for non-percipient beings who are passing away—for them, there the truth of suffering is ceasing, but for them, there the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those others who will attain the path and are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them, there both the truth of suffering is ceasing and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0359] vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path will cease in a certain plane, is the truth of suffering ceasing for that person in that plane?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati[T 1.0331], no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those at the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those others who will attain the path and are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of consciousness during the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, there the truth of the path will cease, but for them, there the truth of suffering is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those others who will attain the path and are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them, there both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of suffering is ceasing.

120. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

120. (Ka) For a person for whom the truth of origin is ceasing in a certain plane, will the truth of the path cease for that person in that plane?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those in the planes of misery, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of their craving—for them, there the truth of origin is ceasing, but for them, there the truth of the path will not cease. For those who will attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of their craving—for them, there both the truth of origin is ceasing and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom the truth of the path will cease in a certain plane, is the truth of origin ceasing for that person in that plane?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhati.

For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those endowed with the vodāna consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for other persons who will attain the path and are at the arising-moment of craving; and for those for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring—for these persons, in that plane, the truth of the path will cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is not ceasing. For those persons who will attain the path and are at the dissolution-moment of craving, for them, in that plane, both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of origin is ceasing.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual

121. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

121. (Ka) For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not ceasing, will the truth of origin not cease for them?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe [T 1.0332] maggassa [V 1.0360] ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca [M 1.0247] na nirujjhati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the origin will cease. For those at the arising moment of the highest path, for arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the origin will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the origin will not cease, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness, and for those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path—for them, the truth of the origin will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering is ceasing. For those at the arising moment of the highest path, for arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, both the truth of the origin will not cease and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ [T 1.0333] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path, for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for those others who will attain the path who are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the path will cease. For arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, for those worldlings who will not attain the path who are being reborn, for them at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for them is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā [V 1.0361] maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path, for arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness, for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are passing away, and for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering is ceasing. For arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are being reborn, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

122. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

122. For whom the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya [M 1.0248] uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for those at the moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those others who will attain a path, at the arising moment of craving; for those while a mind dissociated from craving is occurring; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the origin is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the path will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for arahants; for those worldlings who will not attain a path, at the arising moment of craving; and for those while a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, both the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa [T 1.0334] samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for them is the truth of the origin not ceasing?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne vattamāne, nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ (sī. syā.) tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, at the dissolution moment of craving for them, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of the origin is ceasing. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for arahants; for those worldlings who will not attain a path, at the arising moment of craving for them; and for them while a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of the origin is not ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Section

123. Yattha [V 1.0362] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati…pe….

123. Where the truth of suffering is not ceasing...

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative Section on Persons and Spheres

124. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

124. For whom, where the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them, there, will the truth of the origin not cease?

Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the dissolution moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, there, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, but for them, there, the truth of the origin will cease. For those at the arising moment of the highest path, for arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for those being reborn into the non-percipient plane, and for those in the formless plane at the dissolution moment of the highest path and of the fruit—for them, there, both the truth of suffering is not ceasing and the truth of the origin will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom, where the truth of the origin will not cease, for them, there, is the truth of suffering not ceasing?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0335] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those passing away from the non-percipient plane—for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of suffering is ceasing. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the arising-moment of consciousness, for those at the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for those in the formless plane at the dissolution-moment of the highest path and of the fruition, and for those who are being reborn into the non-percipient plane—for them, in that plane, the truth of origin will not cease, and the truth of suffering is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomever, in whatsoever plane, the truth of suffering is not ceasing, for them, in that plane, will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa [V 1.0363] uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa [M 1.0249] cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the moment of arising of the supreme path; for those at the moment of arising of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path; for others who will attain the path, who are being reborn; for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of dissolution of the path and its fruition—for them, the truth of suffering is not ceasing there, but for them, the truth of the path will cease there. For Arahants at the moment of arising of consciousness; for those in the woeful states and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are being reborn; for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence; for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings; and for those in the formless realm at the moment of dissolution of the supreme path and its fruition—for them, the truth of suffering is not ceasing there, and the truth of the path will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the truth of the path will not cease in a certain plane, for that one, is the truth of suffering not ceasing in that plane?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ [T 1.0336] na nirujjhati.
