Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca na nirujjhati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of the supreme path; for Arahants at the moment of dissolution of consciousness; for those in the woeful states and for worldlings who will not attain the path, who are passing away; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those passing away from the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the path will not cease there, but for them, the truth of suffering is ceasing there. For Arahants at the moment of arising of consciousness; for those in the woeful states and for worldlings who will not attain the path, who are being reborn; for those at the moment of arising of consciousness in the course of existence; for those in the formless realm at the moment of dissolution of the supreme path and its fruition; and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the path will not cease there, and the truth of suffering is not ceasing there.

125. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

125. For one for whom the truth of the origin is not ceasing in a certain plane, for that one, will the truth of the path not cease in that plane?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa [V 1.0364] bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising-moment of the supreme path, for those for whom immediately after a certain consciousness they will attain the supreme path, for others who will attain a path, for those at the arising-moment of craving, and for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is not ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the supreme path, for arahants, for those in the woeful states, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the arising-moment of craving, for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the truth of origin is not ceasing and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whomever, in whatsoever plane, the truth of the path will not cease, for them, in that plane, is the truth of origin not ceasing?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0337] maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhiti.

For those in the woeful planes and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are at the dissolution-moment of craving—for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of origin is ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of the supreme path, for arahants, for those in the woeful planes, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those at the arising-moment of craving, for those for whom a mind dissociated from craving is occurring, and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of origin is not ceasing.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) Section on the Past and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Conforming Individual

126. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0250] dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the truth of suffering has ceased, for that one, will the truth of origin cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for arahants, and for those endowed with the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the supreme path—for them the truth of suffering has ceased, but for them the truth of origin will not cease. For the others, for them both the truth of suffering has ceased and the truth of origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

126. Or again, for one for whom... and so on...? Yes.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the truth of suffering has ceased, for that one, will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ [V 1.0365] paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

At the moment of dissolution of the highest path, for the Arahants and for those worldlings who will not attain a path, for them the truth of suffering has ceased, but the truth of the path will not cease for them. At the moment of arising of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after this consciousness, and for others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of suffering has ceased and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for one for whom... and so on...? Yes.

127. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the truth of origin has ceased, for that one, will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for the Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the origin has ceased, but the truth of the path will not cease for them. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of the origin has ceased and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā [T 1.0338] pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whomsoever…? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Progressive Sphere

128. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha…pe….

128. Where the truth of suffering has ceased… and so on.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) The Progressive Individual and Sphere

129. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

129. (Ka) For whom, in which realm, has the truth of suffering ceased, for that person, in that realm, will the truth of the origin cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the highest path, for the Arahants, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for the non-percipient beings, for them the truth of suffering has ceased in that realm, but the truth of the origin will not cease for them in that realm. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both the truth of suffering has ceased in that realm and the truth of the origin will cease in that realm.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti[M 1.0251]?

(Kha) Or again, for whom, in which realm, will the truth of the origin cease, for that person, in that realm, has the truth of suffering ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ [V 1.0366] tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those who are being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa realms, for them the truth of the origin will cease in that realm, but for them the truth of suffering has not ceased in that realm. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them in that realm both the truth of the origin will cease and the truth of suffering has ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whichever person, in whichever realm, the truth of suffering has ceased, for that person, in that realm, will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for the Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for those in the states of deprivation, and for the non-percipient beings, for them, in that realm, the truth of suffering has ceased, but for them, in that realm, the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for others who will attain the path, for them, in that realm, both the truth of suffering has ceased and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever realm, the truth of the path will cease, for that person, in that realm, has the truth of suffering ceased?

Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0339] tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those who are being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa realms, for them the truth of the path will cease in that realm, but for them the truth of suffering has not ceased in that realm. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for others who will attain the path, for them in that realm both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of suffering has ceased.

130. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

130. (Ka) For whichever person, in whichever realm, the truth of the origin has ceased, for that person, in that realm, will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path—for the Arahants, for those worldlings who will not attain the path, and for those in the planes of misery—for them the truth of the origin has ceased in that realm, but the truth of the path will not cease for them in that realm. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for those others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of the origin has ceased in that realm and the truth of the path will cease in that realm.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever, in whichever realm, the truth of the path will cease, for that person, in that realm, has the truth of the origin ceased?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhittha. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [V 1.0367] ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhittha.

For those in the Pure Abodes, while the second consciousness is occurring, for them the truth of the path will cease in that realm, but the truth of the origin has not ceased for them in that realm. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for those others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of the path will cease in that realm and the truth of the origin has ceased in that realm.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative: Individuals

131. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

131. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering has not ceased, for that person will the truth of the origin not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin will not cease, for that person has the truth of suffering not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ka) yassa [M 1.0252] dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti[T 1.0340]? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering has not ceased, for that person will the truth of the path not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for that person has the truth of suffering not ceased? It has ceased.

132. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

132. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin has not ceased, for that person will the truth of the path not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for that person has the truth of the origin not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative: Sphere

133. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha…pe….

133. In which realm the truth of suffering has not ceased… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: Individuals and Sphere

134. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

134. (Ka) For whom, in which realm, the truth of suffering has not ceased, for that person, in that realm, will the truth of the origin not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom, in which realm, the truth of the origin will not cease, for that person, in that realm, has the truth of suffering not ceased? It has ceased.

(Ka) yassa [V 1.0368] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

(Ka) For whom, in which realm, the truth of suffering has not ceased, for that person, in that realm, will the truth of the path not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom, in which realm, the truth of the path will not cease, for that person, in that realm, has the truth of suffering not ceased? It has ceased.

135. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

135. (Ka) For whom, wherein the truth of the origin has not ceased, for them, therein will the truth of the path not cease?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhittha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the Pure Abodes, while the second consciousness-moment is occurring, for them, therein the truth of the origin has not ceased, but for them, therein the truth of the path will cease. For non-percipient beings, for them, therein the truth of the origin has not ceased, and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom, wherein the truth of the path will not cease, for them, therein has the truth of the origin not ceased?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ [T 1.0341] na nirujjhittha. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhittha.

At the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, and for those in the planes of misery, for them, therein the truth of the path will not cease, but for them, therein the truth of the origin has ceased. For non-percipient beings, for them, therein the truth of the path will not cease, and the truth of the origin has not ceased.

Nirodhavāro.

The Section on Cessation.

2. Pavatti 3. uppādanirodhavāro

2. Occurrence 3. The Section on Arising and Cessation.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present.

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive: Individual.

136. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0369][M 1.0253] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

136. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for them is the truth of the origin ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin is ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering arising? No.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for them is the truth of the path ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path is ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering arising? No.

137. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

137. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin is arising, for them is the truth of the path ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path is ceasing, for them is the truth of the origin arising? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: Sphere.

138. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti?

138. Wherein the truth of suffering is arising, therein is the truth of the origin ceasing?

Asaññasatte tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhati…pe….

In the plane of non-percipient beings, therein the truth of suffering arises, but therein the truth of the origin does not cease... and so on.

(Yatthakaṃ uppādavārepi nirodhavārepi uppādanirodhavārepi sadisaṃ natthi nānākaraṇaṃ).

(The section on spheres is the same in the section on arising, in the section on cessation, and in the section on arising and cessation; there is no distinction to be made.)

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Individual and Sphere.

139. Yassa [V 1.0370] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

139. For whom, wherein the truth of suffering is arising, for them, therein is the truth of the origin ceasing? No.

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ).

(The section on individuals and the section on individuals and spheres are also the same.)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Individual.

140. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

140. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for them is the truth of the origin not ceasing?

Taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca [M 1.0254] na nirujjhati.

At the dissolution-moment of craving, for them the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them the truth of the origin is ceasing. For all who are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from craving in the course of existence, and for those at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit in the formless realm, for them the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the origin is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the origin is not ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering not arising?

Sabbesaṃ [T 1.0342] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte taṇhāvippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all who are being reborn and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them the truth of the origin is not ceasing, but for them the truth of suffering is arising. For all who are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from craving in the course of existence, and for those at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit in the formless realm, for them the truth of the origin is not ceasing and the truth of suffering is not arising.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for them is the truth of the path not ceasing?

Maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhati.

At the dissolution-moment of the path, for them the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them the truth of the path is ceasing. For all who are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the path in the course of existence, and for those at the arising-moment of the path and of fruition in the formless realm, for them the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the path is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0371] vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path is not ceasing, for them is the truth of suffering not arising?

Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For all who are being reborn, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them the truth of the path is not ceasing, but for them the truth of suffering is arising. For all who are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the path in the course of existence, and for those at the arising-moment of the path and of fruition in the formless realm, for them the truth of the path is not ceasing and the truth of suffering is not arising.

141. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

141. (Ka) For whom the truth of the origin is not arising, for them is the truth of the path not ceasing?

Maggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati. Taṇhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhati.

At the dissolution-moment of the path, for them the truth of the origin is not arising, but for them the truth of the path is ceasing. For those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving, for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the path, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them the truth of the origin is not arising and the truth of the path is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā [T 1.0343] pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the truth of the path is not ceasing, for them is the truth of the origin not arising?

Taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Maggavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the arising-moment of craving, for them the truth of the path is not ceasing, but for them the truth of the origin is arising. For those at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the path, for those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from craving, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them the truth of the path is not ceasing and the truth of the origin is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative: Sphere.

142. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

142. Wherein the truth of suffering is not arising… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative: Individual and Sphere.

143. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

143. For whom, wherein the truth of suffering is not arising… and so on.

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ, yassayatthakepi nirodhasamāpannānanti na kātabbaṃ).

(The section on individuals and the section on individuals and spheres are similar; in the section on individuals and spheres, the classification 'for those who have attained cessation' should not be made.)

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past.

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive Section: Individual

144. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0372][M 1.0255] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

144. (Ka) For whom did the truth of suffering arise, for them did the truth of origin cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom...? Yes.

(Atītā pucchā yathā uppādavāre vibhattā evaṃ uppādanirodhavārepi anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhajitabbaṃ).

(Just as the past questions were analyzed in the origination section, so too should the positive and negative questions be analyzed in the origination-cessation section.)

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive Section: Individual

145. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

145. (Ka) For whom will the truth of suffering arise, for them will the truth of origin cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain mind-moment, for them the truth of suffering will arise, but for them the truth of origin will not cease. For the remaining persons, both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom...? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0344] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom will the truth of suffering arise, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjissati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of suffering will arise, but for them the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the arising moment of the supreme path, for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain mind-moment, and for others who will attain a path, for them both the truth of suffering will arise and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom...? Yes.

146. (Ka) yassa [V 1.0373] samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

146. (Ka) For whom will the truth of origin arise, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjissati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of origin will arise, but for them the truth of the path will not cease. For those who will attain the path, both the truth of origin will arise and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom will the truth of the path cease, for them will the truth of origin arise?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca uppajjissati.

For those at the arising moment of the supreme path, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain mind-moment, for them the truth of the path will cease, but for them the truth of origin will not arise. For those who will attain the path, both the truth of the path will cease and the truth of origin will arise.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive Section: Plane of Existence

147. Yattha [M 1.0256] dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati…pe….

147. In which plane of existence the truth of suffering will arise... and so forth.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive Section: Individual and Plane of Existence

148. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

148. For whom, in which plane of existence the truth of suffering will arise, for that person, in that plane of existence, will the truth of origin cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha [T 1.0345] …pe… itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha…pe…. (Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ).

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain mind-moment, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane... and so forth. For the remaining beings in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them in that plane... and so forth. (The section on the individual and the section on the individual-and-plane are similar.)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative Section: Individual

149. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

149. (Ka) For whom the truth of suffering will not arise, for them will the truth of origin not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0374] vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom the truth of origin will not cease, for them will the truth of suffering not arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain mind-moment, for them the truth of origin will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering will arise. For those endowed with the final consciousness, for them both the truth of origin will not cease and the truth of suffering will not arise.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the truth of suffering will not arise, for them will the truth of the path not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for them will the truth of suffering not arise?

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the supreme path, for Arahants, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering will arise. For those endowed with the final consciousness, for them both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of suffering will not arise.

150. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

150. (Ka) For whom the truth of origin will not arise, for them will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccañca [T 1.0346] nuppajjissati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the supreme path, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them the truth of origin will not arise, but for them the truth of the path will cease. For Arahants at the dissolution moment of the supreme path, for them both the truth of origin will not arise and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or alternatively, for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for them will the truth of origin not arise?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe [M 1.0257] arahantānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of origin will arise. For Arahants at the dissolution moment of the supreme path, for them both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of origin will not arise.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Section: Plane of Existence

151. Yattha [V 1.0375] dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati…pe….

151. Where the truth of suffering will not arise… and so forth.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative Section: Individual and Plane of Existence

152. Yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjissati…pe….

152. For whom, where the truth of suffering will not arise… and so forth.

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ, samudayasaccaṃ maggasaccaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ, aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe, arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjissati).

(The section on the individual and the section on the individual-and-plane are similar. The truth of origin and the truth of the path make no difference. For those at the dissolution moment of the supreme path, for Arahants, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane, both the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of origin will not arise.)

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Present and Past Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive Section: Individual

153. Yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

153. For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for them has the truth of origin ceased? Yes.

Yassa vā pana…pe….

Or again, for whomsoever… and so on.

(Paccuppannaatītā paccuppannenātītā (syā.) pucchā uppādavārepi uppādanirodhavārepi yassakampi yatthakampi yassayatthakampi anulomampi paccanīkampi sadisaṃ, asammohantena vibhajitabbā).

(The questions on the present and past—in the section on arising and in the section on arising and ceasing; the section on persons, the section on planes, and the section on persons-and-planes; both the positive and the negative—are similar. They should be analyzed without confusion.)

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive: The Individual

154. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

154. For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for them will the truth of the origin cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ [T 1.0347] nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness; and for those at the arising moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path—for them, the truth of suffering is arising, but for them the truth of the origin will not cease. For the other persons who are being reborn, and for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the origin will cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 1.0376] vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the origin will cease, for them is the truth of suffering arising?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa [M 1.0258] ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For all who are passing away; for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those at the arising moment of the path and of fruition in the formless realm—for them, the truth of the origin will cease, but for them the truth of suffering is not arising. For all who are being reborn, and for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence, for them the truth of the origin will cease and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the truth of suffering is arising, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of suffering is arising, but for them the truth of the path will not cease. For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for those at the arising moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for those other persons who will attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of suffering is arising and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the path will cease, for them is the truth of suffering arising?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe [T 1.0348] tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those at the dissolution moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for other persons who will attain the path, who are passing away or are at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those at the arising moment of the path and of fruition in the formless realm—for them, the truth of the path will cease, but for them the truth of suffering is not arising. For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for those at the arising moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for other persons who will attain the path, who are being reborn or are at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, the truth of the path will cease, and the truth of suffering is arising.

155. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

155. For whom the truth of the origin is arising, for them will the truth of the path cease?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye [V 1.0377] maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them at the arising moment of craving, the truth of the origin is arising, but for them the truth of the path will not cease. For those who will attain the path, for them at the arising moment of craving, the truth of the origin is arising, and the truth of the path will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom the truth of the path will cease, for them is the truth of the origin arising?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for those at the moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for other persons who will attain the path, who are at the dissolution moment of craving or for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is present; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the path will cease, but for them the truth of the origin is not arising. For those who will attain the path, for them at the arising moment of craving, the truth of the path will cease, and the truth of the origin is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: The Sphere

156. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati…pe….

156. In which sphere the truth of suffering is arising… and so on.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Person and Sphere

157. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0259] yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ [T 1.0349] nirujjhissatīti?

157. For whom, in which sphere, the truth of suffering is arising, for them, in that sphere, will the truth of the origin cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ…pe… itaresaṃ catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ…pe….

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness; for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, in that existence, the truth of suffering… and so on. For others being reborn in the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, and for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, in that existence, the truth of suffering… and so on.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whom, in which existence, the truth of the origin will cease, for them, in that existence, is the truth of suffering arising?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Catuvokāraṃ pañcavokāraṃ [V 1.0378] upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless existence at the arising moment of the path and of fruition—for them, the truth of origin will cease in that existence, but for them the truth of suffering does not arise in that existence. For those being reborn into the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, and for those at the arising moment of consciousness in the course of existence—for them, in that existence, the truth of origin will cease and the truth of suffering is arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

For whom, in which existence, the truth of suffering is arising, for them, in that existence, will the truth of the path cease?

Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 1.0350] pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For Arahants at the arising-moment of consciousness; for those worldlings who will not attain the path (both for those being reborn and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence); and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of suffering is arising in that existence, but for them the truth of the path will not cease in that existence. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those at the arising-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for other persons who will attain the path (both for those being reborn and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness in the course of existence)—for them, in that existence, the truth of suffering is also arising and the truth of the path will also cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the truth of the path will cease in a certain existence, for that person in that existence, does the truth of suffering arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjati. Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca uppajjati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for other persons who will attain the path, who are passing away; for those at the dissolution-moment of a consciousness during the course of existence; and for those in the formless sphere at the arising-moment of the path and of fruition—for them, in that sphere, the truth of the path will cease, but for them, in that sphere, the truth of suffering is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those at the arising-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for other persons who will attain the path, who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of a consciousness during the course of existence—for them, in that sphere, the truth of the path will also cease, and the truth of suffering is also arising.

158. (Ka) yassa yattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

158. For a person for whom the truth of origin is arising in a certain existence, for that person in that existence, will the truth of the path cease?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati, no ca [M 1.0260] tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe [V 1.0379] tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca uppajjati maggasaccañca nirujjhissati.

For those in the planes of misery, and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them at the arising-moment of craving, in that existence, the truth of origin is arising, but for them, in that existence, the truth of the path will not cease. For those who will attain the path, for them at the arising-moment of craving, in that existence, the truth of origin is also arising, and the truth of the path will also cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the truth of the path will cease in a certain existence, for that person in that existence, is the truth of origin arising?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti [T 1.0351] ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ uppajjati. Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca uppajjati.

For those at the arising-moment of the highest path; for those at the arising-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for other persons who will attain the path, at the dissolution-moment of their craving; and for those in whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, in that existence, the truth of the path will cease, but for them, in that existence, the truth of origin is not arising. For those who will attain the path, for them at the arising-moment of craving, in that existence, the truth of the path will also cease, and the truth of origin is also arising.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative: Persons

159. (Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

159. For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for that person, will the truth of origin not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For all who are passing away, for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, and for those in the formless realm at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruit—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them, the truth of origin will cease. For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those in the formless realm at the arising-moment of the highest path and of its fruit—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of origin will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the truth of origin will not cease, for that person, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca [T 1.0352] nuppajjati.

For those at the arising-moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the arising-moment of consciousness, and for those at the arising-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path—for them, the truth of origin will not cease, but for them, the truth of suffering is arising. For those at the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, and for those in the formless realm at the arising-moment of the highest path and of its fruit—for them, the truth of origin will not cease and the truth of suffering is not arising.

(Ka) yassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For a person for whom the truth of suffering is not arising, for that person, will the truth of the path not cease?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa [V 1.0380] bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ [M 1.0261] cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggaphalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for others who will attain the path, for them while passing away, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence, and in the formless sphere at the arising-moment of the path and of the fruition—for them the truth of suffering is not arising, but for them the truth of the path will cease. At the dissolution-moment of the highest path; for arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness; for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them while passing away, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence, and in the formless sphere at the arising-moment of the highest fruition—for them the truth of suffering is not arising and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the truth of the path will not cease, for that person, is the truth of suffering not arising?

Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggaphalassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For Arahants at the arising-moment of consciousness; and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them while being reborn, and at the arising-moment of consciousness during the course of existence—for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of suffering is arising. At the dissolution-moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness; and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, for them while passing away, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness during the course of existence, and in the formless sphere at the arising-moment of the highest fruition—for them the truth of the path will not cease and the truth of suffering is not arising.

160. (Ka) yassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

160. For whom is the truth of origin not arising, for them will the truth of the path not cease?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ [T 1.0353] paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

At the arising moment of the highest path; for those endowed with the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for others who will attain the path; for those at the dissolution moment of craving; for those for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them the truth of origin is not arising, but for them the truth of the path will cease. At the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants; and for those worldlings who will not attain the path who are at the dissolution moment of craving or for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring—for them the truth of origin is not arising, and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or, for whom will the truth of the path not cease, for them is the truth of origin not arising?

Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ [V 1.0381] maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne tesaṃ maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those worldlings who will not attain the path who are at the arising moment of craving—for them the truth of the path will not cease, but for them the truth of origin is arising. At the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants; and for those worldlings who will not attain the path who are at the dissolution moment of craving or for whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring—for them the truth of the path will not cease, and the truth of origin is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Negative Sphere

161. Yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati…pe….

161. Where the truth of suffering is not arising… and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Negative Person-Sphere

162. (Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

162. For whom, where the truth of suffering is not arising, for them, there, will the truth of origin not cease?

Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa [M 1.0262] bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa [T 1.0354] anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those passing away from the four-constituent and five-constituent existences; for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence; and for those at the arising-moment of the path and its fruit in the formless existence—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising there, but for them, the truth of origin will cease there. At the dissolution-moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution-moment of consciousness; for those at the dissolution-moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those passing away from the non-percipient existence; and for those at the arising-moment of the highest path and its fruit in the formless existence—for them, both the truth of suffering is not arising there, and the truth of origin will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or alternatively, for whom, where the truth of origin will not cease, for them does the truth of suffering not arise there?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggamaggassa [V 1.0382] ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

At the arising moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness; for those at the arising moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; and for those being reborn into the non-percipient existence—for them, the truth of origin will not cease there, but for them, the truth of suffering is arising there. At the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for those at the dissolution moment of that consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those in the formless sphere at the arising moment of the highest path and of fruition; and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence—for them, both the truth of origin will not cease there, and the truth of suffering is not arising there.

(Ka) yassa yattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom, where the truth of suffering does not arise, for them will the truth of the path not cease there?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggaphalassa [T 1.0355] uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā apāyā asaññasattā (syā.) cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for others who will attain the path, who are passing away; for those in the course of existence at the dissolution moment of consciousness; and for those in the formless sphere at the arising moment of the path and of fruition—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising there, but for them the truth of the path will cease there. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for beings in the woeful states and for those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are passing away; for those in the course of existence at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for those in the formless sphere at the arising moment of the highest fruition; and for those passing away from the non-percipient existence—for them, the truth of suffering is not arising there, and the truth of the path will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Or alternatively, for whom, where the truth of the path will not cease, for them does the truth of suffering not arise there?

Arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ apāyaṃ asaññasattaṃ (syā.) upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe aggaphalassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjati.

For Arahants at the arising moment of consciousness; for beings in the woeful states and those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are being reborn; for those in the course of existence at the arising moment of consciousness; and for those being reborn into the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the path will not cease there, but for them the truth of suffering is arising there. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for beings in the woeful states and those worldlings who will not attain the path, who are passing away; for those in the course of existence at the dissolution moment of consciousness; for those in the formless realm at the arising moment of the highest fruition; and for those passing away from the realm of non-percipient beings—for them, the truth of the path will not cease there, and the truth of suffering is not arising there.

163. (Ka) yassa [M 1.0263] yattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati tassa tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

163. For whom, where the truth of the origin does not arise, for them will the truth of the path not cease there?

Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye caññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte [V 1.0383] vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccañca nuppajjati maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the highest path; for those at the arising moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path; for those others who will attain a path and are at the dissolution moment of craving; and for those in whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring—for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin is not arising, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants; for beings in the woeful states; for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are at the dissolution moment of craving; for those in whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin is not arising, and the truth of the path will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha maggasaccaṃ [T 1.0356] na nirujjhissati tassa tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjatīti?

Alternatively, for whomever in whatever plane the truth of the path will not cease, for them in that plane is the truth of the origin not arising?

Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nuppajjati. Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca na nirujjhissati samudayasaccañca nuppajjati.

For those in the woeful planes and for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are at the arising moment of craving—for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not cease, but for them, in that plane, the truth of the origin is arising. For those at the dissolution moment of the highest path; for Arahants; for beings in the woeful planes; for those worldlings who will not attain the path and are at the dissolution moment of craving; for those in whom a consciousness dissociated from craving is occurring; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, the truth of the path will not cease, and the truth of the origin is not arising.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) The Section on the Past and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Direct Question

164. Yassa dukkhasaccaṃ uppajjittha tassa samudayasaccaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

164. For whomever the truth of suffering has arisen, for them will the truth of the origin cease?

(Yathā nirodhavāre atītānāgatā atītenānāgatā (syā.) pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhattā evaṃ uppādanirodhavārepi asammohantena vibhajitabbaṃ).

(Just as in the Section on Cessation the questions concerning the past and future were analyzed in both the direct and reverse orders, so too in the Section on Arising and Cessation they should be analyzed without confusion.)

Uppādanirodhavāro.

The Section on Arising and Cessation.

Pavattivāro niṭṭhito.

The Section on Occurrence is concluded.

3. Pariññāvāro

3. The Section on Full Understanding

1. Paccuppannavāro

1. The Section on the Present

165. (Ka) yo [V 1.0384] dukkhasaccaṃ parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ pajahatīti? Āmantā.

165. (Ka) Is one who is fully understanding the truth of suffering abandoning the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ pajahati so dukkhasaccaṃ parijānātīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Alternatively, is one who is abandoning the truth of the origin fully understanding the truth of suffering? Yes.

(Ka) yo [M 1.0264] dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is a person who is not fully understanding the truth of suffering not abandoning the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, is a person who is not abandoning the truth of the origin not fully understanding the truth of suffering? Yes.

2. Atītavāro

2. The Section on the Past

166. (Ka) yo [T 1.0357] dukkhasaccaṃ parijānittha so samudayasaccaṃ pajahitthāti? Āmantā.

166. (Ka) Did a person who fully understood the truth of suffering abandon the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, did a person who abandoned the truth of the origin fully understand the truth of suffering? Yes.

(Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānittha so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahitthāti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Did a person who did not fully understand the truth of suffering not abandon the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, did a person who did not abandon the truth of the origin not fully understand the truth of suffering? Yes.

3. Anāgatavāro

3. The Section on the Future

167. (Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ parijānissati so samudayasaccaṃ pajahissatīti? Āmantā.

167. (Ka) Will a person who will fully understand the truth of suffering abandon the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, will a person who will abandon the truth of the origin fully understand the truth of suffering? Yes.

(Ka) yo [V 1.0385] dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānissati so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Will a person who will not fully understand the truth of suffering not abandon the truth of the origin? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, will a person who will not abandon the truth of the origin not fully understand the truth of suffering? Yes.

4. Paccuppannātītavāro

4. The Section on the Present and the Past

168. (Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ pajahitthāti? No.

168. (Ka) Has a person who is fully understanding the truth of suffering abandoned the truth of the origin? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ pajahittha so dukkhasaccaṃ parijānātīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, is a person who has abandoned the truth of the origin fully understanding the truth of suffering? No.

(Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahitthāti?

(Ka) Has a person who is not fully understanding the truth of suffering not abandoned the truth of the origin?

Arahā dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti, no ca samudayasaccaṃ nappajahittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti samudayasaccañca nappajahittha.

An Arahant is not fully understanding the truth of suffering, but he has abandoned the truth of the origin. Setting aside the person endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons are not fully understanding the truth of suffering and have not abandoned the truth of the origin.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nappajahittha so dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānātīti?

(Kha) Or again, is a person who has not abandoned the truth of the origin not fully understanding the truth of suffering?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī samudayasaccaṃ nappajahittha, no ca dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti. Aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā samudayasaccañca nappajahittha dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti.

A person endowed with the highest path has not abandoned the truth of the origin, but he is fully understanding the truth of suffering. Setting aside the person endowed with the highest path and the Arahant, the remaining persons have not abandoned the truth of the origin and are not fully understanding the truth of suffering.

5. Paccuppannānāgatavāro

5. The Section on the Present and the Future

169. (Ka) yo [T 1.0358] dukkhasaccaṃ parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ pajahissatīti? No.

169. (Ka) Will a person who is fully understanding the truth of suffering abandon the truth of the origin? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ pajahissati so dukkhasaccaṃ parijānātīti? No.

(Kha) Or again, is a person who will abandon the truth of the origin fully understanding the truth of suffering? No.

(Ka) yo [M 1.0265] dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissatīti?

(Ka) Will a person who is not fully understanding the truth of suffering not abandon the truth of the origin?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānanti, no ca samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissanti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti [V 1.0386] te dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti samudayasaccañca nappajahissanti.

Those who will attain the path do not yet fully understand the truth of suffering, but they will abandon the truth of the origin. The Arahant and those worldlings who will not attain the path do not yet fully understand the truth of suffering and will not abandon the truth of the origin.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissati so dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānātīti?

(Kha) Or again, does one who will not abandon the truth of the origin not yet fully understand the truth of suffering?

Aggamaggasamaṅgī samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissati, no ca dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti. Arahā ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te samudayasaccañca nappajahissanti dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti.

One endowed with the highest path will not abandon the truth of the origin, but is fully comprehending the truth of suffering. The Arahant and those worldlings who will not attain the path will not abandon the truth of the origin and do not fully comprehend the truth of suffering.

6. Atītānāgatavāro

6. The Section on the Past and the Future.

170. (Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ parijānittha so samudayasaccaṃ pajahissatīti? No.

170. Will one who has fully understood the truth of suffering abandon the truth of the origin? No.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ pajahissati so dukkhasaccaṃ parijānitthāti? No.

Or, as for one who will abandon the truth of the origin, has that one fully understood the truth of suffering? No.

(Ka) yo dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānittha so samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissatīti?

Will one who has not fully understood the truth of suffering not abandon the truth of the origin?

Ye maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānittha, no ca te samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissanti. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te dukkhasaccañca na parijānittha samudayasaccañca nappajahissanti.

Those who will attain the path have not fully understood the truth of suffering, but they will abandon the truth of the origin. One endowed with the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path have not fully understood the truth of suffering and will not abandon the truth of the origin.

(Kha) yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissati so dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānitthāti?

Or, as for one who will not abandon the truth of the origin, has that one not fully understood the truth of suffering?

Arahā samudayasaccaṃ nappajahissati, no ca dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānittha. Aggamaggasamaṅgī ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti te [T 1.0359] samudayasaccañca nappajahissanti dukkhasaccañca na parijānittha.

The Arahant will not abandon the truth of the origin, but has fully understood the truth of suffering. One endowed with the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path will not abandon the truth of the origin and have not fully understood the truth of suffering.

Pariññāvāro.

The Section on Full Comprehension.

Saccayamakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Book of Pairs on the Truths is concluded.
